This coupling can introduce spurious periodicities and complicate their interpretation. We present a non-parametric extension of the phase-distance correlation (PDC) periodogram that quantifies and reduces dependence on scan geometry at the period-search stage. Using data, we identified recurrent periodicities associated with characteristic scanning-law timescales and showed that they are strongly suppressed by the scan-angle-controlled statistic. We then applied the method to Data Release 4 (DR4) prerelease epoch astrometry, where a recurrent ∼54-day feature is suppressed across multiple sources while independently known orbital signals remain detectable. The method provides a diagnostic of scan-angle dependence and a way to mitigate its impact on period searches. These results are particularly relevant for DR4, where public epoch astrometry will enable large-scale searches for companions ranging from exoplanets to dormant black holes. Hipparcos Gaia Hipparcos Gaia Gaia
2026-10-29.summary_zh: 本研究针对空间天体测量任务中因一维扫描策略导致的系统误差，提出了相位-距离相关周期图的非参数扩展方法，能够在周期搜索阶段量化并减弱对扫描几何的依赖。通过对Hipparcos数据的分析，识别出与扫描规律相关的周期性特征，并用扫描角度控制统计量有效压制了这些虚假周期。该方法在Gaia DR4数据中验证了有效性，成功压制了~54天的系统周期同时保留了已知的真实轨道信号，为利用Gaia历元天体测量进行系外行星、褐矮星等伴星搜索提供了重要的系统误差诊断和处理工具。

2026-10-29.title: Spatial variability of CH4-to-CO conversion pathways in irradiated gas giant atmospheres: implications for chemical relaxation and 1D quench schemes
2026-10-29.abstract: Abstract Close-in gas giant atmospheres are in chemical disequilibrium. Solving 3D kinetics to capture one source of this disequilibrium, transport-induced quenching, is computationally demanding, so simplifications are used. General circulation models (GCMs) relax abundances on the timescale of a single conversion pathway. 1D models place a quench level and hold abundances vertically uniform above it. We test both simplifications on CH4 against aerosol-free, solar-composition GCM simulations with thermochemical kinetics for HAT-P-11b, HD 189733b, HD 209458b and WASP-17b. We find ten CH4-to-CO conversion pathways, varying with depth, longitude and planet. A single pathway controls CH4 quenching on the three cooler planets; on WASP-17b two compete. The CH4 quench level is 3D: where the atmosphere is hotter, or a faster pathway takes over, the conversion timescale shortens, the quench level rises and the quench-level abundance falls. On WASP-17b the pathway switch lifts the quench level over the substellar tropics, deepening equatorial CH4 depletion. A 1D quench treatment with the Zahnle & Marley timescale typically locates the quench level within a factor of two in pressure for CH4 and about four for CO on every planet. It fails above the quench level, where every quench scheme holds abundances vertically uniform. The minor carbon carrier, CH4 or CO depending on the planet, is wrong by up to two orders of magnitude, on HD 189733b in opposite directions at different latitudes. Quenching sets an abundance at the quench level but does not fix it thereafter; even without photochemistry, transport and conversion keep that abundance spatially structured.
2026-10-29.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-10-29.summary_zh: 本研究通过三维全球环流模型模拟具有热化学反应的系外气态巨行星大气，揭示了CH₄到CO的转化途径随深度、经度和行星而变化的空间结构，发现1D假设将大气分层设置为垂直均匀的方法在描述化学非平衡时存在显著偏差。研究表明虽然1D淬灭方案能在较好的精度范围内定位淬灭层，但在淬灭层上方完全失效，且对次要碳承体的丰度预测误差可达两个数量级，这对精确模拟系外行星大气组成具有重要启示。

2026-10-28.title: Eclipse Properties and Superhump Evolution in the SU UMa-type Dwarf Nova Z Cha
2026-10-28.abstract: Abstract The advent of large-scale time-domain surveys provides both opportunities and challenges for understanding accretion disk evolution in cataclysmic variables (CVs). Using high-cadence photometry from the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), we investigate the eclipsing SU UMa-type dwarf nova Z Cha. Leveraging eclipses as a natural probe, we examine the evolution of the accretion disk through variations in eclipse depth, O – C of eclipse minima, and positive superhump (PSH) amplitude. During superoutbursts, all three quantities exhibit quasiperiodic modulations with a common period of ∼2 days, consistent with the precession period of an eccentric disk. We interpret these correlated variations as evidence of an eccentric, precessing disk: O – C traces the periodic shift of the system’s brightness center, while eclipse depth and PSH amplitude vary with the orientation of the disk bulge relative to the line of sight. In quiescence (Sectors 13 and 93), PSHs with periods of ∼0.0762 days show linearly decreasing amplitudes and periods, indicating gradual shrinkage of the eccentric disk and a slowing precession. Remarkably, a coherent signal with a period of ∼0.0729 days ( ϵ − ≈ −0.02) appears in the same quiescent intervals. This signal may represent negative superhumps (NSHs) coexisting with PSHs, although an orbital sideband of the PSH cannot presently be excluded with the available data. If confirmed as NSHs, their coexistence with PSHs would challenge the classical tilted-disk model, and could be explained by retrograde apsidal precession of an eccentric disk, where the inner disk precesses retrogradely (NSHs) and the outer disk progradely (PSHs); this interpretation remains to be tested by further observations.
2026-10-28.summary_zh: 本研究利用TESS高时间分辨率光度测光数据，通过日食深度、日食时刻和正超驼峰振幅的准周期调制，揭示了食双星型矮新星Z Cha中偏心圆盘的存在及其进动特性，三个物理量在~2天周期内的相关变化证实了圆盘的偏心性和进动。在静止状态下，正超驼峰和可能存在的负超驼峰共存现象挑战了传统的倾斜圆盘模型，可能反映了圆盘内外区域逆向进动的复杂动力学过程。

2026-10-28.title: The ALMA Survey of Gas Evolution of PROtoplanetary disks (AGE-PRO): Evolution of dust properties from multi-wavelength observations
2026-10-28.abstract: Abstract Understanding the evolution of solids in protoplanetary discs is important to comprehend the formation of giant planets cores and terrestrial planets. The ALMA Large Program AGE-PRO studied key disc properties in a survey of 30 protoplanetary discs across three evolutionary stages: the embedded phase (0.5-1 Myr), the middle-age phase (1-3 Myr), and the end of the disc lifetime (2-6 Myr). Preliminary dust properties were estimated using 1.3 mm observations, but a multi-wavelength analysis provides a better constraint of important properties such as the dust disc mass, the dust temperature, and the maximum grain size. We present new ALMA 3.1 mm and 1.5 mm (Bands 3 and 5) continuum observations of the complete survey of 30 AGE-PRO discs. We fitted the observed visibilities and derived radial brightness profiles, spatially resolving 20 discs from the AGE-PRO sample at the two studied wavelengths. A multi-wavelength modelling was performed including also the radial profiles from the 1.3 mm observations. Our results replicate trends obtained from the single wavelength analysis: the dust disc size seems to be constant over age and the dust disc mass decreases with time, with a factor ∼10-40 uncertainty from opacity assumptions. This result implies much lower gas-to-dust mass ratios for the discs in our sample than previously reported. In addition, the derived spectral indices are consistent with optically thick emission in a large fraction of the AGE-PRO discs, in particular for the Ophiuchus and Lupus discs.
2026-10-28.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-10-28.summary_zh: AGE-PRO项目通过多波长ALMA观测（1.3、1.5、3.1 mm）对30个不同演化阶段的原行星盘进行了尘埃特性研究。通过空间分辨的亮度廓线拟合和多波长建模，研究发现尘埃盘尺寸在演化过程中保持稳定，但尘埃质量随时间显著下降（衰减因子~10-40），这表明样本中的气尘比显著低于先前报告值，且大部分盘在长波段表现出光学厚发射特征。

2026-10-27.title: UV-driven organic precursor formation and dust evolution outside the snow line
2026-10-27.abstract: In the outer regions of protoplanetary disks, dust grains are often mantled with a layer of ice containing simple molecules. The irradiation of the disk by far-ultraviolet (FUV) photons breaks such molecules, producing photoproducts (radicals, ions, and intermediary molecules) in the ice layer that can act as precursors to complex organics. As grains drift towards the warmer, inner region of the disk, their consequent sublimation of ices causes organic synthesis on their surfaces, potentially enhancing grain sticking and dust growth. In addition to interstellar medium radiation, FUV emission from the central star and nearby massive stars can contribute to photoproduct formation. We perform a vertical dust size evolution simulation including grain growth and fragmentation, and calculate photoproduct formation under irradiation from these three sources, treating the central star's FUV continuum and Lyman-$α$ emission separately. We find that enhanced UV irradiation, particularly from stellar Lyman-$α$ emission, significantly increases the total abundance of photoproducts formed. This results from both the strong stellar Lyman-$α$ flux and resonant scattering by the overlying hydrogen layer, which redistributes photons and directs a fraction toward the dust layer. Turbulent mixing and fragmentation cycles further redistribute grains vertically, allowing photoproducts to form throughout the disk. We find that stellar Lyman-$α$ irradiation can produce sufficient photoproducts to produce an organic mantle with an {organic-to-rock ratio of $\approx 10\%$}, which could enhance grain sticking. Our results suggest that FUV-driven organic synthesis may facilitate dust growth and contribute to overcoming barriers to planetesimal formation.
2026-10-27.summary_zh: 本研究通过垂直尘埃演化模拟和光化学计算,考察原行星盘雪线外紫外辐照驱动的有机前驱体形成及其对尘埃演化的影响。研究发现恒星莱曼α辐射通过共振散射能够显著增加光产物丰度,足以在尘粒表面形成约10%的有机-岩石比外壳。这些紫外驱动的有机合成可以增强尘粒粘着性,促进尘埃生长,从而有助于克服类地行星形成的屏障。

2026-10-27.title: The anomalously large transiting planet around Boyajian's star: evidence for a circumplanetary ring
2026-10-27.abstract: A recent study reported a transiting giant-planet candidate with a mass of $9.4^{+4.9}_{-4.1}\,M_{\rm J}$ and a radius of $1.7\pm0.1\,R_{\rm J}$ on a wide orbit around Boyajian's star (KIC 8462852, also called Tabby's star), which is well known for its irregular, deep flux dips. The reported radius is puzzling, because cool giant planets of $\sim$10\,$M_{\rm Jup}$ are expected to have radii close to Jupiter's, so the companion appears $\sim$60--70\% larger than standard models allow. Here we explore the solution that the planet is actually ringed. We develop a fast and accurate code to compute the transit light curve due to a ringed planet, and apply it to the TESS light curve. The ring model is marginally favoured by the data by $Δχ^2>10$ and a difference in Bayesian information criterion (BIC) of $<2$. The preferred configuration is a Jupiter-sized ($1.1\,R_{\rm J}$) planet surrounded by an opaque, highly flattened ring extending to $3.1$--$4.4$ planetary radii with a nearly polar obliquity. While the ring geometry is uncertain, simple estimates suggest that a debris annulus extending out to the planet's Roche limit is needed to explain the large transit depth. The ring thus removes the radius anomaly altogether and is qualitatively consistent with the dusty, comet-shepherding environment inferred from the star's historic dimmings.
2026-10-27.summary_zh: 本研究针对博亚吉安星周围巨行星候选体半径异常偏大的问题，通过开发快速精确的环行星凌星光变曲线计算代码，对TESS观测数据进行拟合分析。研究表明该行星实际上被一个不透明、高度扁平的环系统所环绕，环的外半径延伸至行星半径的3.1-4.4倍，具有近极向的倾角。该环模型消除了行星的半径异常，且与该星历史性昏暗事件推断出的尘埃-彗星牧羊环境在物理图像上相一致。

2026-10-27.title: Planetesimal Delivery to Giant Planet Circumplanetary Disks: Bulk Ice Enrichment and an Ice-rich Iapetus
2026-10-27.abstract: The regular satellites of Jupiter and Saturn are substantially enriched in ice relative to the rock-rich solids of the outer Solar System. In addition, the satellites interior to Titan and distant Iapetus are icier than Titan itself. Collisional processes and subsequent migration can readily alter compositions deep in the planetary potential well, but producing a distant, ice-rich satellite with Iapetus's radius of about 700 km is a challenge \citep{mosqueira2026a}. We show that differential ablation and capture of icy and rocky fragments from differentiated outer Solar System bodies can explain the bulk Jovian and Kronian satellite ice enrichment and supply the substantial ice-rich inventory needed for Iapetus. For 1\,m--1\,km fragments with the canonical size-distribution index \(p=3.5\) and a source containing 30\% ice by mass, the fixed radial distance Saturn calculation deposits material with ice fractions of 0.66 (delivery of vapor-only rock) or 0.50 (with retained rock melt) at 20 Saturn radii and nearly pure ice at 60 Saturn radii. Following three-dimensional trajectories over repeated passages through the pressure-supported gas gives ice fractions of about 0.4 near 20 Saturn radii and 0.9 near 60 Saturn radii. The matching Jupiter calculation yields a similar bulk ice enrichment, with a corresponding compositional gradient across the Galilean satellite region. These delivery profiles supply ice-enriched material for satellite formation. Yet satellitesimal inward migration subsequently modifies the material incorporated into satellites and thus alters their bulk compositions. We briefly discuss the implications for the PDS~70 planetary system.
2026-10-27.summary_zh: 本研究通过模拟微行星在气体盘中的轨迹演化和差异烧蚀过程，揭示了冰质和岩质碎片的选择性捕获机制如何解释木星和土星卫星系统的冰丰富特征。研究发现，不同粒度的外太阳系分化天体碎片在通过行星周盘时，由于烧蚀和碰撞过程的差异，可在不同轨道距离产生0.4-0.9的冰质量分数梯度分布，足以为Iapetus等冰富卫星提供充足的冰质物质。同时考虑卫星体小行星随后的向内迁移会进一步改变卫星的最终组成。

2026-10-27.title: High-resolution Modeling of Coronae and Winds in Solar-type Stars with Varying Rotation Rates. II. Stellar Winds
2026-10-27.abstract: Abstract Observations suggest a connection between steady-wind mass loss and coronal X-ray activity in low-mass main-sequence stars. Interpreting this connection is challenging because the wind is controlled mainly by the large-scale open field, whereas X-ray emission traces heating in small-scale closed fields often unresolved in global wind models. Here we use Space Weather Modeling Framework–Alfvén-Wave Solar Model with global convective dynamo-generated magnetic maps and solar magnetograms. We model Alfvén-wave-heated winds for four solar-type stars plus the Sun, spanning rotation rates of 1.0–23.3 times the solar rate, and magnetic field strengths of 6.0–1200 G. Our models show that faster rotation yields a more tightly wound spiral, a larger Alfvén surface, higher terminal wind speeds, and a harsher wind-pressure environment for orbiting exoplanets, different from that of the present-day Sun. We estimate the mass- and angular-momentum-loss rates and find systematic differences from Zeeman–Doppler imaging based predictions. Building on the successful reproduction of X-ray coronae in our Paper I, we obtain the first self-consistent activity–wind relation in a unified modeling framework: the mass-loss rate scales with the surface X-ray flux following a power law with an index of ∼0.67. We also reexamine magnetic braking via open-flux magnetization, finding that the effective Alfvénic lever arm depends on the magnetization parameter with a power-law index of ∼0.35. Finally, we quantify the stellar wind pressure at the orbits of several super-Earths. Together with our Paper I, the series of results shows the distinct roles of multiscale magnetic fields and provides physically grounded inputs for assessing habitable-zone space weather.
2026-10-27.summary_zh: 本研究利用全球对流动力学生成的磁场图和Alfvén波加热模型,对五颗不同自转速率(太阳速率的1.0-23.3倍)的太阳型恒星进行高分辨率风模型计算。研究发现恒星自转越快,螺旋磁场缠绕越紧,Alfvén表面越大,终端风速越高,对系外行星的风压环境更恶劣;质量损失率与表面X射线通量存在幂律关系(幂指数~0.67),提供了自洽的活动-风耦合关系。这些结果揭示了多尺度磁场在恒星风中的作用机制,为宜居区空间天气评估提供了物理约束。

2026-10-27.title: Frequent X-class Far-ultraviolet Flares from the Young Solar Analog DS Tucanae A
2026-10-27.abstract: Abstract The young solar analog DS Tuc A (∼45 million yr old, spectral type G6V) serves as an excellent proxy to the Sun during early stages of the Earth’s evolution. The young Sun’s enhanced magnetic activity in the form of X-ray and extreme UV emission, stellar wind, and flares likely affected the magnetospheric and atmospheric environments of early Venus, Earth, and Mars. Studies of DS Tuc A help constrain the evolution of the magnetospheric and atmospheric environments of early Venus, Earth, and Mars and create opportunities to study the impact of flares on the transiting exoplanet, DS Tuc A b. We analyze ∼11 hr of far-ultraviolet (FUV; 1130–1450 Å) observations taken by the Hubble Space Telescope Cosmic Origins Spectrograph during late 2023 and early 2024. We find that DS Tuc A exhibited 26 flares over ∼11.1 hr of observations in the transition region lines Si IV (1394 Å + 1402 Å), with durations ranging from 90 to 960 s and FUV absolute energies ranging from ∼10 29 to 10 31 erg over the observed bandpass. Si IV flares are accompanied by increases of other chromospheric and transition region lines; however, the strongest Si IV flares show no enhanced coronal emission traced by Fe XXI 1354 Å. We present an analysis of each detected flare, including X-ray and bolometric luminosities scaled from FUV flare energies, electron density measurements for the strongest flares, and the FUV continuum response to flaring. These results provide constraints on the frequency and energetics of flares comparable to X100-class solar flares and FUV-emitting regions in young solar analogs.
2026-10-27.summary_zh: 本研究通过哈勃空间望远镜对年轻太阳类星DS Tuc A进行约11小时的远紫外波段观测，发现该星在观测期间产生26次X级耀斑，耀斑能量达10²⁹-10³¹尔格，持续时间为90-960秒。研究详细分析了各耀斑的能谱特性、电子密度和X射线亮度等性质，为理解早期太阳对行星磁层和大气环境的影响提供了关键约束，同时为研究耀斑对绕行星DS Tuc A b的影响奠定了观测基础。

2026-10-27.title: JWST Reveals Refractory-rich Water Ice in Interstellar Comet 3I/ATLAS: Evidence for a Continuum of Grain Properties across Protoplanetary Disks
2026-10-27.abstract: Abstract We present JWST/NIRSpec PRISM observations of the interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS obtained on 2025 August 6 (Epoch 1), 2025 December 22 (Epoch 2), and 2026 April 1 (Epoch 3), spanning 8 months around perihelion at heliocentric distances of 3.3, 2.4, and 5.7 au, respectively. The spectra reveal a broad 3 μ m absorption band together with H 2 O, CO 2 , and CO gas emission. Unlike previously reported water-ice-rich solar system comae, the strong 3 μ m absorption is accompanied by weak or absent 1.5 and 2.0 μ m water-ice bands. Spectral modeling indicates that the observations are best reproduced by submicron- to micron-sized water-ice-bearing aggregates containing refractory material. Compared with Epoch 1, the Epoch 3 spectrum favors the presence of a second population of larger, micron-sized, ice-rich aggregates and exhibits a subtle Fresnel-like structure near 3.1 μ m, consistent with crystalline water ice. The observations can be explained by either crystalline water ice at both epochs, with the spectral evolution arising primarily from changes in grain size and refractory mixing, or an evolution from an amorphous-like to crystalline state. The spectral properties of 3I bridge those of water-ice-bearing solar system comae and several spectral classes of mid-sized trans-Neptunian objects. These similarities suggest that the icy building blocks of planetesimals formed in different protoplanetary disks may share a common continuum in the physical state of water ice, ranging from pure ice grains to water-ice-bearing aggregates with varying refractory content at submicron-to-micron scales, with the grains observed in 3I lying toward the refractory-rich end of this continuum.
2026-10-27.summary_zh: 本研究利用JWST/NIRSpec对星际彗星3I/ATLAS进行了8个月跨度的光谱观测,发现其水冰成分呈现出异于太阳系彗星的特征——强3μm吸收伴随弱的1.5和2.0μm水冰带,光谱建模表明这源于含有难熔物质的亚微米至微米级水冰聚集体。研究表明,不同原行星盘中形成的类地行星冰质构块中的水冰物理状态可能存在连续统一体,从纯冰颗粒到含不同难熔物质的水冰聚集体,而3I所观测的颗粒性质位于这一连续体中难熔物质较丰富的一端。

2026-10-27.title: Contribution of White Dwarf Formation Kicks to the Free-floating Planet Population
2026-10-27.abstract: Abstract Free-floating planets (FFPs) are a distinct class of exoplanets that do not orbit stars but are nevertheless found to be very common. A variety of formation mechanisms have been proposed as their origin, such as “starlike” direct collapse from gas and dust clouds or ejection from young planetary systems via dynamical instabilities. Here, another possible formation scenario is explored that would instead apply for old planetary systems, in the form of white dwarf (WD) formation kicks. Observations over recent years have shown that WDs experience a mild recoil kick during their formation from asymptotic giant branch (AGB) stars. Here we show that, while WD formation kicks directly unbind only ∼1% of the known planet and exoplanet population, they drive dynamical instabilities in ≳40% of known long-period multiplanet systems, likely leading to planet ejection and FFP generation by most WDs. We also show that FFPs generated via WD kicks will have undergone potentially significant and long-lasting heating via their host stars’ enhanced AGB luminosities. Given the low ejection velocities due to the weakness of the WD kicks, such warmed FFPs can thus be associated with their former host stars for several Myr after formation. Therefore, WD formation kicks contribute a distinct, observationally identifiable FFP subpopulation comprising a few percent of the Galaxy’s FFPs, relevant for the design of future FFP surveys.
2026-10-27.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了白矮星形成过程中的反冲速度作为自由浮动行星(FFPs)的一个重要形成机制。通过动力学模拟,我们发现虽然白矮星反冲直接解除仅约1%已知行星系统的束缚,但会在≳40%的长周期多行星系统中引发动力学不稳定性,导致大多数白矮星周围的行星被抛出形成FFPs。由于白矮星反冲速度较低,这些被抛出的FFPs在其前主星增强的AGB阶段获得加热,可在形成后数百万年内与前主星保持关联,构成一个具有独特观测特征的FFP亚群体,约占银河系FFPs的数个百分比。

2026-10-27.title: You Shall Not Pass (Without Modeling): High-resolution Analysis of KMT-2019-BLG-0253 using MORIA
2026-10-27.abstract: Abstract We present the Microlensing Object high-Resolution Imaging Analysis pipeline, or MORIA . This is an automated procedure to reduce high-resolution Hubble Space Telescope (HST) images of microlensing targets, build empirical point-spread function (PSF) models from the data, and perform simultaneous multistar PSF fitting to blended sources, lenses, and neighbor stars. We have developed and tested this pipeline using HST observations of the microlensing event KMT-2019-BLG-0253, which shows clear evidence of three highly blended stars in HST. Under our assumed source and lens identification, we determine a host mass of M host = 0.65 ± 0.04 M ⊙ . We have reduced the number of possible solutions for this target by a factor of 2, with the remaining solution subject to the well-known close/wide degeneracy. We determine a planet mass of m p = 7.18 ± 0.40 M ⊕ (close) or m p = 9.48 ± 1.13 M ⊕ (wide), and distance to the lens system of D L = 2.64 ± 0.22 kpc. This target lies within the upcoming Roman Telescope Galactic Bulge Time Domain Survey (GBTDS) field. Future analysis of the Roman data for this event can confirm or reject the initial source and lens identifications presented in this work. Finally, this work demonstrates the importance of using an automated high-resolution imaging tool to inform lightcurve modeling for microlensing planets found during the GBTDS.
2026-10-27.summary_zh: 本研究开发了MORIA管道，用于自动化处理哈勃太空望远镜高分辨率微引力透镜观测数据，通过多星点扩散函数拟合解决严重混光问题。应用于微引力透镜事件KMT-2019-BLG-0253，确定了主星质量(0.65±0.04 M☉)、行星质量(7.18±0.40 M⊕或9.48±1.13 M⊕)和透镜距离(2.64±0.22 kpc)，将可行解减少50%。该工作强调了高分辨率成像分析在罗曼太空望远镜银河系凸起巡天中微引力透镜行星研究中的关键作用。

2026-10-27.title: Propagation of a quasi-stationary zonal wavenumber-2 Rossby wave in Jupiter's stratosphere
2026-10-27.abstract: Atmospheric planetary waves redistribute energy and momentum and shape the large-scale circulation of giant-planet atmospheres. However, the three-dimensional structure and dynamical role of low-zonal-wavenumber waves on Jupiter remain poorly constrained. We investigate the structure, propagation, and possible dynamical influence of a low-zonal-wavenumber wave in Jupiter's upper troposphere and stratosphere, with a particular emphasis on its coupling to the quasi-quadrennial oscillation (QQO). We analysed four global temperature maps retrieved from Cassini Composite Infrared Spectrometer (CIRS) observations obtained during the 2000--2001 Jupiter flyby. The zonal wavenumber-2 temperature disturbance was isolated from the retrieved three-dimensional temperature field and diagnosed using vertical phase structure, refractive-index calculations, and Eliassen--Palm flux diagnostics. We identify a coherent zonal wavenumber-2 temperature disturbance in Jupiter's northern mid-latitudes that maintains a nearly fixed longitudinal phase over multiple observing epochs, indicating a quasi-stationary Rossby wave. Its vertical phase tilt demonstrates upward propagation, while refractive-index diagnostics show confinement within a favourable westerly waveguide. Eliassen--Palm flux diagnostics further show upward propagation followed by poleward refraction near the turning line associated with the easterly phase of the QQO. Regions of EP-flux convergence indicate momentum deposition into the background flow and suggest that the wave may in turn influence the evolution of the QQO. These results provide observational constraints on the dynamical coupling between planetary Rossby waves and Jupiter's QQO, with broader implications for understanding wave--mean-flow interactions in planetary atmospheres exhibiting quasi-periodic oscillations.
2026-10-27.summary_zh: 本研究通过分析卡西尼号CIRS观测数据，识别了木星平流层中的准静止纬向波数-2罗斯贝波，利用垂直相位结构、折射指数计算和Eliassen-Palm通量诊断方法分析其三维结构和传播特性。研究发现该波动在西风导管内向上传播，在准四年振荡(QQO)的东风相位附近发生极向折射，EP通量汇聚区表明波动向背景流输送动量，揭示了行星罗斯贝波与木星QQO之间的动力学耦合机制。这些观测约束对理解具有准周期振荡的行星大气中的波-平均流相互作用具有重要意义。

2026-10-27.title: A double debris disc around a white dwarf sculpted by two planetary bodies
2026-10-27.abstract: Abstract Many planetary systems survive the metamorphosis of their host stars into white dwarfs, as demonstrated by the detection of dusty circumstellar discs around these stellar remnants and chemical signatures of planetary debris in atmospheres of these stars. A small fraction of these circumstellar discs also contain gas, detected in the form of emission lines from various ionic transitions (most commonly the near-infrared Ca II triplet). All of the 21 known gas discs exhibit double-peaked line profiles characteristic of a rotating flat disc. The mechanism behind the generation of gas is still debated, but for at least one system it has been linked with the presence of a surviving planetesimal embedded within the dust disc. Here we report the discovery of WD J132800.85–145019.95, a new gas-disc system that exhibits quadruple-peaked instead of double-peaked line profiles. These emission lines originate from two separate gaseous rings extending from 0.14 R ⊙ to 0.34 R ⊙ and from 0.54 R ⊙ to 1.93 R ⊙ . We propose that this structure results from the presence of two distinct planetary bodies within these discs, ranging in size from a few kilometres to the size of Pluto. The detection this stable double-disc presents a new challenge for the current models of debris disc formation and evolution.
2026-10-27.summary_zh: 本研究发现了白矮星WD J132800.85–145019.95周围罕见的双气体碎屑盘系统,通过Ca II三重线的四峰发射线谱揭示了两个分离的气体环结构。研究表明这种双环构型由两个行星体(尺度从几公里到冥王星大小)分别嵌入其中的碎屑盘所产生,提供了行星在白矮星演化阶段幸存的直接证据。该稳定的双盘结构对现有碎屑盘形成与演化模型构成新的约束,为理解行星系统在宿主星演变中的动力学演化提供了重要案例。

2026-10-24.title: A Headwind-like Helium Outflow from TOI-3884b
2026-10-24.abstract: Constraining atmospheric loss is crucial for understanding the evolution of planetary atmospheres. We report the detection of an evaporating exosphere from TOI-3884b, a super-Neptune in a polar orbit around an M4 dwarf star. We infer this evaporation from a 6.8$\pm$0.27\% excess transit depth in the He I 10830 Å\, line, observed during five transits of TOI-3884b with the Habitable Zone Planet Finder spectrometer. While we observe outflow signatures starting as early as 5 hours before the onset of the planet's optical transit, no significant post-transit tail is detected. Hitherto, such a pre-transit headwind without a significant post-transit tail has only been detected from HAT-P-67b, a hot Saturn orbiting an F-type star. This asymmetric outflow morphology supports irradiation-driven mass loss over core-heated mass loss, and we explore whether this could be caused by sub-Alfvén star-planet interaction. The detection of such complex outflow morphologies is now opening a new window, enabling us to test theories of star-planet interactions and planetary magnetic fields with observations.
2026-10-24.summary_zh: 本研究通过Habitable Zone Planet Finder分光仪对超海王星TOI-3884b进行五次过境观测,在He I 10830 Å谱线检测到6.8±0.27%的过量过境深度,从而探测了其蒸发外层大气。研究发现该行星表现出独特的非对称外流形态——过境前5小时即出现外流信号但过境后几乎无尾流,这种"逆风"现象仅在热土星HAT-P-67b上被观测到。该外流形态支持辐照驱动质量损失机制,可能源于亚Alfvén星-行星相互作用,为利用大气外流观测约束行星磁场和星-行星相互作用理论提供了新途径。

2026-10-24.title: The first selection of optimal targets for the Lazuli ExtraSolar Coronagraph's reflected starlight exoplanet campaign
2026-10-24.abstract: Direct detection and characterization of exoplanet atmospheres via reflected starlight enables probes of composition of mature exoplanet systems (since flux is decoupled from age) at closer separations than via thermal emission (due to observations in visible wavelengths), and even probes of biosignatures. New and upcoming ground and space-based platforms are enabling these observations for the first time. Recently the 3-m Lazuli Space Telescope, from the Eric and Wendy Schmidt Observatory System, was announced, which will be equipped with the ExtraSolar Coronagraph (ESC) designed for reflected light gas giant exoplanet observations in visible wavelengths. In this paper we present 27 known giant exoplanets that make up the first target list for these observations. Our target list spans ages and temperatures of planets not probed before by direct imaging, but some of which will also be accessible to the \textsl{Nancy Grace Roman} Coronagraph instrument and the ELT-METIS thermal imager, providing comprehensive atmosphere characterization and synergies. We discuss the science enabled by ESC observations of our target list and enhancements provided by future astrometric and radial velocity measurements.
2026-10-24.summary_zh: 本研究为即将开展的Lazuli太空望远镜ExtraSolar日冕仪反射星光系外行星观测任务筛选了27个已知巨行星作为首批目标，这些目标覆盖了前所未有的行星年龄和温度范围。该目标列表通过可见光直接成像探测系外行星大气成分，与Roman日冕仪和ELT-METIS热成像形成协同观测体系，并讨论了未来天体测量和径向速度测量对大气表征的增强作用。

2026-10-24.title: HD 152384: A 5-megayear-old debris disk system showing a gaseous ring of refractory elements at the dust sublimation radius
2026-10-24.abstract: Circumstellar gas around young stars provides key insights into planet formation and disk evolution. HD,152384, a young (5 Myr) A0,V star in Sco-Cen, exhibits hybrid disk characteristics with a modest infrared excess due to small dust grains and atomic emission lines dominated by refractory elements, but the disk's structure and origin remain unclear. We aim to characterise the kinematics and excitation of the circumstellar gas around HD,152384, and to constrain the physical properties of the emitting region. We used new optical and near-infrared high spectral resolution data from the Ultraviolet and Visual Echelle Spectrograph (UVES) and CRyogenic high-resolution InfraRed Echelle Spectrograph (CRIRES) instruments at the Very Large Telescope to revisit the circumstellar environment of HD,152384. Earlier studies suggested the presence of a broad, gas-rich circumstellar disk; here, we re-examine this scenario. -1 $ peak separation. Modelling of gas in Keplerian rotation indicates that the gas is confined to a geometrically thin ring at a radial distance of 0.09--0.12 au from the central star, close to the dust sublimation radius (0.10--0.14 au, assuming a dust sublimation temperature of ∼1500 K). The detected Fe, i emission comes from an optically thick region. However, the Mg, i lines are optically thin, allowing us to derive a mass of 2.2 times 10^22 kg (or 3.6 times 10^-3 M$_⊕) in magnesium gas confined to the geometrically thin ring. The inferred mass and composition of circumstellar dust and gas in the HD,152384 system are consistent with a secondary origin related to rocky planetesimal collisions. We suggest that the atomic gas seen in our observations is due to the sublimation of small dust grains created in such collisions, spiralling inwards to the dust sublimation radius, creating an accumulation of atomic gas at this location. We conclude that HD,152384 represents a young analogue of gas-bearing debris disk systems such as β Pictoris and of the gaseous debris disks around metal-polluted white dwarfs (in which a similar phenomenology is observed), offering a new window into the early violent phase of rocky planetesimal processing.
2026-10-24.summary_zh: 本研究通过UVES和CRIRES高分辨光谱观测5百万年龄的年轻A星HD 152384的周围气体,发现难熔元素气体被限制在距星0.09-0.12 AU的几何薄环中,该位置对应尘埃升华半径。通过建模Keplerian旋转气体并测量Mg I的光学薄谱线,推导出环中含有3.6×10⁻³地球质量的镁气体,其成分和质量与岩质微行星碰撞产生的次生起源一致。研究结论表明HD 152384是β Pic型气体碎屑盘的年轻类似体,为理解岩质微行星碰撞过程中气体和尘埃的早期演化提供了新的观测窗口。

2026-10-23.title: Searching for substellar companion candidates with Gaia. V. M dwarfs within 15 pc studied with absolute astrometry, radial velocities, and direct imaging
2026-10-23.abstract: In this work, we survey M-type stars within 15 pc observed by Gaia based on their colour, magnitude, and quality of astrometric data. We aim to detect new substellar companions using primarily Gaia astrometry and, when available, proper-motion anomaly (PMa) along with radial velocity (RV) and direct imaging (DI) data. We used the GaiaPMEX tool to search for bound companions around 582 M dwarfs. We identified all previously known stellar and planetary companions that were consistent with the Gaia excess signal. Then for all newly identified companions, we computed detection limits in the (mass, semi-major axis) parameter space using archival RV and DI data, to possibly rule out the presence of a stellar companion. The joint analysis of the parameter space allowed by astrometry and constrained by RV and DI provides tight constraints on the nature of the companion. We found 156 M dwarfs to have a bound companion within the Gaia sensitivity domain. The astrometric signals of 37 and seven of them are due to known stellar and substellar companions, respectively. We report 35 new substellar companions among which at least ten giant planets orbiting between 0.2 au and 2 au, with masses close to 1 M_Jup. We also report 77 substellar candidates, and provide detection limits using astrometry+RV+DI for 50 stars with known exoplanets and no significant Gaia excess noise. This work reveals a significant population of new substellar companions to M-type stars, challenging core accretion models. These results will be crucial inputs for estimating occurrence rates and studying the architecture of planetary systems around M dwarfs. Some new companions presented here, located beyond the water ice line, are prime targets for DI or coronagraphy observations with JWST or ELT.
2026-10-23.summary_zh: 本研究通过盖亚绝对天体测量、径向速度和直接成像联合分析,对15 pc内582颗M型矮星进行了系统巡天,利用自行异常信号和多波段数据约束搜索亚恒星伴星。研究确认了37颗已知恒星伴星和7颗已知亚恒星伴星,新发现35颗亚恒星伴星(其中至少10颗木星质量行星轨道在0.2-2 au)和77颗伴星候选体,显著扩展了M型矮星周围行星系统的已知种群。这些结果对理解行星形成机制、估算行星发生率以及研究M型矮星周围系统的构型具有重要意义。

2026-10-23.title: Uncertainty estimation of incoming comet trajectories with a thermophysical non-gravitational force model for Comet Interceptor encounter planning
2026-10-23.abstract: The European Space Agency Comet Interceptor mission is designed to fly-by an as-yet undetermined incoming long-period or dynamically-new comet, which will require an accurate prediction of its trajectory. Cometary orbits are perturbed from purely gravitational trajectories by non-gravitational accelerations (NGAs) stemming from their outgassing, however, and these must be taken into account in the navigation. We here test the ability of ground-based astrometry and standard NGA-fitting techniques to predict the position and velocity of incoming comets perturbed by a Monte Carlo sampled thermophysical acceleration model. We find that, due to the difficulties of predicting NGA evolution as well as the limitations of reasonably simulated astrometry, predicted accuracies are unlikely to meet the mission goals of 1000 km and 1 m s$^{-1}$ in position and velocity, sixty days before intercept. We instead recommend expanded uncertainties of $10,000$ km and several m s$^{-1}$. Our NGA fits struggle to reproduce the reference accelerations and trajectories when outgassing is rising steeply at a few AU-incoming, but with more observations up until perihelion, do eventually converge, leading to good estimates of many of the underlying acceleration parameters even for half an orbital arc.
2026-10-23.summary_zh: 本研究通过蒙特卡罗采样的热物理非引力加速度模型，测试了地基天体测量和标准非引力加速度拟合技术在预测受彗星放气扰动的近日彗星轨迹中的能力。研究发现，由于非引力加速度演化难以预测且天体测量观测存在限制，现有方法难以满足Comet Interceptor任务在撞击前60天内位置和速度精度分别达到1000 km和1 m/s的要求。建议将轨迹不确定度扩大至10,000 km和数个m/s，同时指出更多观测数据（特别是近日点附近的观测）能显著改善非引力加速度参数的反演精度。

2026-10-23.title: Astrometric detection of rocky exoplanets from inexpensive space platforms
2026-10-23.abstract: The detection of orbiting exoplanets by way of astrometric monitoring of the host star to reveal gravitationally induced reflex motion requires extreme precision and measurement stability when targeting Earth-mass objects. Despite this, astrometry is widely regarded as the most promising avenue for the most desired of all targets: true Earth analogue systems in the solar neighbourhood. Formerly thought to require flagship class investment, recently several smaller concepts such as the TOLIMAN and SHERA missions have shown that detections are possible, at least in principle, from more modest space platforms. A key enabling feature is that these missions exploit narrow-angle astrometry. Observing only multiple star systems where the target provides its own astrometric reference greatly alleviates the challenges confronted by traditional astrometry with its reliance on distant, faint field stars. This principle underlies the TOLIMAN mission, for which progress and status is reported. However, only a tiny handful of nearby star systems are suited to such a TOLIMAN-like architecture. This paper discusses speculative optical concepts featuring ultra-stable telescopes of modest (<0.5m) aperture designed for astrometric monitoring of isolated single stars at the micro-arcsecond scales required for the discovery of Earth mass objects orbiting sun-like stars in temperate orbits. In simulation, highly sought-after neighbourhood systems such as Epsilon Eridani and Tau Ceti can be exhaustively searched for rocky planets with dedicated observing campaigns spanning several years, all from relatively inexpensive orbital platforms.
2026-10-23.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了利用低成本空间平台通过星体位置测量法(窄角测量)检测类地系外行星的可行性,针对邻近恒星系统的微角秒级精度测量需求。研究采用模拟方法,对TOLIMAN等小型任务架构进行评估,并提出了搭载超稳定小孔径望远镜(<0.5m)的光学概念设计。结果表明,在数年的专项观测中,即使使用相对廉价的轨道平台,也能够有效搜索Epsilon Eridani和Tau Ceti等邻近恒星周围宜居轨道上的类地行星。

2026-10-23.title: Detection of Solar-like Oscillations and Granulation at Infrared Wavelengths using JWST
2026-10-23.abstract: Stellar oscillations and granulation are key probes of stellar convection, one of the most poorly understood processes in stars. Stellar models predict strong wavelength dependence of the amplitudes of oscillations and granulation, but hitherto both processes have only been measured at optical wavelengths. Here we present the first detection of oscillations and granulation at infrared wavelengths, using JWST time-series observations of the F6V main-sequence star WASP-121 that were obtained to study the atmosphere of an exoplanet. We find that the amplitudes of oscillations and granulation decrease with wavelength, consistent with expectations, but with a functional form that deviates from simple blackbody scaling. The detection opens the door to detailed tests of 3D convection models, facilitates the combined modeling of stellar and exoplanet signals in JWST passbands for exoplanet observations, and supports the predicted asteroseismic yields from the infrared time-domain data that will soon be obtained by the Roman Space Telescope.
2026-10-23.summary_zh: 本研究利用JWST对主序星WASP-121的红外时间序列观测,首次在红外波段探测到恒星振荡和肉眼可见的太阳粒状结构,发现这两种现象的振幅随波长减小且偏离简单黑体辐射标度。该工作为三维对流模型提供了精确约束,改进了JWST系外行星大气观测中恒星和行星信号的联合建模方法,并为Roman太空望远镜的红外测时观测提供了小行星震学预测支持。

2026-10-23.title: Deep-Learning Identification and Global Characterization of Energetic O2+ Beams at Mars
2026-10-23.abstract: Martian ionospheric ions can be accelerated away from Mars by the solar wind, contributing substantially to atmospheric ion escape. Here, we develop a U-Net-based image segmentation model to identify a distinct population of escaping planetary ions, energetic O2+ beams, from a decade of Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN (MAVEN) observations and perform an event-based statistical analysis of their global properties and dependence on external conditions. We find that O2+ beams are widely distributed throughout the Martian plasma environment, with a strong preference for the +E hemisphere, where the solar wind convective electric field points away from Mars. This pronounced spatial asymmetry indicates that the convective electric field plays a major role in beam formation. In the solar wind and magnetosheath, these beams are consistent with the plume. Their occurrence-weighted flux agrees with previous long-term plume estimates, whereas the flux during identified beam intervals is substantially higher. This highlights the advantage of our event-based approach in capturing the intrinsic properties of O2+ plumes. In the induced magnetotail, beam formation remains strongly associated with the convective electric field, while the Hall electric field can provide additional energization. The beam properties are primarily controlled by upstream solar wind conditions, with no apparent influence from solar extreme ultraviolet irradiance. These results might improve our understanding of ion escape at Mars. More broadly, we also demonstrate the potential of deep learning for identifying transient plasma populations from spacecraft observations.
2026-10-23.summary_zh: 本研究利用U-Net深度学习模型从MAVEN十年观测数据中识别火星高能O2+离子束，通过事件统计分析揭示其全球分布特征和环境依赖性。研究发现O2+束主要分布在+E半球，其形成和能量化主要由太阳风对流电场和霍尔电场控制，与上游太阳风条件密切相关，而与太阳极紫外辐照无关。该研究不仅有助于理解火星离子逃逸过程，还展示了深度学习在识别航天器观测中瞬变等离子体群的潜力。

2026-10-23.title: Ellipsoidal Modeling Framework for TNOs: the triaxial shape of (50000) Quaoar and its implications for Weywot and the dynamical environment
2026-10-23.abstract: The three-dimensional shapes of Trans-Neptunian Objects (TNOs) are notoriously difficult to determine due to their slow orbital motion and minimal variations in aspect angle over human timescales. To overcome this geometric degeneracy, we developed a versatile modeling framework capable of deriving ellipsoidal shapes by simultaneously combining stellar occultations and rotational light curves, including parameterizations of localized surface albedo. We applied this methodology to the large TNO (50000) Quaoar, jointly modeling 37 stellar occultation events and two photometric datasets. Our MCMC analysis demonstrates that Quaoar is best represented by a triaxial shape with equatorial semi-axes $a = 620.7^{+3.3}_{-2.8}$ km and $b = 546.5^{+6.0}_{-5.6}$ km, and a polar semi-axis $c = 511.5^{+5.3}_{-5.5}$ km, yielding a bulk density of $1.663 \pm 0.127$ g cm$^{-3}$. By isolating Quaoar's barycentric motion from the astrometric offsets, we determined the mass of its satellite, Weywot, to be $(1.485 \pm 0.360) \times 10^{18}$ kg, corresponding to a system mass ratio of $q = 0.0012 \pm 0.0003$ and a satellite bulk density of $0.95 \pm 0.60$ g cm$^{-3}$. Furthermore, dynamical simulations using the derived triaxial gravitational field reveal that potential additional satellites can only maintain stable orbits beyond 2.4 Quaoar radii, as inner bodies would be strongly perturbed. Regarding the ring system, particles at the location of the secondary ring (Q2R) location exhibit libration associated with the 5:7 spin-orbit resonance (SOR). Similarly, particles at the location of the main ring (Q1R) location show libration of the 2:6 SOR angle for orbital eccentricities larger than 0.2, providing a plausible mechanism for the azimuthal width variations observed in Q1R.
2026-10-23.summary_zh: 本研究通过联合恒星掩食事件和旋转光变曲线数据，开发了一套通用的椭球体建模框架，克服了TNO三维形状测定的几何简并问题。我们将该方法应用于大型TNO Quaoar，确定其为三轴椭球体(a=620.7 km, b=546.5 km, c=511.5 km)，体密度为1.663 g cm⁻³，并进而精确测定其卫星Weywot的质量和密度。动力学模拟表明Quaoar的三轴引力场严格限制了潜在卫星的稳定轨道范围，同时揭示了其环系统中的自旋-轨道共振机制对环结构的调控作用。

2026-10-23.title: The Pandora SmallSat: post-launch operations and mission update
2026-10-23.abstract: The Pandora SmallSat is a NASA flight project designed to study the atmospheres of exoplanets. Transmission spectroscopy of transiting exoplanets provides our best opportunity to identify the makeup of planetary atmospheres in the coming decade, and is a key science driver for HST and JWST. Stellar photospheric inhomogeneity due to star spots, however, has been shown to contaminate the observed spectra in these high-precision measurements. Pandora will address the problem of stellar contamination by collecting long-duration photometric observations sampled over a stellar rotation period with a visible-light channel and simultaneous spectra with a near-IR channel. These simultaneous multiwavelength observations will constrain star spot covering fractions of exoplanet host stars, enabling star and planet signals to be disentangled in transmission spectra to then reliably determine exoplanet atmosphere compositions. Pandora will observe exoplanets with sizes ranging from Earth-size to Jupiter-size and host stars spanning mid-K to late-M spectral types. Pandora was selected in early 2021 as part of NASA's inaugural Astrophysics Pioneers Program. Herein, we present an overview of the mission, including the science objectives, operations, the observatory, science planning, and upcoming milestones as we prepare for launch readiness in 2025.
2026-10-23.summary_zh: Pandora SmallSat通过在可见光和近红外波段同时进行长期测光观测,以约束系外行星宿主星的星斑覆盖率,从而解决恒星光球不均一性对凌星光谱的污染问题。该方法使研究人员能够将恒星信号与行星信号解耦,可靠地确定系外行星大气成分。该任务计划于2025年发射,将观测Earth到Jupiter尺度的系外行星及其K到M型宿主星,为未来十年的系外行星大气探测奠定基础。

2026-10-23.title: OGLE-2012-BLG-0563: Relative Proper Motion Constraint from Keck Follow-up finds the correct Lens
2026-10-23.abstract: We present Keck/NIRC2 adaptive optics imaging results of planetary microlensing event OGLE-2012-BLG-0563. We find that the OGLE-2012-BLG-0563L planetary system consists of a 1.12 +/- 0.09 Jupiter-mass planet orbiting a 0.81 +/- 0.04 solar-mass host star at a distance of 5.49 +/- 0.56 kpc from the Sun. This event has a lens-source separation of 23.28 +/- 0.48 mas, which is the smallest lens-source separation measured to date with Keck AO data. We find that the incorrect solution - which identifies the Northeast (NE) star as the source star - is favored if one only considers the discovery paper, the Fukui et al. (2015) solution, or an unconstrained model. However, by performing an image-constrained light curve model fit using the relative proper motion direction constraint from the Keck follow-up data, we demonstrate that the correct solution identifies the NE star as the lens star. The discrepancy in the unconstrained models is driven by systematics in the FTS and MOA B & C data, alongside the impact of the relative proper motion direction constraints. This outcome offers two important lessons for future Roman data analysis: (1) thoroughly verify systematics across all passbands and identify the precise origin of chi-squared differences, and (2) utilize image-constrained light curve modeling incorporating relative proper motion direction constraints to identify the correct lens.
2026-10-23.summary_zh: 本研究通过Keck自适应光学成像观测微引力透镜事件OGLE-2012-BLG-0563，利用相对自行方向约束条件进行图像约束的光曲线模型拟合，确定了该行星系统的正确透镜星身份。研究发现该系统由质量约1.12倍木星质量的行星围绕0.81倍太阳质量的主星公转，距离太阳5.49 kpc，透镜-源分离为23.28 mas，这是Keck AO观测中最小的分离。研究揭示了多波段数据中的系统误差对光曲线模型的影响，强调了在未来罗曼望远镜数据分析中需要充分验证系统误差并结合相对自行约束来识别正确的引力透镜。

2026-10-23.title: The coupled impacts of atmospheric dynamics and cloud microphysics on hot Jupiter atmospheres. I. An application to WASP-43b
2026-10-23.abstract: Understanding the influence of cloud-circulation feedback on planetary climates is crucial to interpreting solar system and extrasolar planet observations. Hot Jupiter phase curve observations have reported westward optical phase curve offsets and weak absorption features, which may be explained by the presence of clouds. JWST observations have also revealed tentative silicate cloud absorption features in emission and transmission spectroscopy. While a number of 3D atmospheric dynamics models of hot Jupiters and microphysical models describing cloud formation exist, few combine these two approaches. To help elucidate the impact of clouds on hot Jupiters, we introduce a post-processing scheme with the 3D GCM ADAM with SPARC (formerly SPARC/MITgcm), the 1D microphysical cloud model CARMA, and the radiative transfer code PICASO. We first simulate the cloud-free atmosphere of WASP-43b with ADAM, then incorporate resulting thermal profiles into CARMA to simulate WASP-43b's cloud structure, and finally generate phase-dependent emission spectra from our results with PICASO. By comparing to JWST observations, we infer that WASP-43b has a cloudy nightside, a mostly clear morning and evening limb with patchy clouds, and a clear dayside at the level of the photosphere. Our microphysical model predicts the condensation of five cloud species, including silicates, but overestimates the cloud opacity at all phases compared to observations, requiring additional modeling to explain. The results from this post-processing setup are promising for more meaningful characterization of WASP-43b's atmosphere, and will serve as a comparison baseline for our upcoming indirect coupling of both models, as well as for other future studies.
2026-10-23.summary_zh: 本研究结合三维大气动力学模型ADAM、微物理云模型CARMA和辐射传输代码PICASO，系统研究了云-环流反馈对热木星WASP-43b大气的耦合影响。通过后处理方案模拟大气热结构和云的形成，结果表明WASP-43b具有多层云结构特征：夜侧多云、晨昏跛行云覆盖、日侧清晰，预测包括硅酸盐在内的五种云物种凝结，但云不透明度仍存在高估问题。该研究为理解云对热木星相位曲线和光谱特征的影响提供了定量框架，为JWST观测的解释和后续完全耦合模型的发展奠定了基础。

2026-10-23.title: The Pandora SmallSat: Target Selection and Early Science
2026-10-23.abstract: The Pandora spacecraft is a smallsat selected in NASA's inaugural class of Pioneers missions. The aim of the Pandora mission is to disentangle stellar activity signals from exoplanet atmospheric transmission spectroscopy measurements. Pandora accomplishes this goal with its combined visible photometry and NIR spectroscopy that observe each target in the prime mission for 10 separate transit observations, each spanning 24 hours at a time. Targets were carefully selected for the Pandora prime mission. Pandora is specifically studying planets around low-mass stellar hosts (K and M dwarf stars) spanning a range of rotation periods and activity levels. The planets range in size from 1.5 - 15 Earth radii and orbital periods ranging from 1.7 - 11.5 days. In addition to the 10 transit visits planned for each of the 20 prime mission targets, Pandora is observing a number of auxiliary targets encompassing a variety of science topics. This includes topics such as stellar activity and young systems, transit timing variations of exoplanets, brown dwarf compositions, exoplanet phase curves, etc. We will discuss the selection of these targets, how they have been scheduled to fill in gaps in prime mission operations, and early science results. If the mission is extended, there is further opportunity for accomplishing additional science. Here we will discuss the possible options for extended mission operations and science.
2026-10-23.summary_zh: Pandora小卫星任务旨在通过结合可见光测光和近红外光谱学,在系外行星大气透射光谱测量中分离恒星活动信号,对围绕低质量恒星(K和M矮星)的行星进行10次凌日观测。该研究精心选择了20个主要目标,这些目标的行星大小范围为1.5-15地球半径,轨道周期为1.7-11.5天,并辅以多个辅助目标观测恒星活动、凌日时间变化和系外行星相位曲线等科学问题。本文讨论了目标选择策略、观测调度方案以及早期科学成果,并探讨了任务延期情景下的进一步科学机遇。

2026-10-23.title: OGLE-2013-BLG-1125/MOA-2013-BLG-584: Discovery of a gas giant orbiting an M dwarf
2026-10-23.abstract: We report the discovery and characterization of a planetary system in the microlensing event OGLE-2013-BLG-1125/MOA-2013-BLG-584. We analyze photometric data from OGLE and MOA surveys, as well as LCO, $μ$FUN, and Mindstep follow-up telescopes to model the microlensing light curve. We also used data from the Keck II telescope collected in 2018 to obtain additional constraints on the lensing system. We found a Saturn-mass planet of mass $M_{\rm p}=105\pm13 \ M_\oplus$ orbiting a low-mass host star $M_{\rm L}=0.139\pm0.011 \ M_\odot$ at $1.00\pm0.08$ kpc from Earth. This discovery adds to the small sample of giant planets orbiting low-mass stars and provides constraints on planet formation theories.
2026-10-23.summary_zh: 本研究通过分析OGLE-2013-BLG-1125/MOA-2013-BLG-584微引力透镜事件的多望远镜测光数据，采用微引力透镜光变曲线建模方法，发现了一个质量为105±13地球质量的土星质量行星绕低质量M矮星(质量0.139±0.011太阳质量)运行。该发现为数量稀少的低质量恒星周围巨行星样本增添了新成员，有助于约束行星形成理论。

2026-10-23.title: Searching for Planets around Altair with JWST/NIRcam
2026-10-23.abstract: Abstract Altair ( α Aql) is one of the nearest stars to the Sun at 5.13 pc and its age has recently been revised to 88 ± 10 Myr, making it one of the youngest stars in the solar neighborhood. This makes Altair a compelling target for high-contrast direct imaging searches for giant planets. We present two epochs of simultaneous F444W and F200W MASK430R JWST/NIRCam coronagraphic imaging observations. After postprocessing, these data achieve F444W contrast levels of 2 × 10 −6 at 1″ (5.1 au), 1.5 × 10 −7 at 2″ (10.3 au), and a few ×10 −8 beyond 4″(20 au). Using the Sonora Flame Skimmer models, this corresponds to sub-Jupiter mass sensitivity beyond 5 au and sub-Saturn mass sensitivity beyond 10 au. We identified several candidate point sources in the field in the first epoch data. Second epoch observations confirmed that none of the candidates were co-moving with Altair and their colors are consistent with background stars. Altair has no known companions, no detected debris disk, and is not associated with any stellar association. Despite this, its youth and proximity ensure it will remain a high-priority target for future high-contrast imaging observations. We additionally discuss Altair as a potential reference star for future observations, presenting measurements of background sources in the field and showing that Altair will remain at least a few arcsec from background stars over the next 10–20 yr, making it a reliable reference target for upcoming imaging campaigns including the Roman Space Telescope Coronagraph Instrument.
2026-10-23.summary_zh: 本研究使用JWST/NIRCam对年轻邻近星Altair进行了两个历元的高对比度直接成像观测,在5-20 AU范围内达到亚木星至亚土星质量的灵敏度。通过多波段冠状图像处理和二次历元验证,排除了所有候选点源为伴星的可能性,确认Altair周围不存在行星伴星。尽管未发现行星,但Altair的年轻年龄(88±10 Myr)和近距离使其成为未来高对比度成像巡天的优先靶标,同时其稳定的背景恒星配置使其可用作未来空间望远镜观测的参考星。

2026-10-23.title: Demographics of Close-In TESS Exoplanets Orbiting FGK Main-sequence Stars – II. Spectral-Type Dependence and the Neptunian Landscape
2026-10-23.abstract: Abstract Understanding how planetary demographics depend on host star properties is essential for constraining planet formation and evolution theories. In this paper, we analyse close-in (0.5–16 d) planet occurrence rates from the TESS Science Processing Operations Center (SPOC) full-frame image data for individual F-, G-, and K-type main-sequence stellar samples. Integrated over 0.5 < P < 16 d and 2 < Rp < 20 R⊕, the occurrence rates are $12.1^{+3.0}_{-2.3}$, $10.2^{+1.2}_{-1.0}$, and $13.1^{+1.4}_{-1.2}$ planets per 100 stars for F-, G-, and K-type hosts, consistent with each other at 1σ, so any spectral-type dependence is localized rather than global. For transiting hot Jupiters, we measure $0.30^{+0.04}_{-0.03}$, 0.50 ± 0.03, and $0.67^{+0.08}_{-0.07}$ per cent, with the rate peaking at K type; the latter being the first such measurement for K-type hosts. Modelling the Neptunian desert directly in occurrence-rate space, we find that the desert extends to longer orbital periods around hotter stars. Integrating over the desert interior gives $0.069^{+0.045}_{-0.011}$, $0.093^{+0.046}_{-0.022}$, and $0.150^{+0.033}_{-0.026}$ planets per 100 stars, implying about one close-in planet in a hundred lies inside the desert, and the desert is roughly twice as populated around K- as around F-type hosts. A rigorous Bayesian model comparison for the 6–8 R⊕ strip indicates that a distinct Neptunian ridge is not required to explain the measurements.
2026-10-23.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-10-23.summary_zh: 本研究基于TESS数据分析了环绕F、G、K型主序星的近距离行星（0.5–16天轨道周期）的出现率，发现不同谱型主星间的整体行星出现率相近（~10–13颗/百星），但热木星出现率随谱型变化明显（F型0.3%、G型0.5%、K型0.67%）。通过直接在出现率空间中建模海王星沙漠，发现该沙漠在较热的主星周围延伸到更长轨道周期，且K型主星周围的沙漠内行星数量约为F型的两倍，贝叶斯模型比较表明无需引入独立的海王星脊来解释观测数据。这些结果为行星形成和演化理论提供了关键的谱型依赖性约束。

2026-10-22.title: Radio and high-energy variable emission from a multi-wavelength follow-up of the infant planet-hosting star V1298 Tau
2026-10-22.abstract: V1298 Tau is a very young and magnetically active K1V star which hosts a benchmark multi-planetary system to study planet formation and evolutionary history at the earliest stages. Between 2025 and 2026, we conducted a campaign to monitor the variability of V1298 Tau in radio (band C), X-ray, and NUV bands, with the support of publicly available contemporary optical light curve, and to investigate multi-band correlations to link the emission with stellar activity. Radio observations were carried out with the Karl G. Jansky Very Large Array (JVLA) in band C (4.5--6.5 GHz). X-ray and NUV observations were carried out with the Swift satellite over 20 days, ending one month before the begin of the radio campaign. We analysed the temporal variability of peak (integrated) fluxes in the C-band and of X-ray (NUV) luminosities on various timescales, comparing it with the variability observed in the high-cadence optical light curve collected by the ASAS-SN survey. We observed both radio and high-energy time variable emission. JVLA detected emission in 90\% of the visits, switching between high ($\geq$0.1 mJy/beam) and low flux states in matter of days or hours. The fluxes show moderate correlation with the optical light curve, suggesting modulation with the stellar rotation period. Except for one visit, dynamic spectral analysis does not reveal short-term (minutes) variability, nor is there any evidence of circularly polarised emissions. Overall, the radio observations can be explained as gyrosynchrotron and/or cyclotron emission from the corona, and linked to stellar magnetic activity. At high-energy, we detected significant variability in X-ray luminosity (within the range ~1.2--2.5x10$^{+30}$ erg/s), the decay phase of a stellar flare, and evidence of correlation with the optical flux. Our data confirm that V1298\,Tau follows the near-linear Güdel-Benz relation.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究对年轻多行星宿主星V1298 Tau进行了2025-2026年期间的多波段监测活动，采用JVLA射电观测、Swift卫星X射线/紫外观测和光学数据，系统研究其射电和高能变时性与恒星磁活动的关联。观测结果表明V1298 Tau的射电和X射线均呈现明显时间变化，射电通量在数小时至数天尺度内在高低态间切换，与恒星自转周期调制的光学曲线中等相关；X射线光度变化显著，证实该源遵循Güdel-Benz关系，整体辐射可由日冕的回旋加速和回旋辐射解释。

2026-10-22.title: White dwarf pollution in wide binaries I: the effects of stellar evolution
2026-10-22.abstract: Context. Atmospheric pollution in white dwarfs is interpreted as evidence for the accretion of rocky material from remnant planetary systems. Wide binary companions can influence the delivery of planetary material onto white dwarfs, making it essential to understand the interplay between stellar evolution and binary perturbations. Aims. We investigate how uncertainties in stellar mass-loss histories affect the dynamical evolution of remnant planetary systems in wide binaries, and assess their relative importance compared with binary perturbations in driving the accretion of rocky material onto white dwarfs. Methods. We perform REBOUND N-body simulations incorporating time-dependent stellar parameters interpolated from MESA evolutionary tracks and tidal interactions, following the dynamical evolution up to the white dwarf stage. We explore two stellar-evolution models with distinct mass-loss histories for wide binary systems hosting a Jupiter-mass planet and a planetesimal disc, spanning a range of binary architectures. Results. The adopted stellar-evolution model has only a minor effect on the survival of the planet, mainly affecting the timing and efficiency of planetesimal delivery during the white dwarf stage. Instead, the architecture of the binary primarily controls the pollution outcome: wider binaries produce the highest rates of accretion onto the white dwarf, consistent with the observed prevalence of polluted white dwarfs in wide binaries. Moreover, planetesimal reservoirs remain long-lived, with survival times increasing with binary separation, enabling Gyr-long metal pollution. Conclusions. Our results suggest that the architecture of wide binaries, rather than uncertainties in stellar evolution, is the dominant factor controlling the dynamical delivery of rocky material onto white dwarfs.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究通过REBOUND N体模拟探讨了宽双星系统中恒星演化不确定性对残存行星系统动力学演化的影响，采用MESA演化轨迹和潮汐作用模型追踪从主序星到白矮星阶段的演化过程。研究表明，恒星演化模型对行星存活率影响较小，而双星构型是控制岩质物质吸积效率的主导因素，更宽的双星分离能产生更高的吸积速率并维持行星碎片长期存在。结论是双星构型而非恒星演化不确定性是控制岩质物质动力学输运到白矮星的主要因素。

2026-10-22.title: Systematic Uncertainties in Rocky Exoplanet Reflected Light from Incomplete Laboratory BRDF Measurements
2026-10-22.abstract: The first observations of short-period rocky exoplanets have initiated the era of terrestrial exoplanet characterization. The interpretation of these observations relies on forward models used in atmospheric and surface retrieval frameworks. While atmospheric modeling is supported by extensive laboratory datasets of molecular opacities, the experimental basis for rocky surface characterization remains limited. Most reflectance libraries of planetary analog materials provide spectra measured at a single illumination and viewing geometry, constraining the spectral behavior but not its full angular scattering properties. We show that incomplete angular coverage in laboratory bidirectional reflectance measurements introduces an intrinsic systematic uncertainty in the interpretation of rocky exoplanet observations. We demonstrate that multiple combinations of photometric parameters can reproduce the same laboratory reflectance spectrum while predicting different angular scattering behaviors and disk-integrated observables. We propagate this non-uniqueness to reflected-light phase curves, geometric albedos, and planet-star contrast ratios between $0.5$--$1.7\,μ$m, representative of the spectral range targeted by future direct-imaging missions such as the HWO. We find that single-geometry laboratory spectra produce large uncertainties in predicted signals, particularly at small phase angles. Simplified assumptions adopted in exoplanet studies, such as isotropic scattering can additionally introduce systematic biases. Using multi-angular laboratory measurements from the Bloomsburg University Goniometer dataset, we show that the uncertainty in predicted observables collapses once angular scattering behavior is directly constrained. Our results demonstrate that multi-angular measurements are required to construct physically predictive reflected-light models of rocky exoplanets.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究通过对比单几何与多角度实验室BRDF测量数据,揭示了不完整角度覆盖在rocky系外行星反射光观测中引入的系统性不确定性。我们表明,相同的单几何反射光谱可对应多种光度参数组合,导致预测的相位曲线、几何反照率和星-行星对比度在0.5-1.7 μm波段出现显著差异(1.7倍以上)。研究证明利用多角度实验室测量数据可有效约束角散射行为,从而大幅降低这些不确定性,为HWO等未来直接成像任务的Rocky系外行星大气和表面反演提供更可靠的物理模型基础。

2026-10-22.title: Saturation Level of the Streaming Instability
2026-10-22.abstract: In proto-planetary disks, gas turbulence can cluster dust grains and catalyze the formation of planetesimals. This process depends on the strength of the turbulence. Here, we evaluate the turbulence strength that is induced by the streaming instability. Based on the amount of free energy available, we estimate the viscous parameter to be alpha ~ St Pi^2 f(epsilon), where St (< 1) is the Stokes number of the streaming grains, Pi is the dimensionless pressure gradient, and f (epsilon) is an explicit function of epsilon, the local dust-to-gas density ratio. This estimate explains the results of many previous studies, and is also supported by our additional tailor-made simulations. We discuss two easy applications of our result, one is a self-consistent dust scale height, one is the astrophysical relevance of a pressure bump. Lastly, while this work allows one to characterize the streaming turbulence, we emphasize our current inability to connect the strength of turbulence to the formation of planetesimals.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究通过分析原行星盘中流动不稳定性产生的湍流能量，建立了湍流强度与粒度参数、压力梯度和尘气比的定量关系：α ~ St Pi² f(ε)。该理论预测得到多个前期研究结果的验证和额外数值模拟的支持，并可应用于估计尘埃标度高度和压力凸起的天体物理意义。然而，作者指出当前仍无法将湍流强度与行星小体形成过程相关联。

2026-10-22.title: A sub-Earth-sized TESS planet candidate in the nearby M-dwarf binary GJ 774, most likely orbiting GJ 774 A (TIC 351339274)
2026-10-22.abstract: Small planets transiting the nearest M dwarfs are the terrestrial planets most accessible to detailed characterisation. We report a sub-Earth-sized transiting planet candidate in the wide (17.6") M-dwarf binary GJ 774 at 12.86 pc, most likely orbiting the M2.5 primary GJ 774 A (TIC 351339274). The signal was a SPOC multi-sector threshold-crossing event (MES = 7.95) and is not a TESS Object of Interest. In eight TESS sectors (2019-2026) a 1.28-h transit recurs every 4.225138 +/- 0.000010 d with a box-mean depth of 365 +/- 32 ppm in A's light. The 2026 data, which entered neither the SPOC search nor our selection, show it at the ephemeris predicted from 2019-2023 data (304 +/- 43 ppm; none of 10^5 phase-scrambled versions of the 2026 data is as deep). The per-target false-alarm probability is < 0.03 at 95%. Odd/even, secondary-eclipse, archival-plate and Gaia radial-velocity tests exclude unrelated blended eclipsing binaries and eclipsing companions on 4.2-d orbits, and hierarchical eclipsing binaries are improbable. The stars are 0.85 TESS pixel apart, so the TRICERATOPS false-positive probability (0.26) is set by a planet on GJ 774 B. B is disfavoured because its own light does not dim enough: PRF-deblended photometry gives 109 +/- 115 ppm in B's light, against 1089 ppm required if B were the host. Conditional on a point source at A or at B, the joint host model gives P(A)=0.59-0.97 (0.97 for the native target-pixel baseline). Over all sectors the PRF photometry is consistent with A, but in the out-of-sample 2026 data 40% of the deficit appears at B's position, an unexplained 2-3 sigma (PSF-model and depth dependent) tension with host A. On A the planet has R_p=0.70 +/- 0.06 R_Earth, S=15.0 +/- 1.8 S_Earth and T_eq=548 +/- 16 K. It is not validated; resolved ground-based photometry of the pair would test host B directly.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 我们利用TESS多个观测周期的数据在近距离M矮星双星GJ 774中发现了一个亚地球质量的凌星行星候选体,该候选体最可能围绕主星GJ 774 A运行,公转周期为4.225天,半径约0.70地球半径。通过多种假阳性检验(包括奇偶传递、次级食、视差速度和分层食双星检验)以及光谱能量分布(TRICERATOPS)分析,我们排除了大部分可能的假阳性信号,虽然伴星GJ 774 B仍存在约26%的假阳性概率。该行星仍需通过地基分辨率光学观测进行确认验证,但其在邻近M矮星上的发现为进行详细的行星特征研究提供了机遇。

2026-10-22.title: TOI-3686: A Hot Jupiter and Sub-Neptune In A 2:1 Mean-Motion Resonance
2026-10-22.abstract: Hot Jupiters are typically thought to be "lonely", but a small and growing subset of them have been found to have nearby planets in the same system. We present the discovery of a new member of this class of systems, TOI-3686. TOI-3686 c is a hot Jupiter with $P_\mathrm{orb} = 5.078$ days detected by NASA's TESS mission that shows peak-to-peak transit timing variations (TTVs) of 40 minutes, amongst the largest ever observed for a hot Jupiter. A subsequent search of the TESS data revealed the transits of a second planet, TOI-3686 b, a sub-Neptune with $P_\mathrm{orb} = 2.54$~days and peak-to-peak TTVs of 10 hours, $\sim 16\%$ of its orbital period. We characterized the system through photodynamical modeling of photometry from TESS and ground-based facilities, as well as radial velocity measurements from the NEID and MAROON-X spectrographs. We find that the two planets in the TOI-3686 system are deep in a 2:1 mean-motion resonance, making this the only hot Jupiter system currently known to be in a truly resonant configuration, which may be related to its $\lesssim1$~Gyr system age. Systems like TOI-3686 likely formed through a dynamically quiescent pathway and were captured into resonance after migration through a disk, and may represent the high-mass end of processes that occur in compact systems of smaller planets.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究报道了TOI-3686系统中热木星与亚海王星的发现,该系统展现出异常大的过境时间变化(热木星40分钟、亚海王星10小时),通过TESS光度测光、地面观测和NEID/MAROON-X径向速度数据的光动力学建模确认两颗行星处于2:1平均运动共振中。这是目前已知唯一处于真正共振构型的热木星系统,其年龄≲1 Gyr,表明该系统可能通过动力学平静的途径形成并在盘迁移后被捕获进入共振,代表了紧凑行星系统中高质量端的动力学过程。

2026-10-22.title: Two Validated Planets and 179 Candidates From a TESS Faint Star Transit Search in the ULTRASAT Fields
2026-10-22.abstract: The TESS mission is designed to survey the entire sky to find planets most amenable to follow-up observations, and transit searches have therefore focused specifically on bright targets. Faint stars ($T_{mag}>13.5$) have not been systematically searched for planets, despite TESS having the sensitivity necessary to do so, therefore representing a promising avenue for increasing TESS's scientific yield. We utilized TESS's sensitivity for faint stars in particular to find more planets for joint optical-UV studies of exoplanet transits. Observing transits in both UV and optical gives insight into exoplanet atmosphere composition and evolution and remains relatively unexplored due to the lack of UV-capable instruments. ULTRASAT is an upcoming UV space telescope that will perform a high cadence survey suitable for observing exoplanet transits. To increase the sample size of planets capable of observations with ULTRASAT, we performed a transit search of faint stars down to $T_{mag}=16$ in the ULTRASAT high cadence survey fields using TESS light curves optimized for faint stars. Our search recovered 262 planet candidates, of which 181 are new to this work. We also statistically validated 2 of those candidates as bona fide planets. Finally, we estimated the ULTRASAT SNR of both new and existing planet candidates, and found that 113 targets will be detectable with ULTRASAT, which would facilitate the largest study of transiting planets in the visible and UV. This work demonstrates the power of TESS to detect exoplanets around faint stars and provides a catalog of well-vetted transiting planet candidates to observe with ULTRASAT.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究通过优化的TESS光曲线分析方法,在ULTRASAT巡天视场中系统搜索了暗星(Tmag≤16)周围的行星,发现262个行星候选体(其中181个为新发现),并统计验证了其中2颗为真实行星。研究估算了113个目标的ULTRASAT信噪比,这些目标可用于进行迄今最大规模的可见光-紫外联合行星凌日观测,为探索系外行星大气组成和演化提供了宝贵的样本。

2026-10-22.title: A Solar Optical Clock
2026-10-22.abstract: Precision spectroscopy underpins quantum sensing, atomic timekeeping, and the search for terrestrial-mass exoplanets. Finding an Earth-Sun analog requires fractional splitting of spectral features that rivals the precision of the best laboratory spectroscopy. This corresponds to resolution of a few parts in $10^5$ of a typical stellar spectral line, or a Doppler velocity precision of less than 10 cm s$^{-1}$. Only a few astrophysical spectrometers reach this regime, and only by dispersing starlight with large gratings and averaging thousands of lines. Here, we show that comparable precision can be achieved on a single solar line by leveraging techniques used in quantum sensors and optical clocks. A laser is frequency-locked to the 1565 nm solar Fe I line by coupling to a single mode of the solar thermal field and counted against an optical frequency comb referenced to the SI second, thus creating a solar optical clock. Operating at the fundamental photon-noise limit of thermal heterodyne spectroscopy, we achieve centroid precision of one part in $10^9$ of the optical frequency, or 30 cm s$^{-1}$ in radial velocity. We recover the Sun's five-minute acoustic oscillations and the expected Rossiter-McLaughlin signal during a solar eclipse. Combining these techniques from quantum sensing with a thirty-meter-class telescope could enable our demonstrated precision on the nearest Sun-like stars in a few hours. Multiplexing such absolute frequency measurements across lines with different magnetic sensitivity and formation depth would reduce averaging time and help disentangle stellar granulation and activity from the Doppler signature of terrestrial exoplanets, providing new approaches to address some of the most demanding measurements in astrophysical spectroscopy.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究利用量子传感和光学钟技术对太阳1565 nm铁谱线进行精密频率锁定，通过与光频梳比对实现了光学频率十亿分之一的质心精度（30 cm/s径向速度精度），并成功探测到太阳五分钟声振荡和日食期间的Rossiter-McLaughlin信号。这一方法通过单条谱线达到了传统大光栅分光仪平均数千条谱线才能获得的精度，为地球质量系外行星搜索提供了新的技术路径。将该技术应用于三十米级望远镜观测类太阳星，可在数小时内实现相同精度，并通过多谱线磁敏感性分析有效区分恒星活动与行星信号，显著推进系外行星动力学研究的精度极限。

2026-10-22.title: The T-matrix method for modeling the optical properties of grains in exoplanetary atmospheres
2026-10-22.abstract: Observations of exoplanetary atmospheres have revealed a rather complex co-existence between the gaseous and condensed phases, ranging from atmospheres apparently covered in clouds to clear ones, across a myriad of intermediate regimes. The interaction between solids and stellar radiation is of fundamental importance when forward or retrieval models are compared to observations. The simplest approach is to assume spherical particles, whose scattering and absorption properties are readily computed with Mie theory. More advanced computational methods, however, can also treat non-spherical condensates. Among these, the transition matrix approach has proven to provide a rigorous and efficient calculation of the extinction by non-spherical particles over a broad range of sizes and refractive indices. We here focus on the absorption and scattering cross sections of forsterite, spinel and silicon monoxide from the near to the far infrared range for particles of different sizes, with shapes ranging from compact ensembles of spheres to porous aggregates. We find that, depending on the size and the configuration chosen, the differences in extinction can be as high as a factor of 2-3, with structured grains being more efficient absorbers in the near infrared for sizes greater than 1 $μ$m. In a fiducial transmission spectrum we show that in the $λ= 1-5\,μ$m range the amount of spherical material needed to match the contribution of the structured grains can be a factor 2 higher. Such calculations, available for the community through a Zenodo repository, prove to be useful for interpreting recent and future observations of exoplanetary atmospheres.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究采用T矩阵方法计算系外行星大气中非球形颗粒(橄榄石、尖晶石、一氧化硅)在近红外到远红外波段的消光特性,对比了不同粒度和形态(从紧密球体堆积到多孔聚集体)颗粒的吸收散射截面差异。研究发现结构化颗粒的消光系数可相差2-3倍,在1μm以上波长范围内结构颗粒的吸收效率更高,等效球形颗粒的质量需增加2倍才能匹配其贡献。这些计算结果为系外行星大气观测的正演和反演模型提供了关键参考。

2026-10-22.title: When the core ate the atmosphere
2026-10-22.abstract: The initial volatile element inventories in a planet's atmosphere, mantle, and core are established by delivery and transport during planetary growth. Conversely, the volatile abundances of Earth's planetary reservoirs record its accretion pathway. We model here volatile transport during planet formation for two different delivery scenarios, via pebble and planetesimal accretion, to predict the volatile inventories of proto-Earth at the end of its main accretion phase. We find that the distributions of volatiles between the atmosphere, mantle, and core exhibit strong sensitivity to volatile delivery timing, metal-silicate partition coefficients, atmosphere-magma solubilities, and planet mass. In particular, the early volatile delivery expected in pebble accretion scenarios substantially enhances core sequestration of hydrogen and carbon relative to continuous delivery during incremental planetesimal accretion. With our fiducial partition coefficients, the pebble accretion model produces a 760 bar carbon-dominated atmosphere with 39 bar of hydrogen and water and a few bars of nitrogen, consistent with volatile concentration estimates for bulk silicate Earth including the atmosphere. The corresponding planetesimal accretion model produces a more massive ($\sim$$1350$ bar) atmosphere with similar composition. The core stores $\sim$$70$% of both the H and the C budget in the early-delivery scenario, but $\lesssim$$50$% in the corresponding continuous delivery scenario. Overall our results demonstrate that substantial amounts of volatiles are sequestered into rocky planet cores during planet formation and that the volatile inventory of bulk silicate Earth was likely established already during the magma ocean phase of planet formation.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究通过建立行星吸积过程中挥发元素在大气、地幔和核中的运输模型，比较了流星体吸积和卵石吸积两种情景下原始地球的挥发元素分配。研究发现挥发元素的分配对吸积时间、金属-硅酸盐分配系数和大气-岩浆溶解度等因素高度敏感，其中早期交付（流星体吸积）会显著增加氢和碳向地核的迁移。结果表明地球硅酸盐体的挥发元素库存主要在岩浆洋阶段就已确立，地核在行星形成期间封存了大量挥发元素（早期交付情景中约70%的H和C）。

2026-10-22.title: The Sensitivity of TESS to Transiting Planets in TOIs with Close-in Stellar Companions
2026-10-22.abstract: Abstract High-resolution imaging with optical speckle interferometry has revealed that many transiting exoplanet host stars possess close-in stellar companions. The objective of this study is to quantify how the presence of these companions impacts the ability of TESS to detect the transits of small planets. We accomplish this by examining 2052 TESS Objects of Interest (TOIs) that appear to be single-star systems based on speckle interferometric observations as well as 188 TOIs in unresolved (<1 . ″ 2) stellar binaries. For each planet, we take its transit signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), radius, and orbital period from the TOI catalog and, for planets in stellar binaries, we correct the radius for dilution by the companion. By applying a scaling relation to the measured transit SNR of each TOI in our sample, we determine the detectability of transits in each TOI as a function of both planet radius and orbital period. When applied to the full sample, this procedure elucidates the sensitivity of TESS to transiting planets as a function of binarity, host-star spectral type, planet radius, and planet orbital period. These sensitivity grids quantify the bias against the detection of small planets in unresolved binaries by TESS and show that there is a particularly low sensitivity to planets transiting secondary stars in unresolved binaries, especially as the magnitude difference between the stars increases. These sensitivity grids are available for download to facilitate their use in other studies.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究利用光学干涉仪观测的2052个单星系统和188个未分解的食双星系统的TESS目标,通过分析凌日信噪比、行星半径和轨道周期,定量评估了伴星对TESS探测小行星凌日的灵敏度的影响。研究结果表明,未分解的食双星系统中存在凌日信号稀释效应,TESS对于在伴星上凌日的行星的灵敏度特别低,这种灵敏度的降低随着两星星等差的增加而更加显著。所获得的灵敏度网格可用于量化TESS对小行星探测的偏差,为后续行星统计学研究提供重要参考。

2026-10-22.title: Evidence for an Extended Hydrogen Outflow on WASP-12 b
2026-10-22.abstract: Abstract Recent observations of atmospheric escape from planets orbiting early-type stars indicate that planets with higher Roche filling factors have significantly higher mass-loss rates. For three of these planets, full-orbit observations have revealed the presence of large leading and trailing tails of escaping planetary material. These 3D outflow geometries encode information about the underlying outflow physics, and can also be used to constrain their stellar wind properties and to predict their long-term orbital evolution. We present new evidence for extended H α and H β absorption from escaping hydrogen for a fourth planet, WASP-12 b. We observed WASP-12 b with the Keck Planet Finder on Keck I over a period of approximately 8 hr centered on the transit. We find an H α and H β absorption signal in the stellar rest frame that is strongest during the transit (H α amplitude: 2.66% ± 0.25%, H β amplitude: 2.88% ± 0.43%), with evidence of both pre- and posttransit absorption. This measurement is consistent with outflow models where the escaping gas overflows the planet’s Roche lobe and is advected into the stellar rest frame before being tidally sheared into extended tails. This outflow behavior is qualitatively similar to previous H α observations of this planet as well as observations of extended outflows from other gas giants orbiting early-type stars. Longer-baseline observations spanning a full planetary orbit are required in order to fully map the extent of WASP-12 b’s outflow.
