2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究通过Keck行星探测器对WASP-12b进行约8小时的凌星观测,检测到氢原子(Hα和Hβ)在恒星静止参考系中的吸收信号,在凌星期间强度最强,并在凌星前后均有吸收证据。观测结果与行星大气逃逸模型相符,表明该行星逃逸气体溢出洛希瓣后被吸积进恒星静止系并最终被潮汐力拉伸成延伸尾流,这一行为与其他绕早型星运行的气态巨行星的观测结果定性一致。该研究补充了行星大气逃逸的3D几何结构证据,有助于约束恒星风特性并预测行星长期轨道演化。

2026-10-22.title: Spectroscopic monitoring of long secondary period variables. The case of J-type carbon stars
2026-10-22.abstract: Long-secondary-period (LSP) variables are a subclass of long-period variables whose origin is a matter of debate. The current leading hypotheses involve binarity or non-radial pulsations. We aim to investigate the spectroscopic signatures associated with the LSP variability by targeting two J-type carbon stars exhibiting an LSP - VZ Per and UV Cam - and further constrain its origin. Decade-long spectroscopic monitoring was used to obtain a long-term radial-velocity (RV) curve for the two stars. From a frequency analysis, we isolated an LSP signal. The retrieved periodicity was then compared with changes in spectral profiles and available light-curve variability to further constrain the origin of the modulation. For VZ Per, the LSP derived from the RV curve (∼,960 days) is correlated with the light-curve dimming event and a variation in the Balmer absorption line profile. These results translate into changes in the gas and dust column densities with the phase of the LSP, with the maximum gas column density occurring ahead of the dust. For UV Cam, the RV monitoring yields a period of ∼,1178 d, with an amplitude of about 1,km/s. When interpreting the RV modulation as a Keplerian signal for both stars, a low-mass ($<0.1, ̊m M_⊙$) close companion is found. In this scenario, variations in gas and dust column densities with (orbital) phase trace the material in the expanding comet-like tail trailing the substellar companion. These observations provide time-dependent variations of the gas and dust in LSP variables that are consistent with the current binary scenario. Furthermore, the detection of LSP among J-type carbon stars anchors their current evolutionary status in the dust-producing region of the thermally pulsing AGB phase.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究通过十年长期光谱监测两颗具有长周期变光的J型碳星（VZ Per和UV Cam），利用径向速度曲线频率分析和光谱轮廓变化来探讨长二周期变光的起源机制。研究发现两颗星的径向速度调制可解释为低质量伴星（<0.1太阳质量）的开普勒信号，气体和尘埃柱密度随轨道周期的变化与伴星周围彗星尾结构中物质分布相符，支持双星假说；同时在热脉动AGB阶段产尘区检测到长二周期变光的J型碳星，确认了这类天体的演化地位。

2026-10-22.title: Detailed study of HD 219134: A benchmark K dwarf with a compact planetary system
2026-10-22.abstract: Space-based missions such as CoRoT, , and TESS have revolutionised asteroseismology and strengthened its synergies with exoplanet science. With PLATO and ARIEL on the horizon, these synergies will play an even more central role. Kepler We revisit the characterisation of the nearby K dwarf HD 219134 using advanced seismic diagnostics. Our goals are to investigate the reported tension between asteroseismic and interferometric radii, update the fundamental parameters of the star, refine the properties of its planetary system, and investigate the coupled rotational, magnetic, and star–planet evolution of the system, including the atmospheric mass‑loss histories of its planets. The stellar characterisation is based on detailed asteroseismic forward modelling complemented by seismic inversions to quantify systematic uncertainties associated with non‑seismic constraints, assess the compatibility of radius measurements, and evaluate the impact of surface modelling on seismic inferences. The revised stellar properties were used as inputs for rotational evolution investigations, stellar wind modelling, and high‑energy irradiation histories. Seismic inversions rule out the most recent interferometric radius determination, whereas asteroseismic and spectroscopic results are compatible with the previous interferometric measurement from 2019. We derive revised stellar mass, radius, and age of 0.779 ± 0.015_ ± 0.006_ , M_⊙, 0.753 ± 0.005_ ± 0.002_ , R_⊙, and 8.92 ± 0.89_ ± 0.19_ Gyr, respectively. The quoted systematic uncertainties reflect contributions from the non-seismic observational constraints only. Literature values for combined uncertainties arising from physical inputs and surface-effect prescriptions are 0.007M_⊙, 0.002R_⊙, and 0.81 Gyr, respectively. Using stellar wind models and a dedicated calibration of the magnetic braking law for low-mass stars, we reconstructed the rotational and angular‑momentum evolution of the host star and find that standard magnetic braking prescriptions remain broadly consistent with the observed present‑day rotation and angular‑momentum loss. Models invoking weakened magnetic braking provide a closer match but challenge commonly adopted scaling relations for the wind-driven angular momentum loss. The reconstructed X‑ray activity history implies early atmospheric stripping of the innermost planets, while the more massive outer planets are expected to have retained at least part of their primordial envelopes. In particular, HD 219134d appears to have undergone only moderate atmospheric erosion over the system lifetime. (stat) (sys) (stat) (sys) (stat) (sys) The available evidence suggests that the apparent radius discrepancy for HD 219134 does not reflect a genuine astrophysical problem but is more likely the result of underestimated uncertainties in previous interferometric analyses. We therefore advocate adopting the asteroseismic radius, which demonstrates remarkable robustness against variations in modelling assumptions and optimisation strategies.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究通过详细的星震学正演建模和反演分析，重新确定了K型矮星HD 219134的基本参数（质量0.779±0.015M⊙、半径0.753±0.005R⊙、年龄8.92±0.89 Gyr），解决了其与干涉测量结果的张力，并证实星震学半径测量的可靠性。基于更新的恒星参数，研究通过恒星风模型和磁制动率校准重建了系统的旋转演化和高能辐射历史，揭示了内层行星经历了大气剥离而外层行星保留了部分原始包层的不同演化路径。研究表明标准磁制动处方仍与观测相符，但弱化的磁制动模型提供了更优的匹配，这对低质量恒星的角动量损失标度关系提出了挑战。

2026-10-22.title: High-resolution transmission spectroscopy of KELT-18b. Metastable helium detection at 1083 nm
2026-10-22.abstract: Exoplanets orbiting near their host stars experience intense irradiation, which can drive the expansion and escape of their upper atmospheres. The near-infrared metastable helium triplet at 1083.3 nm has emerged as a powerful diagnostic to probe these mass-loss processes. We present the first high-resolution transmission spectroscopy of the ultrahot Jupiter KELT-18b, probing its escaping atmosphere by analyzing a single transit obtained with the CARMENES spectrograph. Transmission spectroscopy and Doppler tomography were utilized to isolate the planetary signal. To mitigate contamination from the strong telluric OH lines overlapping the region of interest, two distinct data analysis procedures were applied: a standard Molecfit and OH-masking approach, as well as a principal component analysis (PCA)-based method. By combining the two complementary approaches, we successfully detect a He,I triplet absorption feature of 1.10 ± 0.22% (5.1σ). The signal exhibits a velocity shift consistent with zero and is attributed to the exoplanetary atmosphere. An injection test reveals that the PCA-based method significantly suppresses the retrieved signal. Additionally, using the ATES and TPM codes, we modeled the atmospheric photoevaporation and the helium triplet profile for different He/H ratios and stellar extreme ultraviolet (XUV) fluxes, accounting for instrument and planetary rotational broadening. From our simulations we derive a mass-loss rate and an evaporation efficiency for KELT-18b of 10.47 łeq 10 ( ) łeq 11.68 and 0.153 łeq η łeq 0.321, showing that the atmosphere of KELT-18b is undergoing photoevaporation. Furthermore, our simulations show good agreement with the observed transmission spectrum, allowing us to exclude very low He/H ratios at a 3σ confidence level for XUV fluxes up to approximately twice the nominal reconstructed value. M Our result expands the known parameter space of exoplanets with confirmed helium absorption, establishing KELT-18b as the most massive planet orbiting the hottest host star with such a detection. Furthermore, when employing PCA, we emphasize the need to perform injection tests to investigate whether any planetary signal is removed, not only near quadrature but also during transits.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究利用CARMENES高分辨率光谱仪对超热木星KELT-18b进行了首次甲烷态氦三重态(1083.3 nm)传输光谱观测,通过传输光谱和多普勒层析成像结合Molecfit和PCA等数据处理方法,成功检测到1.10±0.22%的氦吸收信号(5.1σ显著性),揭示该行星大气正在发生光蒸发。利用ATES和TPM模型模拟大气光蒸发过程,推导出KELT-18b的质量损失率为10.47-11.68×10^9 g/s、蒸发效率为0.153-0.321,同时对He/H比值和极紫外辐射通量进行了约束,确立该行星为已知中最大质量且绕最热恒星的氦吸收确认行星。

2026-10-22.title: Binary tidal evolution as a sculptor of circumbinary planet architectures
2026-10-22.abstract: Circumbinary planets (CBPs) are expected to form in circumbinary discs and migrate towards the disc inner cavity, often close to the dynamical stability boundary of the binary. Yet, the observed transiting and radial-velocity population is not strictly marginally stable. Excluding extreme systems, the typical offset from the stability limit is Δ ≡ a_ ̊m p /a_ ̊m crit =1.22^ +0.18 _ -0.07 , suggesting that post-formation evolution may have shaped the present-day architecture. We investigated whether the secular evolution of close binaries can contribute to the observed displacement of CBPs from marginal stability. We tested how prescribed binary contraction and eccentricity damping move the stability boundary, a_ ̊m crit (t), thereby modifying Δ=a_ ̊m p /a_ ̊m crit as well as the orbital response, survival, and loss of near-boundary planets as a function of binary mass ratio. We performed controlled, high-accuracy N-body simulations of single coplanar CBPs initially placed near a_ (t) modifies the planets' final offsets, orbital response, survival, and loss. crit. The planets evolve under Newtonian gravity, while the central binary follows a prescribed contraction and eccentricity damping track that approximately conserves orbital angular momentum. We measured how the resulting motion of a_ crit The retreat of a_ ̊m crit (t) filters the initially near-boundary population, adding a contraction-driven loss component dominated by ejections. Surviving planets remain quasi-fossilised, with median changes in a_̊m p and e_̊m p close to zero and typical semi-major axis drifts of only a few per cent. Considering all valid synthetic survivors, the final offset reaches a global median value of Δ_f = 1.86^ +0.18 _ -0.26 . Applying the same fiducial damping prescription to the observed sample shifts the median offset from Δ_ ̊m now =1.22^ +0.18 _ -0.07 to Δ_ ̊m damp =1.44^ +0.32 _ -0.10 . Near-equal-mass binaries undergo stronger dynamical filtering, with enhanced ejections and collisions. Binary tidal evolution offers a plausible internal pathway for shaping non-marginal circumbinary architectures. By displacing or removing planets initially close to marginal stability, the inward retreat of a_ crit (t) can widen the inner circumbinary gap and move surviving planets towards larger offsets from the present-day stability boundary. This mechanism links binary orbital evolution, dynamical filtering, and the detectability of transiting CBPs, supporting a multi-channel interpretation of the CBP desert in which physical sculpting and geometric selection act together.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究调查了双星潮汐演化对联星行星轨道架构的塑造作用，通过高精度N体模拟追踪了处于边界附近的联星行星在双星收缩和偏心率阻尼过程中的动力学响应、生存和损失情况。研究表明，稳定性边界的后退会引起初始靠近边界的行星群体的动力学筛选（主要通过抛出机制），而存活行星基本保持其原始轨道特征，最终偏离稳定边界的中位数值从观测样本的1.22提升至1.86，这与观测到的非边界稳定架构相符。该结果表明双星轨道演化提供了一条可信的内部物理机制，能够解释联星行星沙漠现象中物理塑造和几何选择的共同作用。

2026-10-22.title: Star Cluster Ecology. VIII. Dynamically Forming S-Type and αCentauri-like Systems
2026-10-22.abstract: Approximately half of the field stars in the local neighbourhood are part of binaries. Nevertheless, only sim15%-20% of the detected exoplanets orbit binary or higher-N systems. Previous work has investigated the extent to which binary systems modify planet formation or introduce dynamical instabilities, but only a few papers considered the role of the cluster environment. We analyse the impact of dynamically formed binaries that emerge naturally from various star cluster environments in already established planetary systems. We conducted numerical simulations replicating the star-forming region NGC 1333. Three models were considered, each using identical cluster realisations and simulation parameters. The cluster itself was initially sub-virial and fractally distributed. Model A assumed that planetary systems are initially in mean motion resonance. In model B, the same planetary systems were moved out of resonance, but remained intrinsically stable. Finally, model C removed all planets from the simulation. Ten independent realisations were integrated per model until 30 Myr. Dynamically formed binaries emerged at similar rates in all models, indicating that planets play only a little role in their formation. We also found a higher production rate of wide binaries than reported in previous numerical studies, which we attribute to the sub-virial and sub-clustered initial conditions. S- and binary S-type planetary systems naturally emerged in our simulations, while P-type systems were rare. For model A, the fraction of S- or binary S-type systems is f_ ̊m S =0.02 and f_ ̊m Bin,, S =0.05, respectively. Rogue planets originating from a binary system were ejected with a substantially higher velocity than those around single-planet system. Planet-star collisions and planet capture events occurred disproportionately within binary systems. Finally, several αCentauri-like systems emerged in our simulations, suggesting that the nearest stellar system to the Sun might have a dynamical origin.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究通过数值模拟NGC 1333星团环境中的动力学过程,探究动态形成的双星系统对已有行星系统的影响。研究采用三种模型(初始共振、非共振稳定和无行星对照组),各进行十次独立演化至3000万年,发现动态双星形成率与行星存在与否关系不大,但产生了更高比例的宽双星系统,且S型和双星S型行星系统大量产生。研究发现流浪行星在双星系统中的喷出速度更高,行星碰撞和捕获事件更频繁地发生于双星系统,并揭示了αCentauri型系统可能具有动力学起源的证据。

2026-10-22.title: The GAPS Programme at TNG. LXXX. Characterisation of the 400 Myr old multi-planet system K2-233
2026-10-22.abstract: Studying the physical properties of the exoplanets is crucial for retrieving the characteristics of their atmospheres and their inner composition. Precise measurements of exoplanetary masses are crucial to constrain their bulk densities and infer their inner composition. For young systems hosting planets within or near the radius valley, accurate physical parameters are required to distinguish between different evolutionary scenarios and to understand the impact of atmospheric mass-loss mechanisms, such as photoevaporation driven by stellar activity. In this work we perform a revision of the masses of the three transiting exoplanets hosted by K2-233, a young (∼ 400 Myr old) K-type active star. Through dedicated simulations, we get insights into the evolution of planets' atmospheres over time being affected by photoevaporation, and into the modelling of the planets' interiors. We collected 70 HARPS-N observations within the GAPS/ArMS Large Programme and performed a joint analysis combining 124 HARPS literature observations, the available K2 light curves, and TESS data obtained simultaneously with our radial velocity monitoring. After obtaining the planetary information, we reconstructed the atmospheric evolution of the planet K2-233 d by using our photoevaporation code. Due to the strong stellar activity of K2-233, we explored several Multi-GP configurations and demonstrated that the inferred planetary masses are highly sensitive to the selected activity-modelling strategy, yielding a set of different physically viable solutions rather than a single uniquely preferred model. Our models indicate that K2-233 d likely experienced significant atmospheric mass loss. In most scenarios, the planet evolves towards a stripped or partially stripped state, placing it within or near the radius valley at gigayear timescales. Depending on its internal composition and atmospheric properties, the final outcome ranges from a low-mass sub-Neptune retaining a thin envelope (R_p ∼ 1.71 - 1.84 R_⊕) to a bare-core super-Earth (R_p ∼ 1.95 R_⊕). From our inner composition models, we found that K2-233 b and K2-233 c are likely iron-dominated, while K2-233 d presents a significant H-He atmosphere.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究通过HARPS-N和TESS等多波段观测数据联合分析，精确测定了400 Myr年轻多行星系统K2-233三颗行星的质量，并采用光蒸发模型模拟了其大气演化过程。研究发现星际活动对行星质量推导的敏感性较大，导致存在多个物理可行解，其中K2-233 d经历显著大气质量损失，在Gyr尺度上可能演化为半剥离亚海王星或裸露超地球，而b、c行星富铁，d行星保留显著H-He包层。

2026-10-22.title: Metaheuristic physics-informed extreme-learning machine for initial orbit determination of near-Earth asteroids from too-short arcs
2026-10-22.abstract: Modern wide-field astronomical surveys are substantially increasing the volume of observational data and the discovery rate of near-Earth asteroids (NEAs), placing growing demands on efficient and automated initial orbit determination (IOD). The physics-informed extreme-learning machine (PIELM) is an artificial intelligence (AI)-based algorithm for IOD that reconstructs orbital trajectories under observational and dynamical constraints. However, optical survey observations often span arcs that are too short to provide sufficient geometric constraints, making it difficult for the standard PIELM to determine a reliable initial orbit. New IOD methods capable of handling too-short arcs (TSAs) are therefore increasingly needed. We develop a new AI-based method for determining the initial orbits of NEAs from TSAs. It yields reliable initial estimates for subsequent least-squares refinement. We propose a metaheuristic PIELM method, termed MH-PIELM. An artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm explores candidate solutions defined by a single line-of-sight range, with PIELM embedded directly within the search to reconstruct the corresponding trajectories under observational and dynamical constraints. The resulting PIELM loss serves as the fitness function, guiding the ABC algorithm toward promising candidate solutions. The method was tested on the initial optical observations reported for several NEAs. The MH-PIELM solutions enabled successful least-squares refinement, whose results closely agreed with the Jet Propulsion Laboratory reference solutions. The refined orbits were then used to predict the astrometric positions on the following day. Comparisons with the corresponding observations showed a useful short-term predictive capability for follow-up observations and target recovery, demonstrating the feasibility of the MH-PIELM approach. MH-PIELM offers a new AI-based strategy for initial orbit determination from TSAs by combining metaheuristic global search with physics-informed machine learning. It extends the applicability of the standard PIELM to challenging TSA observations.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究针对短弧观测数据下近地小行星初轨确定的难题,提出了一种融合元启发式算法与物理约束极限学习机(MH-PIELM)的新方法,通过人工蜂群算法在视线范围空间中探索候选解,将物理约束的轨迹重构嵌入搜索过程中。在多颗近地小行星的实际观测数据上的验证表明,该方法获得的初轨估计可为后续最小二乘法精化奠定基础,精化后的轨道与JPL参考解高度一致,并具有良好的短期预测能力,为困难的短弧观测提供了一种可行的人工智能求解策略。

2026-10-22.title: Companion architectures of sub-Saturns: Distinct migration pathways across the Neptunian landscape
2026-10-22.abstract: Close-in sub-Saturns (4.0, _⊕ łeq R_ łeq 8.5, _⊕) are distributed unevenly across the period--radius plane: They are depleted in the Neptunian desert at periods P łesssim 3.2,d, accumulate in a narrow overdensity at P ≃ 3.2--5.7,d (the Neptunian ridge), and thin out in the savanna at P ≳ 5.7,d. R p R We tested whether sub-Saturns in different landscape regions have systematically different planetary companion architectures, as expected if desert and ridge planets arrived through high-eccentricity migration and if savanna planets migrated quiescently. We compiled 90 sub-Saturns in 86 systems with both transit and radial velocity (RV) data, constructed per-system RV and transit injection-recovery completeness maps, and combined them into detection probability surfaces for companions. From these maps we derived completeness-corrected occurrence rates for different companion types with a joint Poisson occurrence model. Companion architectures differ significantly across the landscape. Nearby companions (P_ < 200,d) accompany comp -4.3 ^ +3.2 % of savanna sub-Saturns but only 36_ -14 ^ +16 % of desert and ridge sub-Saturns. This contrast is driven almost entirely by small (M_ < 20, _⊕) companions, accompanying 88.2_ comp M -5.5 ^ +4.2 % of savanna but only 29_ -14 ^ +17 % of desert and ridge sub-Saturns, while medium-mass and giant companions within 200,d are rare (łesssim 13%) everywhere, so the sub-Saturn typically dominates its inner system. Moreover savanna sub-Saturns reside in compact multi-planet systems. These contrasts are robust to crosscuts in sub-Saturn radius, bulk density, eccentricity, and host-star properties. Desert and ridge sub-Saturns reside in dynamically emptied systems whose nearby companion rates resemble those of hot Jupiters, while savanna sub-Saturns inhabit compact multi-planet systems resembling those of warm Jupiters. This parallel supports two migration channels within a single population: high-eccentricity migration delivering planets to the desert and ridge, and quiescent disk migration or in situ formation populating the savanna.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究调查了海王星沙漠、海王星岭和草原三个区域中近轨次土星的伴星架构差异,采用联合贝叶斯方法对90个拥有凌日和径向速度数据的次土星系统进行了完整性修正的伴星发生率分析。结果表明草原次土星系统内存在丰富的小质量伴星(88.2%),而沙漠和岭区次土星系统则被动态清空,与热木星系统相似,揭示了高偏心率迁移和静谧盘迁移两条不同的行星迁移通道在塑造次土星种群空间分布中的作用。

2026-10-22.title: Asteroseismic analysis of the merger product red giant in the γ Persei system
2026-10-22.abstract: γ Persei (γ Per) is a long-period eclipsing binary system (P≈ 14.6 years) containing a red-giant primary, and it is well known for its multi-faceted classification as a visual and spectroscopic binary. Its brightness and binary nature together make it a valuable target for both photometric and spectroscopic studies, particularly in the context of asteroseismology and stellar evolution, as the primary star likely formed through a stellar merger. We determined the seismic parameters ν_̊m max and Δ ν, and the oscillation amplitudes of the primary component, an evolved giant, to estimate its seismic mass, which we compared to its estimated dynamic mass. We used Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite data obtained during Sectors 58, 85, and 86. To complement the space-based observations, we incorporated high-resolution radial velocity measurements acquired by the Stellar Observations Network Group during two distinct epochs, 2017 and 2024. We successfully detect solar-like oscillations in γ Per and infer a seismic mass of 3.25 M_⊙, which is slightly below the dynamical mass. We find the photometric oscillation amplitudes to be significantly lower than predicted from scaling relations, but in line with other high-mass red giants. We also find that radial-velocity amplitudes along the Hertzsprung-Russell diagram cannot be fitted uniformly with current scaling relations.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究利用TESS卫星光度数据和高分辨率径向速度测量，对γPersei系统中可能由恒星合并产生的红巨星主星进行了星震学分析。通过测定日震参数νmax和Δν，估算了该星的星震质量为3.25M⊙，与动力学质量基本一致，但发现其光度振幅明显低于理论预测值。研究结果表明现有的标度关系不足以统一描述高质量红巨星的径向速度振幅随恒星演化的变化规律。

2026-10-22.title: The origin of the high heavy-element content of warm Jupiters
2026-10-22.abstract: Interior models of planets have revealed that warm Jupiters should harbour high heavy-element masses, with Jupiter mass planets potentially consisting of up to 30-40% of heavy elements (heavier than hydrogen and helium). However, it is unclear whether the heavy-element mass of giant planets decreases with decreasing stellar mass. Within the pebble drift and evaporation scenario, inward-drifting pebbles can evaporate, enriching the inner disc with vapour to super-stellar values, which can then be accreted by growing giant planets. Due to a sequential evaporation sequence -- where H_2O evaporates in the inner disc, while CO_2, CH_4, and CO evaporate in the outer disc -- the vapour enrichment of the disc decreases with increasing orbital distance. We employed the code to model the migration and growth of planets via pebble and gas accretion in discs around stars of different masses and discs of different sizes. Our simulations show that: (i) pebble drift and evaporation can explain the wide range of derived heavy-element content in giant planets; (ii) giant planets forming around stars with larger disc sizes can accrete larger quantities of heavy elements, because these discs can maintain a high pebble flux for a longer time, allowing the inner discs to be enriched for longer and resulting in planets with higher heavy-element content; (iii) planets forming or migrating interior to the water ice line can accrete larger amounts of heavy elements via the accretion of vapour-enriched gas compared to those forming in the outer disc regions; (iv) metal-rich stars can enable the formation of planets more enriched in heavy elements if they form in the inner disc regions, whereas planets forming in the outer disc regions -- regardless of disc metallicity -- are much less enriched than their inner-disc counterparts that accrete vapour-enriched gas; and (v) planets forming in discs with the same size and total mass but around higher-mass stars are only marginally more enriched than those forming around lower-mass stars. Together, our study suggests that the trend of increasing total heavy-element mass with increasing planetary mass arises from the accretion of vapour-enriched gas in discs of different sizes, combined with the different origins of warm giant planets from the inner and outer disc. chemcomp
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究通过数值模拟探究了暖木星高重元素含量的起源，在小行星漂移蒸发场景下，向内漂移的小行星逐次蒸发使内盘富集超恒星丰度的水汽，被增长中的巨行星吸积。模拟结果表明，盘大小和恒星质量是控制巨行星重元素含量的关键因素，水冰线内侧形成的行星因吸积富集气体而获得更多重元素，而恒星质量的影响相对较弱。该研究解释了观测到的巨行星重元素含量的宽广分布，为暖木星的形成和演化提供了新的物理图景。

2026-10-22.title: On-sky dark-hole digging with implicit electric field conjugation on MagAO-X
2026-10-22.abstract: Direct spectroscopy is a very promising approach to characterizing the atmospheres of nearby rocky exoplanets, but non-common path aberrations (NCPA), which are differential aberrations between the science optical path and the adaptive optics optical path, can leak through the coronagraph and create speckles that mimic exoplanet signals. This limits the sensitivity of high-contrast imaging instruments at close angular separations - exactly the separations where we want to search for rocky exoplanets with current and future telescopes and instruments. We aim to actively remove the NCPA on-sky during observations by using focal-plane wavefront sensing and control with the newly upgraded MagAO-X instrument. MagAO-X is equipped with a unique second-stage adaptive optics (AO) system containing a dedicated deformable mirror (DM) for coronagraphic focal-plane wavefront control. Because this DM is placed after the science and AO beam splitter, it is not seen by the main AO loop. The DM has been recently upgraded from an ALPAO-97 to a Boston Micromachine Kilo-DM, which enables focal-plane wavefront control with the implicit electric field conjugation (iEFC) algorithm. We developed the necessary procedures to run iEFC with MagAO-X on-sky. We demonstrate the successful removal of NCPA on-sky with an iEFC interaction matrix that was calibrated on the MagAO-X internal source; this demonstrates the repeatability between our off-sky and on-sky alignment. The iEFC algorithm was tested on HR4796A and Alpha Centauri in 0.5” seeing conditions. The intensity of the speckles created by NCPA is reduced by a factor of 2 at the outer working angle and a factor of 20 at the inner working angle. This on-sky validation confirms the robustness and efficiency of iEFC under realistic observing conditions, which paves the way for its integration into next-generation AO systems for the Extremely Large Telescope and Giant Magellan Telescope.
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究针对高对比度成像中非共光路像差(NCPA)导致的散斑噪声限制近距离类地行星探测的问题,采用焦平面波前传感与控制技术,在MagAO-X仪器上实现了隐式电场共轭(iEFC)算法的在天观测。通过在HR4796A和Alpha Centauri的实际观测中验证,iEFC成功将NCPA诱导的散斑强度在外工作角和内工作角分别降低了2倍和20倍,验证了该算法在现实观测条件下的鲁棒性和有效性,为极大望远镜和巨麦哲伦望远镜等下一代自适应光学系统的集成奠定了基础。

2026-10-22.title: New insights into the Martian ozone deficit problem from an uncertainty propagation study
2026-10-22.abstract: Abstract Photochemical models of the Martian atmosphere have long suffered from a persistent “ozone deficit”. This discrepancy is typically attributed to missing physical or chemical processes, particularly involving odd-hydrogen chemistry. Here, we instead quantify the impact of uncertainties in chemical reaction kinetics on modelled ozone, which has received comparatively little attention. We perform a global sensitivity analysis using the 1-D configuration of the Mars Planetary Climate Model (MPCM) by perturbing all photochemical rates within their uncertainty ranges. Rank correlation coefficients (RCCs) are used to identify reactions that exert the strongest control on ozone variability. We find that reactions governing hydroxyl radical (OH) production and direct ozone loss dominate the anticorrelation with ozone, while oxygen-producing pathways are positively correlated. Several reactions involving the hydroperoxyl radical (HO2) and hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) that do not produce OH also contribute positively. Guided by these results, we implement targeted rate adjustments in the 3-D MPCM. These modifications produce systematic increases in ozone column densities and vertical mixing ratios across all seasons and latitudes, without perturbing the simulated water cycle. The resulting ozone fields show improved agreement with ACS MIR vertical profiles. Our results demonstrate that uncertainties in reaction kinetics can account for a substantial fraction of the ozone deficit, reducing the need to invoke additional processes, such as heterogeneous uptake on dust. We provide a list of key uncertainty reactions that should be prioritized in new lab campaigns under Mars conditions to improve model performance and better quantify biases before implementing new processes.
2026-10-22.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-10-22.summary_zh: 本研究通过全局敏感性分析量化了火星大气光化学反应动力学不确定性对臭氧模式的影响,使用秩相关系数识别出羟基自由基产生和臭氧直接损失反应对臭氧变率的控制作用最强。通过在3-D火星气候模型中实施有针对性的反应速率调整,臭氧柱密度和混合比在全季节全纬度得到系统性增加,与ACS MIR观测结果吻合度提高,表明反应动力学不确定性可解释火星臭氧缺陷的重要部分,减少了引入额外物理过程(如尘埃异相吸收)的必要性。

2026-10-20.title: Dynamical response of a protoplanetary disk to an FU Ori-type outburst
2026-10-20.abstract: Episodic accretion events onto young stars can significantly change the global structure of their surrounding protoplanetary disks. Using radiation hydrodynamical simulations with the HURAKAN code, we study the response of the outer passive disk to a powerful FU Ori-type outburst. Disk heating initiates a factor-of-two increase in the vertical scale-height, which develops on a local keplerian timescale. This effectively launches an outward travelling wave with a bump whose radial position changes with time as $r_{b}\sim t^{2/3}$. After the outburst ends, new waves are launched as the disk structure re-equilibrates toward a quiescent state. The vertical expansion of the disk introduces significant time-variable extinction of the central source emission. Disks with inclinations in the range $40^{\circ}<i<60^{\circ}$ go from weakly ($A_{V}<1$) to a strongly embedded state ($A_{V}\sim10^2$), with the extinction decaying on a $\sim10^2$ yr timescale after the outburst. A fingerprint of the outburst-launched shadowing wave is a long-lived drop or a transient dip in the luminosity curve occurring several years after the outburst begins. This apparent luminosity variation is relatively large, up to $1^m-3^m$ in the V band, and is not related to the intrinsic accretion variability.
2026-10-20.summary_zh: 本研究采用辐射流体动力学模拟研究了原行星盘对FU Ori型爆发的动力学响应，发现盘加热引发垂直高度增加并产生向外传播的扰动波，其峰值位置随时间演化为$r_{b}\sim t^{2/3}$。盘的竖向膨胀导致中心源光的消光显著变化，对于倾角在40°-60°范围内的盘，消光从弱($A_{V}<1$)变为强($A_{V}\sim10^2$)，衰减时间尺度约为100年。爆发激发的阴影波在爆发后数年产生的光度曲线偏差(V波段可达1-3星等)是该过程的特征表现，与吸积内禀变率无关。

2026-10-20.title: Companions of Hot Jupiters: two decades of radial velocity monitoring with CORALIE
2026-10-20.abstract: Hot Jupiters are thought to form through multiple pathways, some of which can leave observable signatures in the architecture of their planetary systems. Massive outer companions, in particular, can provide important constraints on the dynamical histories of hot Jupiters. We aim to characterize the occurrence rate and orbital properties of additional giant companions in hot Jupiter systems, and to investigate whether these companions provide evidence for the role of dynamical interactions in shaping the hot Jupiter population. We perform a homogeneous long-term radial-velocity analysis of 147 WASP hot Jupiter systems observed with the CORALIE spectrograph between 2007 and 2025. We identify or refine 13 outer giant companions and use individual radial-velocity posteriors within a Bayesian occurrence-rate framework to measure the frequency of giant companions over orbital periods of 10--6250 days. The occurrence rate of additional giant companions increases strongly with orbital period, from {2}lt;0.01$ and 0.02 at 10--50 and 50--250 days to 0.05 and 0.17 at 250--1250 and 1250--6250 days, respectively, in agreement with the giant-planet occurrence of the general FGK population and with previous estimates of outer companions to hot Jupiters. Hot Jupiters with detected companions have longer orbital periods and higher eccentricities than those without. We also find that companion eccentricity decreases with hot Jupiter period, and that the companion-to-hot-Jupiter mass ratio increases with period ratio, both consistent with expectations from high-eccentricity migration (HEM). Our results support HEM as the mechanism shaping hot Jupiters with outer companions. Combining long-baseline radial velocities with future Gaia astrometry will further constrain companion masses, mutual inclinations, and dynamical histories.
2026-10-20.summary_zh: 本研究对147个WASP热木星系统进行了为期18年的均匀径向速度监测，识别或精化了13个外侧巨行星伴星，并通过贝叶斯统计框架测量了不同轨道周期范围内伴星的出现率。研究发现伴星出现率随轨道周期增加而显著增加，且有伴星的热木星表现出更长的轨道周期和更高的偏心率，伴星偏心率随热木星周期递减、质量比随周期比增加，这些特征与高偏心轨道迁移机制的预期一致。结果支持高偏心轨道迁移是塑造有外侧伴星热木星系统的主要机制。

2026-10-20.title: Coupled Orbital and Interior Evolution of Sub-Neptunes
2026-10-20.abstract: Abstract Recent observations have yielded the first measurements of young exoplanet demographics. Close-in sub-Neptune occurrence rates appear to rise from young (10–100 Myr) to intermediate (100 Myr–1 Gyr) ages and then decline sharply in the old (≳1 Gyr) Kepler field population. In this paper, we test whether these observations can be explained by the effects of planetary cooling, atmospheric mass loss, and tidal orbital migration, which we model through a fully coupled evolution framework. The orbital evolution is assumed to operate exclusively through high-eccentricity migration (HEM), in an effort to estimate the maximum possible contribution from this migration channel. In reality, only a subset of planetary systems are expected to undergo HEM. We find that HEM rapidly populates the close-in sub-Neptune bin, producing a sharp rise in occurrence within the first ∼15 Myr. After this early phase, the occurrence evolves only weakly. While the modeled young- to intermediate-age evolution is broadly consistent with the observed trend within the uncertainty limits, it does not support the idea of a sustained young-to-intermediate rise driven by tidal migration. It also fails to reproduce the sharp decline in occurrence seen from intermediate to old ages, motivating additional physics or formation channels to be included in future models.
2026-10-20.summary_zh: 本研究通过耦合行星冷却、大气逃逸和潮汐轨道迁移的演化模型,检验高偏心率迁移(HEM)是否能解释亚海王星在不同年龄阶段的观测丰度变化。模型预测HEM在早期(~15 Myr)内快速填充近距亚海王星轨道,与年轻到中等年龄阶段的观测趋势基本一致,但无法再现中等年龄到老年期的丰度急剧下降,表明需要引入额外物理过程来完整解释亚海王星的长期演化。

2026-10-20.title: ALMA’s Sharpest View of IRAS 08544–4431: Unveiling the Dust Distribution Asymmetries in the Circumbinary Disk
2026-10-20.abstract: Abstract The interactions between post–asymptotic giant branch (post-AGB) binaries and their circumbinary disks play a central role in shaping the evolution of these systems. Circumbinary disks around post-AGB binaries are stable, though relatively short-lived, structures (10 4 −10 5 yr), and their physical properties and evolution remain poorly understood. In this study, we target IRAS 08544−4431, one of the best-studied post-AGB binaries. This system has well-constrained stellar and orbital parameters, exhibits well-defined characteristic refractory-depleted photospheric chemistry, and hosts a stable, sub-Keplerian circumbinary disk extending from a well-resolved sublimation rim at approximately 8 au to outer radii of approximately 1000 au. We probe the disk layers close to the midplane using Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) Band 7 continuum and 12 CO J = 3−2 observations of IRAS 08544−4431 obtained with baselines up to 16.2 km. These data provide the finest angular resolution as yet achieved with ALMA for dust-continuum observations of post-AGB binaries with an (almost) face-on disk (15 au; 10 mas). The resulting map of dust continuum enabled resolving disk inner rim, a largely smooth radial profile, and a prominent azimuthal asymmetry at a radius of ∼45 mas. Notably, the location of this dust asymmetry coincides with the forward-scattering peak reported in SPHERE/VLT observations of IRAS 08544−4431. The 12 CO emission is more extended than the dust continuum and confirms the disk rotation in this system. However, the global 12 CO map shows indications of a spatial offset from the dust asymmetry, suggesting some degree of gas–dust decoupling. Together, these observations establish IRAS 08544−4431 as a key laboratory for studying disk and dust evolution in a parameter space distinct from that of young stars with protoplanetary disks.
2026-10-20.summary_zh: 本研究利用ALMA高分辨率观测（角分辨率~15 au）揭示了post-AGB双星系统IRAS 08544−4431的环双星盘尘埃分布特征，在半径~45 mas处发现了显著的方位角不对称结构，该不对称性与SPHERE/VLT的前向散射峰位置相符。12CO气体发射比尘埃连续谱更加延伸，且存在空间偏移，表明存在气尘耦合不足的现象，为理解post-AGB系统中的盘和尘埃演化提供了重要的观测约束。

2026-10-20.title: A Clearer View of HAT-P-1 b: JWST NIRSpec G395H Reveals Water, Carbon Dioxide, and Possibly Hydrogen Sulfide
2026-10-20.abstract: Abstract As part of the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) Exoplanet Grand Tour Survey, we use panchromatic transmission spectroscopy to connect HAT-P-1 b’s previously studied optical and near-infrared atmosphere to the longer-wavelength molecular bands accessible with JWST. We present JWST Near-infrared Spectrograph G395H transmission spectroscopy of the hot Jupiter HAT-P-1 b over 2.7–5.3 μ m, and combine the new spectrum with archival Hubble Space Telescope Space Telescope Imaging Spectrograph and Wide Field Camera 3 observations for a 0.3–5.3 μ m atmospheric analysis. We independently reduce the JWST data with the Eureka! , FIREFLy , and Tswift pipelines, finding mutually consistent transmission spectra across the G395H bandpass. Atmospheric retrievals yield strong evidence for H 2 O and CO 2 with Bayes factors of log 10 B H 2 O = 8.9 and log 10 B CO 2 = 52.3 , while providing tentative evidence for H 2 S ( log 10 B H 2 S = 1.4 ). The joint H 2 O and CO 2 constraints favor an atmosphere near chemical equilibrium, with log 10 M/H = 0.9 9 − 0.14 + 0.19 , corresponding to ∼10× solar or ∼9× relative to the near-solar metallicity host star, and a 3 σ upper limit of C/O < 0.52. Because H 2 O and CO 2 provide a metallicity comparatively insensitive to vertical mixing in this temperature regime, their combined detection suggests the composition is dominated by bulk enrichment rather than strong disequilibrium transport. We find no significant evidence for clouds; instead, the persistence of molecular structure across the spectrum argues against strong cloud muting. The tentative H 2 S signal, if confirmed, would further suggest limited photochemical processing at the pressures probed. Together, the molecular inventory, enriched metallicity, and low C/O ratio point to an oxygen-rich atmosphere and establish HAT-P-1 b as a benchmark for comparative studies of hot Jupiter atmospheric composition.
2026-10-20.summary_zh: 本研究利用JWST NIRSpec G395H在2.7-5.3 μm波段对热木星HAT-P-1 b进行传输光谱观测，结合哈勃太空望远镜的光学和近红外数据进行0.3-5.3 μm的大气成分分析。大气反演强烈证实了H₂O和CO₂的存在（贝叶斯因子分别为8.9和52.3），并初步发现了H₂S的信号，指示该行星大气接近化学平衡状态，金属丰度约为太阳的10倍，C/O比< 0.52。这些观测结果表明HAT-P-1 b拥有富含氧的大气，主要由整体富集而非强烈的非平衡过程驱动，为热木星大气比较研究建立了重要基准。

2026-10-17.title: Singles in Disguise: Kepler's Low-SNR Single-Transiting Systems as Incompletely Detected Multis
2026-10-17.abstract: NASA's Kepler mission found more systems with one transiting planet (``singles'') than expected from those with several (``multis''). This excess was first taken as evidence for a Kepler dichotomy -- a second population of intrinsically single or highly inclined systems -- but later work argued that selection effects acting on a single population can reproduce it. Singles also show a puzzling excess of low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) detections relative to multis. The question arises whether this excess reflects false positives, a selection effect, or an inherent population difference. Here we show, using the ExoMOD population synthesis model and the Kepler DR25 catalog, that multis drawn from the same parent population as singles have shorter mean orbital periods, and thus higher-SNR detections on average. Detecting several planets in one system favors compact architectures, so long-period, low-SNR detections are preferentially cataloged as singles, most of them intrinsically multi-planet systems whose other planets went undetected. The low-SNR excess of singles therefore requires neither false positives nor a Kepler dichotomy but rather only the geometry and period sensitivity of transit detection.
2026-10-17.summary_zh: 本研究通过ExoMOD种群合成模型和开普勒DR25目录数据,揭示了开普勒单行星系统中低信噪比信号过量的真实原因:多行星系统倾向于具有更紧凑的轨道构型和更短的平均轨道周期,因此在观测中表现出更高的平均信噪比,而长周期低信噪比信号被优先性地编目为单行星系统,实际上大多为未被完全探测的多行星系统。该结果表明开普勒的单-多行星系统比例异常可完全由凌星探测的几何效应和周期敏感性解释,无需调用虚假正信号或开普勒二分性假说。

2026-10-17.title: Identifying deformed exoplanets with JWST and Ariel: A target selection metric for phase curve observations
2026-10-17.abstract: The shape of an exoplanet encodes fundamental information about its internal structure. For close-in giant planets, strong stellar tidal forces induce measurable deformations that can be probed through high-precision photometry. These deformations are quantified by the fluid Love numbers, which characterise a planet's response to external perturbations and are directly linked to its internal density distribution. In this work, we assess the potential of JWST and the future Ariel mission to constrain the Love numbers of hot Jupiters through full-orbit phase curve observations. To identify the most promising targets for this science case, we introduce a new detection metric, the deformation metric (D), which combines the expected deformation amplitude with the anticipated photometric signal-to-noise ratio. We apply this metric to the Ariel target list and identify WASP-33 b, WASP-76 b, and HAT-P-32 b as the three most favourable targets that currently lack Love number measurements. Using WASP-76 b as a benchmark case, we perform end-to-end retrieval simulations and show that a single continuous JWST phase curve observation can constrain the Love number $h_{2f}$ to a precision of $σ_{h_2f} \approx 0.09$, while a single Ariel visit could achieve $σ_{h_{2f}} \approx 0.18$. Such precision is likely sufficient for Love number measurements to provide meaningful constraints on planetary interior models and to distinguish between competing interior-structure scenarios, opening a new observational avenue for probing the deep interiors of exoplanets.
2026-10-17.summary_zh: 本研究通过开发变形度量D来评估JWST和Ariel任务通过全轨道相位曲线观测约束热木星流体Love数的潜力,该度量结合了预期的潮汐变形幅度与光度测量信噪比。针对Ariel目标表进行应用后,识别出WASP-33 b、WASP-76 b和HAT-P-32 b为最优目标,模型模拟表明JWST单次观测可将Love数h₂f约束精度达到σ_{h₂f}≈0.09,这足以对行星内部结构提供有意义的约束。

2026-10-17.title: Chemical Demographics of Star-forming Regions
2026-10-17.abstract: Our understanding of complex organic chemistry during the formation of stars and planets is shaped by a handful of cherry-picked sources with bright molecular emission lines. This observational bias impedes our assessment of how universal chemical complexity is during star formation. The lack of systematic wideband spectral surveys for statistically significant samples of protostars and cores is a major roadblock to properly probing how COM inventories and abundances depend on the vast range of physical conditions, local cloud and global galactic environments, and evolutionary timescales of low- and high-mass star formation. In turn, this limits our ability to constrain and test physicochemical models, which depend critically on these parameters. The next-generation ALMA2040, with a 10x improvement in line sensitivity, is required to observe COMs, that we perceive as common today, in a fraction of the observing time that is needed today with ALMA. Such capabilities will propel us into the era of chemical demographics, whereby wideband (>100 GHz) spectral surveys at high sensitivity (routinely probing COM abundances down to 0.01% relative to CH3OH) will be executed towards >1000-10000 prestellar and protostellar sources. With robust chemical inventories towards large source sample sizes, we will be able to probe for dependencies of chemical complexity on mass regime, feedback processes in a cluster, Galactic position, metallicity, and time-variable accretion. Only with statistically significant samples at high sensitivity will we be able to assess the ubiquity and homogeneity of COM chemistry across the protostellar mass spectrum and natal cores. Constraining the diversity and availability of such species is critical for our understanding of the chemical reservoir available for planet formation, which eventually shapes (exo)planetary atmosphere compositions.
2026-10-17.summary_zh: 该研究指出当前对恒星行星形成区复杂有机分子(COM)化学的理解受到观测偏差限制,缺乏对大样本原恒星和星核的系统光谱巡天导致无法准确评估COM丰度与物理条件、环境和演化时标的依赖关系。研究提出利用下一代ALMA2040开展大规模化学人口统计巡天,对数千个前星和原星源进行高灵敏度宽波段观测,以系统地探测COM化学复杂性在不同质量体系、星团反馈过程、银河位置和冶金度上的依赖性。这些统计上可靠的COM清单对理解行星形成过程中可用的化学成分库至关重要,将直接约束系外行星大气组成。

2026-10-17.title: A New Method for Constraining 3D Exoplanet Atmospheres: Application to WASP-94A b's Panchromatic Spectrum
2026-10-17.abstract: A growing number of transiting exoplanets exhibit spectroscopic evidence that their leading and trailing limbs differ. Interpreting these observations is now the limiting step. The standard approach of fitting limb-resolved transit depths results in highly anti-correlated transit depths, and treating them as independent measurements can result in strongly biased ($3σ$) retrieved molecular abundances. We present an inference framework that avoids these correlations by using the temporal signature of limb asymmetry instead. This wavelength-dependent shift in mid-transit time, or `time-shift spectrum', carries the limb-asymmetry information, is measurable from existing light curves with a spherically symmetric transit model, and is uncorrelated with the spherically-averaged transit depth. Simultaneously fitting the resulting transmission and time-shift spectrum with an independent atmospheric column for each limb enables the retrieval of limb-resolved properties from two independent measurements. We demonstrate that this approach reduces the mean squared error on the retrieved molecular abundances by factors of $\sim30-50$ relative to next best of the alternative approaches currently adopted in the field, and improves retrieved abundance precision by $\sim3-6\times$. We apply the framework to WASP-94A b and present its panchromatic limb-resolved spectrum, spanning 0.8-5~$μ$m and combining NIRISS/SOSS and NIRSpec/G395H observations. The planet's morning limb remains aerosol-obscured across this entire range, while its evening limb constrains the abundances of H$_2$O, CO$_2$, CO, and H$_2$S. We measure a limb-to-limb temperature difference of $415\pm58$~K at 1~mbar. This limb-resolved analysis finds [M/H]=+0.32$^{+0.11}_{-0.11}$ and C/O=0.724$^{+0.013}_{-0.013}$, consistent with the host star.
2026-10-17.summary_zh: 本研究针对系外行星大气昼夜不对称观测的解释问题，提出了一个新的推断框架，通过测量凌日时间随波长的偏移（时间-偏移谱）来避免传统跛足深度拟合中的反相关性，从而将分子丰度的检索精度提高3-6倍。以WASP-94A b为应用案例，结合NIRISS/SOSS和NIRSpec/G395H观测数据，首次获得了0.8-5 μm的全景肢部分辨谱，揭示了其晨昏两侧显著不同的气溶胶分布和温度差异（415±58 K），测得的金属丰度与主星一致。

2026-10-17.title: ALMA2040: Submillimeter-wave Limb Sounding of Venus and Mars
2026-10-17.abstract: Venus and Mars are unique laboratories for understanding the evolution and diversity of terrestrial planets. Despite their broadly similar rocky compositions, their atmospheres, climates, and surface environments have evolved into dramatically different states. Understanding the physical and chemical processes responsible for these divergent pathways is essential for interpreting terrestrial exoplanets and their habitability. By the 2040s, spacecraft missions will provide unprecedented close-up observations of Venus and Mars, while ground-based facilities can provide the long-term monitoring needed to place these snapshots in the context of atmospheric variability and planetary-scale circulation. ALMA2040 can uniquely bridge these two approaches by combining high-resolution submillimeter heterodyne spectroscopy with routinely accessible, extremely high angular resolution. In particular, high-resolution limb sounding would enable vertically resolved measurements of atmospheric winds, temperature, and trace species from the ground. An angular resolution of approximately 0.01" would allow spatial scales comparable to the atmospheric scale heights of Venus (around 5 km) and Mars (around 11 km) to be resolved. This capability would enable three-dimensional studies of Venusian upper-atmospheric circulation and Martian global dust storms, as well as systematic investigations of CO2 photochemistry, water loss through HDO/H2O fractionation, and Venusian sulfur chemistry and cloud formation. By repeatedly observing different local times, seasons, and solar-activity conditions, ALMA2040 would extend spacecraft measurements from snapshots to long-term four-dimensional characterization. It would therefore provide a unique observational framework for directly connecting spacecraft discoveries with the temporal and spatial evolution of planetary atmospheres.
2026-10-17.summary_zh: 本研究提出利用升级后的ALMA进行金星和火星的亚毫米波掩星观测，通过高角分辨率（~0.01角秒）实现大气的垂直分层测量。该方法能够以行星大气标高（金星5 km，火星11 km）的空间分辨率，获得风场、温度和痕量物种的三维分布，从而在2040年代为航天器的瞬间观测提供长期地面监测支持，深入研究金星上层大气环流、火星全球沙尘暴、CO2光化学、水汽流失和硫化学等过程。

2026-10-17.title: Chemistry on solar system scales
2026-10-17.abstract: The initial chemical composition of planets, primitive bodies in our solar system, and exoplanets is ultimately set by their nascent protoplanetary disks. Yet observing key carbon-, oxygen-, and nitrogen-bearing molecules (as well as rarer but important sulphur- and phosphorus-bearing species) in the inner (exo)planet-forming zone ($\lesssim 10$~au) remains extremely challenging with current facilities. Therefore, to construct a complete picture of the chemistry of planet formation and understand how (exo)planetary composition is set by physical and chemical processes within the protoplanetary disk, a more powerful observing facility, i.e., ALMA2040, is needed. Compared to current ALMA (the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array) this new facility must provide >~ a factor of 10 in line sensitivity at a spatial resolution of <~ 5 au at 140 pc, i.e., a factor of 3 - 4 better resolution to low surface brightness emission than currently possible. This distance includes many star-forming regions such as Taurus and Lupus that are host to populations of Sun-like stars. ALMA2040 will enable mapping of disk chemical composition on terrestrial planet-forming scales (within the water snowline) and detect molecules that are the feedstock for potentially habitable worlds.
2026-10-17.summary_zh: 本研究探讨原行星盘内的化学组成如何决定行星和系外行星的初始化学成分，特别是碳、氧、氮及硫、磷等关键分子在内行星形成区的分布。研究采用观测天文学方法，通过对比当前ALMA设备的观测能力与所需的ALMA2040设施需求，提出需要在灵敏度和空间分辨率上分别提高10倍和3-4倍才能在行星尺度上解析原盘化学结构。主要结论表明，下一代观测设施ALMA2040将能够绘制类地行星形成区内的化学成分分布图，探测潜在宜居世界的物质前驱体，从而完整理解行星成分的物理化学调控机制。

2026-10-17.title: Multi-wavelength Polarization as a Probe of Planet Formation
2026-10-17.abstract: Polarization reveals details of circumstellar disks that are not readily available from total intensity observations. Via multi-wavelength polarimetric observations of disks, we can trace how planets form, how dust grains evolve at the onset of planet formation, and how magnetic fields (B-fields) influence accretion. Since polarized emission from these disks is typically at levels from 0.5% to a few percent of the total emission, very high sensitivities are needed. Current ALMA capabilities make these key measurements of protoplanetary disks challenging due to (1) long integrations with separate observations to measure multi-wavelength polarization of substructures, (2) prohibitive time requests to observe large samples of disks, (3) limited sensitivity and frequency coverage for polarization in spectral lines; and (4) insufficient calibration of polarization in all the Stokes parameters. An ALMA2040 with large collecting area, increased bandwidth with multi-band capabilities, and accurate polarization calibration will provide a great leap in our understanding of the formation of protoplanets through polarization. Specifically, such an ALMA2040 can use polarized emission from the continuum and spectral lines to: (A) provide stringent tests of streaming instabilities; (B) accurately constrain grain shape, size, porosity, and alignment; (C) resolve polarization of substructures for a large sample of disks with resolutions less than 5 au; (D) quickly survey 100s of disks; and (E) measure the B-field strength and morphology of disks.
2026-10-17.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了多波长偏振观测作为揭示行星形成过程的探针，能够追踪原行星盘中的行星形成、尘埃演化和磁场对吸积的影响。当前ALMA在观测盘结构偏振特征时面临长积分时间、样本观测时间成本高、谱线偏振敏感度不足等挑战，而升级后的ALMA2040通过更大的集光面积、多波段能力和精确的偏振定标，将能够通过连续波和谱线偏振测量精确约束流动不稳定性、尘埃物理性质和磁场结构，从而显著推进对原行星形成的理解。

2026-10-17.title: Planetary system architectures in the final stages of planet formation
2026-10-17.abstract: The processes in the last stages of planet formation determine the final assembly and composition of planets. After the protoplanetary discs dissipate, a system of planets and planetesimals -- analogues of the Asteroid and Kuiper Belts -- remains. Ongoing collisions between these bodies produce second-generation dust and gas that form a debris disc. Resolved images of such belts allow us to trace the dynamical history of these systems, including giant impacts and planet-belt interactions, during the crucial era from 10 to a few 100 Myr of terrestrial planet formation. High-resolution mm and optical/near-IR imagers have revolutionised our view of the brightest planetesimal belts, providing first glimpses of diverse structures, many of which show plausible planet imprints, while ALMA has revealed gas in a growing number of systems. Yet these results are strongly biased toward the brightest, mostly young belts around early-type stars, and even for these, crucial details remain undetectable at the required resolution due to their typically low surface brightness. A future (sub-)mm facility with an order of magnitude leap in continuum sensitivity and 10x higher line sensitivity would transform our understanding of late-stage planet formation by enabling the first statistically meaningful surveys of faint outer planetesimal belts across all spectral types, imaging planetary collisions in the inner regions of planetary systems, and gas measurements that trace volatile delivery to terrestrial planets. For the first time, this would reach the faint majority of belts, rather than only the rare bright discs accessible today.
2026-10-17.summary_zh: 本研究综述了行星形成末期的系统动力学特征，通过分析碎屑盘的结构来追踪行星-小行星相互作用、巨大碰撞等关键过程，揭示10-几百Myr时间尺度内类地行星的装配历史。当前高分辨率观测虽已检测到多个系统中的行星动力学印迹和气体成分，但主要限于亮源年轻系统，对暗弱盘层的覆盖严重不足。未来次毫米设施通过显著提升灵敏度，将首次实现对全光谱类型外围小行星带的统计调查，并能直接成像行星碰撞过程和测量挥发物传输，从而系统揭示晚期行星形成的多样性动力学机制。

2026-10-17.title: Planet formation on solar system scales
2026-10-17.abstract: Giant planets are often regarded as primordial protoplanetary "architects". Their formation and interactions with planetesimals and other planets during and after the protoplanetary disc phase are key to setting the blueprint of the planetary systems we observe today. Catching nascent gas giants is our best opportunity to uncover these crucial steps in the planet formation process and shed light on the origins of our own solar system. Over the last decade, ALMA has revolutionised our understanding of planet formation; still, detecting signatures of Jupiter-like planets has remained out of reach. We argue that ALMA2040, a next-generation sub(mm) interferometer with improved sensitivity ($\times25$ in the continuum and $\times10$ for line emission) and a $\times3$ higher angular resolution compared to ALMA, will be sensitive to (sub)mm emission around a forming Jupiter-like planet orbiting a Sun-like star within $150\,{\rm pc}$ and allow kinematically characterising interactions of Jovian and sub-Jovian planets with their natal disc. ALMA2040 will provide unique and unprecedented insights into how gas giants carve gaps, accrete material, form satellites, and affect the architectures of their co-evolving planetary systems.
2026-10-17.summary_zh: 本研究针对巨行星形成过程中与原行星盘和其他天体的相互作用如何决定行星系统结构这一关键问题,提出利用下一代亚毫米干涉仪ALMA2040观测木星级气态巨星形成过程的方法。通过灵敏度提升25倍(连续波)和10倍(线发射)以及角分辨率提高3倍,ALMA2040将能够检测150 pc内类日恒星周围类木星行星的(亚)毫米辐射,动力学表征巨行星与原行星盘的相互作用,从而揭示气态巨星如何开凿间隙、吸积物质、形成卫星和影响行星系统架构的过程。

2026-10-17.title: WALTzER: Wide-band Atmospheric Laboratory for Transiting Exoplanet Research
2026-10-17.abstract: Understanding the origin and evolution of planetary atmospheres, and the connection between their lower and upper atmospheric layers, remains a fundamental challenge in exoplanet science. Addressing these questions requires observations spanning a broad wavelength range, from the ultraviolet to the near-infrared, together with the ability to simultaneously characterise planetary and stellar variability. The Wide-band Atmospheric Laboratory for Transiting Exoplanet Research (WALTzER) is an ESA F3 mission candidate designed to address this need through simultaneous low-resolution spectroscopy and high-precision photometry of transiting exoplanets. WALTzER covers simultaneously the near-ultraviolet (NUV: 240--325 nm) and visible (VIS: 450--820 nm) bands with two medium resolution spectrographs and the near-infrared (NIR: 900--1700 nm) range with a broadband photometer. We outline the main science drivers and present the mission concept and instrument design. WALTzER's broad, simultaneous wavelength coverage enables the detection and characterisation of the atmospheres of more than 30 gas-rich exoplanets and provides data relevant for a broad range of Solar System and Galactic astrophysics science cases. The payload consists of a 35 cm Cassegrain telescope feeding three co-aligned channels (i.e. NUV, VIS, NIR), sharing a common optical train to minimise instrumental systematics, while maximising observational efficiency.
2026-10-17.summary_zh: WALTzER任务通过在紫外到近红外波段(240-1700 nm)同时进行低分辨率光谱和高精度测光,研究凌星系外行星大气的起源、演化及其上下层大气之间的联系。该任务搭载35 cm卡塞格林望远镜和三个共轴光学通道,能够表征30多颗富气体系外行星的大气特性,同时最小化仪器系统误差。这一宽波段同步观测能力为研究行星大气的多层结构和大气损耗机制提供关键数据。

2026-10-17.title: A first look at the protoplanet WISPIT 2 b with VLTI/GRAVITY+
2026-10-17.abstract: Confirmed observations of young protoplanets actively undergoing the process of formation have remained rare to date. In this Letter, we present new insights into the nature of the recently identified protoplanet WISPIT 2 b (age $\sim$ 5 Myr) from VLTI/GRAVITY+ observations. Through the analysis of the spectral energy distribution (SED) and astrometry of WISPIT 2 b, with the inclusion of new GRAVITY+ data, we investigate the nature of the protoplanet's thermal emission and orbital properties. We performed an orbit fit with the inclusion of new high-precision GRAVITY+ astrometry to provide an updated orbital solution. We also analyzed the medium resolution GRAVITY+ K band spectrum in combination with new VLT/SPHERE and literature photometry, exploring both the atmospheric properties and the constraints on the circumplanetary environment. Finally, we checked for any signal from a resolved circumplanetary disk in the GRAVITY+ data. We detected the protoplanet WISPIT 2 b at $\sim$322 mas separation from its host star. The new GRAVITY+ astrometry prefers an orbit with a moderate eccentricity. Analysis of the SED reveals an effective temperature in the 900 to 1300 K regime and a slight preference for atmospheric models including clouds over pure blackbody emission. While the GRAVITY+ observations do also not resolve a circumplanetary disk, we place an upper limit on the possible spatial extent of such a disk. The new GRAVITY+ observations independently confirm WISPIT 2 b as a self-luminous and point-like companion residing inside the gap of the transitional disk at $\sim$60 au from its host star. Further observations - either at higher signal-to-noise ratio or at longer wavelengths - are required to characterize the atmosphere and examine the presence of circumplanetary material from thermal emission of the dust.
2026-10-17.summary_zh: 本研究利用VLTI/GRAVITY+对年轻原行星WISPIT 2 b（年龄~5 Myr）进行了首次详细观测，通过光谱能量分布分析、高精度测天和K波段谱线研究，确定了该原行星的有效温度（900-1300 K）、轨道离心率和大气性质。研究结果独立确认了WISPIT 2 b是一个自发光的点状伴星，位于过渡盘间隙内距主星~60 au处，虽未直接探测到环行星盘但给出了其空间范围的上限。

2026-10-17.title: Photometric Study of the Fastest-rotating Near-Earth Asteroid 2024 XA1
2026-10-17.abstract: Abstract Near-Earth asteroid 2024 XA1 was discovered on 2024 December 3 at 05:55 UT by the 2.3 m Bok Telescope of the University of Arizona. At 07:50 UT on the same day, subsequent orbit refinement confirmed a 100% impact probability, with atmospheric entry predicted at approximately 16:15 UT over eastern Siberia. We obtained observations of 2024 XA1 with the Lijiang 2.4 m telescope in the final ∼1 hr prior to its atmospheric entry. Due to the fact that sidereal tracking was used, the asteroid appears as a long bright trail in each exposure. We developed a method to extract light curves from asteroid trails in such trailed images and evaluate the reconstruction quality by comparing the observed trail image with the model image generated from the recovered light curve. Applying this approach to 2024 XA1 we successfully extracted its light curve. We found that the light curves of 2024 XA1 exhibit a double-peaked structure with two maxima and two minima per cycle. We derived a double-peaked rotation period of P rot = 1.6 3 − 0.04 + 0.06 s and a peak-to-peak relative flux amplitude of about 46%. This period would make 2024 XA1 the fastest-rotating near-Earth object currently known.
2026-10-17.summary_zh: 我们对近地小行星2024 XA1进行了测光观测研究,通过开发新方法从恒星追踪模式下的拖尾图像中提取光变曲线。研究结果表明该小行星具有双峰光变结构,自转周期为1.63±0.05秒,相对亮度振幅约46%,使其成为目前已知自转最快的近地天体。

2026-10-17.title: TOI-1408: A Metal-rich Star with Lithium Overabundance Hosting a Multi-planet System.
2026-10-17.abstract: Abstract TOI-1408 is recognised as a star hosting at least two planets: the hot Jupiter TOI-1408b and the inner sub-Neptune TOI-1408c. Using high-resolution spectra with a high signal-to-noise ratio (S/N ∼ 350) and resolving power ranging from λ/Δλ = 52, 000 to 115,000, we refined the star’s fundamental parameters. The derived values are Teff = 6340 ± 40 K, log g = 4.3 ± 0.1, vturb = 1.4 ± 0.1 km s−1, and [Fe/H] = +0.26 ± 0.10 dex. We determined the abundances of 12 chemical elements in the stellar atmosphere, accounting for deviations from local thermodynamic equilibrium. For most elements, the abundance excess relative to the solar value is comparable, except for copper and particularly lithium, which show significantly higher excesses of +0.38 dex and +1.46 dex, respectively. The latter corresponds to an absolute abundance A(Li)=2.44, roughly 30 times the solar value adopted in this study (A(Li)⊙ = 0.98). This combination of high metallicity and extreme lithium overabundance is rare among planet-hosting stars with Teff > ∼6200 K. We found no evidence of accretion of a rocky planet’s material onto the central star based on the correlation of abundance with the condensation temperature of chemical elements. The structural modelling reveals a shallow, cool convective envelope that preserves lithium from destruction, providing a natural explanation for the observed overabundance.
2026-10-17.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-10-17.summary_zh: 本研究通过高分辨率高信噪比光谱分析TOI-1408星系的恒星参数和化学丰度,确定该金属丰富恒星([Fe/H]=+0.26 dex)具有极端锂超丰(A(Li)=2.44,约为太阳值的30倍),这种高金属性与极端锂超丰的组合在温度高于6200 K的宜居星中极为罕见。通过凝聚温度-丰度关联分析排除了行星撞击吸积的可能,结构模型表明浅层冷对流包层的存在能有效保存锂元素,解释了观测到的锂超丰现象,为多行星系统宿主星的演化机制研究提供了新的约束。

2026-10-16.title: A Search for Dust in the Outflow of the HH212 Class 0 Protostellar System
2026-10-16.abstract: Perhaps the most visually striking phenomenon during star formation is the ejection of material along the direction of the protostar's rotational axis. Observed in the form of molecular outflows and/or atomic jets, these features carry away mass, energy and angular momentum from the system. Given the known dust content of protoplanetary disks, and the energetics of outflows, it has been suggested that it should be possible to lift dust from disks via winds, yet limited observational evidence has been presented in the literature. Any detection of dust within protostellar outflows not only puts constraints on the dust content in outflows, but if a sufficient amount of dust can be removed from the system, the mass budget for planet formation could also be affected. We present re-imaging of archival, multi-frequency dust continuum observations taken with the Atacama Large Millimeter/sub-millimeter Array (ALMA) towards the HH212 protostellar system. We detect an extension in the dust emission, and using multi-frequency data in Bands 7 and 9, we estimate the spectral index of the emitting dust and the dust mass in the wind launching region. We find a small but still significant amount of dust mass coincident with the molecular outflow cavity. This finding is assessed in relation to the hypothesis that the outflow could be capable of transporting dust away from the HH212 protoplanetary disk.
2026-10-16.summary_zh: 本研究通过ALMA多频段尘埃连续谱观测，在HH212原恒星系统的分子外流腔中检测到尘埃辐射延伸，并利用第7和第9波段数据估计了尘埃的谱指数和风启动区的尘埃质量。研究发现外流区存在可观的尘埃质量，表明原恒星外流具有将尘埃从原行星盘中驱出的能力，这可能影响该系统的行星形成物质预算。

2026-10-16.title: Planet forming disk populations and their connection to the environment
2026-10-16.abstract: Existing sub-mm observatories such as ALMA have provided statistics on the planet-forming mass reservoirs within circumstellar disks around stars in stellar clusters out to distances of $\sim$400pc. However, these disks are not where most planets form. Many stars, and hence planets, form in more massive clusters, which are only found at larger distances. Environmental conditions that affect disks - such as UV radiation field, ambient gaseous mass reservoir, and stellar density - change significantly as a function of cluster mass, implying that our current knowledge of the disk population from current facilities is severely biased. Characterising planet formation in stellar clusters towards the peak of the cluster mass function requires determining the distribution of planet forming disk masses out to $\sim$3kpc, which encapsulates the nearby parts of the Sagittarius arm of the Milky Way and contains multiple massive stellar clusters. ALMA2040 will provide the leap in sensitivity needed to move beyond detections of only a handful of disks and robustly measure the slope and median of the disk mass distribution at these distances. This will mark the transition from studying individual detections to population-level studies of planet formation across diverse cluster environments. This has synergy with existing and upcoming measurements of accretion rates in these distant clusters, which combined provide a measure of the accretion timescale, enabling us to distinguish various evolutionary pathways and assess how they depend on cluster mass and star-forming environment.
2026-10-16.summary_zh: 本研究旨在表征不同恒星团环境中的行星形成盘种群分布，通过推断其与团质量的关联来理解环境条件（紫外辐射、气体储量、恒星密度）对盘演化的影响。研究采用ALMA2040的增强灵敏度，将观测范围扩展至3kpc距离内的大质量恒星团，以获得统计意义上的盘质量分布（斜率和中值），超越当前仅能检测少量盘的限制。结合吸积率测量，该工作将揭示不同团质量和星形成环境下行星形成的多样演化途径及其物理机制。

2026-10-16.title: HD 152384: A 5 Myr old debris disk system showing a gaseous ring of refractory elements at the dust sublimation radius
2026-10-16.abstract: Context: Circumstellar gas around young stars provides key insights into planet formation and disk evolution. HD 152384, a young (5 Myr) A0 V star in Sco-Cen, shows hybrid-disk traits: a modest infrared excess from small dust grains and atomic emission lines dominated by refractory elements, but its disk structure and origin remain unclear. Aims: We characterise the kinematics and excitation of the circumstellar gas around HD 152384 and constrain the physical properties of its emitting region. Methods: We use new high-resolution optical and near-infrared VLT/UVES and VLT/CRIRES spectra to re-examine the circumstellar environment of HD 152384, previously suggested to host a broad, gas-rich disk. Results: The observations reveal 74 narrow, double-peaked emission lines of Fe, Mg, Si, and Ca, with similar profiles and a 103 km/s peak separation. Keplerian modelling places the gas in a geometrically thin ring at 0.09-0.12 au, close to the dust sublimation radius (0.10-0.14 au for a sublimation temperature of about 1500 K). The Fe I emission is optically thick, whereas the optically thin Mg I lines imply 2.2 x 10^22 kg (3.6 x 10^-3 Earth masses) of magnesium gas in the ring. Conclusions: The dust and gas properties are consistent with a secondary origin involving collisions of rocky planetesimals. We propose that small collision-produced dust grains spiral inward and sublimate near the dust sublimation radius, accumulating atomic gas there. HD 152384 thus represents a young analogue of gas-bearing debris disks such as Beta Pictoris and gaseous debris disks around metal-polluted white dwarfs, offering a new window on the early violent processing of rocky planetesimals.
2026-10-16.summary_zh: 本研究通过VLT高分辨率光谱观测HD 152384（5 Myr年轻A型星）的环星气体，利用Keplerian运动学模型揭示了74条窄双峰发射线来自距星0.09-0.12 au处的几何薄气环，该位置恰好对应尘埃升华半径。通过光学厚度分析和金属丰度测量，研究表明该系统的气体和尘埃来自岩质行星小体碰撞产生，碰撞尘埃向内螺旋运动至升华半径处积聚，为理解早期行星体内的暴力动力学过程提供了新的观测窗口。

2026-10-16.title: Extremely Low Mass Ratio Contact Binaries. III. Photometric and Spectroscopic Investigations of 11 Systems
2026-10-16.abstract: Abstract We present photometric and spectroscopic investigations of 11 totally eclipsing contact binaries with mass ratios below 0.15, classifying them as extremely low mass ratio contact binaries. The ground-based multiband light curves were modeled with PHysics Of Eclipsing BinariEs to derive the photometric parameters of these systems. The Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) light curves of J011323 and J002747 show pronounced asymmetries and continuous variations. Markov Chain Monte Carlo modeling suggests that these variations are related to longitudinal migration of spots on the primary components. Spectral subtraction of the Large Sky Area Multi-Object Fiber Spectroscopic Telescope (LAMOST) spectra reveals excess chromospheric emission in six systems, while no detectable excess emission is found in the other five. The O − C analysis indicates secular period increases in six systems and secular decreases in five systems. We estimated their orbital angular momenta and performed a dynamical analysis. Within our adopted semianalytical framework without energy transfer, the formation of these observed systems requires additional angular momentum loss beyond saturated magnetic braking and gravitational radiation, but this requirement could be modified by different assumptions on mass transfer or radius evolution.
2026-10-16.summary_zh: 本研究通过多波段地基光度观测和LAMOST光谱数据对11个极低质量比接触双星系统进行了详细调查，利用PHysics Of Eclipsing BinariEs程序模型化光变曲线以获取光度参数，并通过TESS高精度数据揭示了主星表面黑子的经度迁移现象。O-C分析和轨道动力学计算表明这些系统的轨道周期呈现长期增加或减少的趋势，其形成机制需要超过饱和磁制动和引力辐射的额外角动量损失过程。

2026-10-16.title: Mapping Molecular Ion Distributions in a Diverse Sample of Protoplanetary Disks
2026-10-16.abstract: Abstract Observations of ionization-tracing molecules in protoplanetary disks suggest that their ionization environments are diverse due to varying degrees of cosmic-ray modulation, stellar activity, and environmental differences that alter the impact of ionizing radiation. To better understand ionization chemistry in disks, we present the largest survey of resolved observations of molecular ions to date. Using new and archival Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array observations we detect HCO + , H 13 CO + , N 2 H + , and DCO + toward seven protoplanetary disks (AS 209, DM Tau, GM Aur, HD 163296, LkCa 15, MWC 480, and V4046 Sgr). We compare distributions of ions to continuum features and find no robust relationships between the two. The observations do, however, reveal distinctions between Herbigs and T Tauris and hint at a dichotomy between two types of T Tauri ionization environments. The Herbig sources exhibit unique centrally peaked N 2 H + J = 4−3 emission, which we speculate could be tracing either a highly ionized surface layer or a zone of CO destruction, possibly due to their strong UV fields. Three T Tauri sources in our sample exhibit bright, radially coincident rings in all optically thin molecular ion lines. We speculate that these radially coincident ion rings are evidence of a global change in ionization, possibly at the edge of a “T Tauriosphere.” While it is not yet clear what factors most strongly influence the distribution of ion emission, this survey more than doubles the number of resolved ion observations in disks and points to potential distinctions in ion emission morphology related to the central star and environment.
2026-10-16.summary_zh: 本研究通过ALMA对7个原行星盘进行了迄今最大规模的分子离子分辨观测调查,检测了HCO+、H13CO+、N2H+和DCO+的分布情况。研究发现分子离子分布与连续谱特征无明显相关性,但揭示了Herbig星与T Tauri星之间的显著差异,包括Herbig源独特的中心峰N2H+发射和部分T Tauri源存在径向一致的离子环结构。这些观测结果表明,原行星盘的电离环境受中心星性质和环境因素的强烈影响,可能存在不同的电离机制。

2026-10-16.title: Dynamical Tides during High-eccentricity Migration Produce the Hot-Jupiter Pileup, Neptune Ridge, and Neptune Desert
2026-10-16.abstract: Abstract The period distribution of hot gaseous exoplanets depends strongly on mass. Clustering between the orbital periods of ∼3 to ∼5–6 days is seen for sub-Saturns (“Neptune ridge”) and Jovians (“hot-Jupiter pileup”), contrasting with a sharp deficit interior to 3 days for sub-Saturns, not seen for Jovians (“Neptune desert”). During high-eccentricity migration, tidally excited fundamental-modes ( f -modes) act as a reservoir for orbital energy, and can take gaseous planets formed beyond several astronomical units and place them at short separations. However, how f -modes relinquish their energy into the planet interior is unknown. Here, we show how f -modes can not only circularize orbits—causing clustering near the Neptune ridge and hot-Jupiter pileup—but can also shock and unbind mass, leaving sub-Saturn cores in the Neptune desert. Our hydrodynamical simulations demonstrate that close approaches tidally excite f -modes, whose supersonic velocities shock gaseous envelopes. Atmospheres cool by radiative diffusion or winds when shocks penetrate shallow versus deep depths. Planetary structural and orbital evolution is followed over many periastron passages using an iterative map: shocks that diffusively cool circularize and bunch orbits near the hot-Jupiter pileup and Neptune ridge, while shocks that drive outflows unbind envelopes and place gas-giant cores in the Neptune desert. Sub-Saturns that dwell in the desert are predicted to arrive with large spin–orbit misalignments after producing luminous flares.
2026-10-16.summary_zh: 本研究探究高偏心率迁移过程中动力潮汐对热木星轨道分布的影响机制。通过三维流体动力学模拟，展示了潮汐激发的基本模式（f-modes）如何通过激发行星大气中的超声速冲击，在不同冷却条件下产生不同结果：扩散冷却导致轨道圆化并聚集在热木星堆积和海王星岭附近，而风驱动的外流则剥离大气使行星核心停留在海王星沙漠区。该机制统一解释了不同行星质量间的周期分布差异，并预言沙漠中的亚土星应具有大的自转轨道倾角并产生明亮耀斑。

2026-10-16.title: Data-driven Modeling of Telluric Features and Stellar Variability with StellarSpectraObservationFitting.jl
2026-10-16.abstract: Abstract A significant barrier to achieving the radial velocity (RV) measurement accuracy and precision required to characterize terrestrial mass exoplanets is the existence of time-variable features in the measured spectra, from both telluric absorption and stellar variability, which affect measured line shapes and can cause apparent RV shifts. Reaching submillisecond accuracy using traditional techniques often requires avoiding lines contaminated by stellar variability and/or changing tellurics, and thus discarding a large fraction of the spectrum, lowering precision. New data-driven methods can help achieve extremely precise and accurate RVs by enabling the use of a larger fraction of the available data. While there exist methods for modeling telluric features or the stellar variability individually, there is a need for additional tools that are capable of modeling them simultaneously at the spectral level. Here, we present StellarSpectraObservationFitting.jl ( SSOF ), a Julia package for measuring Doppler shifts and creating data-driven models (with fast, physically motivated Gaussian Process regularization) for the time-variable spectral features for both the telluric transmission and stellar spectrum, while accounting for the wavelength-dependent instrumental line spread function. We demonstrate SSOF ’s state-of-the-art performance on data from the NEID spectrometer on the WIYN 3.5 m Telescope for multiple stars. We show SSOF ’s ability to accurately identify and characterize spectral variability, provide ∼2–6× smaller photon-limited errors over the NEID CCF-based pipeline, and match the performance of SERVAL , a leading template-based pipeline, using only observed EPRV spectra.
2026-10-16.summary_zh: 本研究开发了StellarSpectraObservationFitting.jl软件包，通过数据驱动方法同时建模恒星光谱中的遥测特征和恒星变率，采用高斯过程正则化在光谱级别联合拟合时变特征，从而能够利用更大比例的可用光谱数据。在NEID分光器数据上的验证表明，该方法相比基于CCF的传统流程可降低2-6倍的光子噪声误差，达到亚毫秒级的径向速度精度，有效支持类地系外行星的探测。

2026-10-16.title: Spectroscopy of TESS selected hot variable stars
2026-10-16.abstract: Abstract We report spectral types for over 300 stars selected as candidate hot subdwarf stars and shown to be variable by data from the Terrestrial Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS). Atmospheric parameters determined from low dispersion spectrograms are provided for many of the targets. In our sample, we find 164 sdB stars, 77 sdB binaries, 21 cataclysmic variables, and small numbers of main sequence, white dwarf, sdO, sdOB and intermediate helium rich subdwarf stars. Several stars appear rather peculiar and are discussed in more detail; TIC 360220395, for example, appears to be an old planetary nebula nucleus.
2026-10-16.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-10-16.summary_zh: 本研究通过TESS卫星数据筛选了300余颗热变星候选体，利用低色散分光法测定其光谱类型和大气参数。样本中包含164颗sdB星、77颗sdB双星、21颗激变变星等，其中TIC 360220395等特殊天体可能是老行星星云核。这一谱学巡查为研究紧密双星系统、白矮星冷却过程及相关行星动力学环境提供了重要的恒星参数基础。

2026-10-15.title: LiDO: The Large inclination Distant Objects Survey
2026-10-15.abstract: Previous trans-Neptunian objects (TNOs) discovery surveys targeted the ecliptic plane, where the overall highest density is seen. High-inclination objects spend little time near the plane, and are thus under-represented in previous TNO surveys. The Large inclination Distant Objects (LiDO) survey targets these high-inclination populations in 34 sq.deg., located in two blocks 14-21 degrees north and south of the ecliptic plane, finding 148 objects, all with i>14 degrees due to survey design. A careful characterization of detection efficiency and other survey parameters results in a "characterized sample" of 125 objects detected within the survey's magnitude and rate limits, thus suitable for model comparison via survey simulations.
