LiDO detected 62 TNOs classified as resonant, including 21 Plutinos, of which 12 are securely Kozai resonators (always coming to pericenter off-ecliptic), as well as 9 objects in the 5:2 resonance, and several mixed mode inclination-eccentricity resonators. No objects beyond 63 au were detected, despite sensitivity to objects as far as 150 au. We found that the i>14 degree orbital distribution of the previous model from OSSOS was rejectable with the inclusion of the 38 characterized hot classical TNOs from LiDO. We constructed a proof-of-concept orbital distribution model of hot classical TNOs based on long-term stability sculpting, which is statistically acceptable for the LiDO and OSSOS samples, while producing population estimates (21,000$^{+3000}_{-3000}$ hot classicals with H_r<8.3) consistent with OSSOS estimates. The discovery of 125 characterized mid-to-high inclination objects in a variety of orbital classifications provides useful constraints for population modeling and the migration history of the Solar System.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: LiDO调查针对高倾角的海王星外天体(TNOs)进行了系统巡天,在远离黄道面14-21度范围内发现148个倾角>14°的天体,其中包含62个共振天体和大量Kozai谐振子。通过详细的探测效率表征和调查模拟,获得了125个可用于模型对比的特征化样本。研究结果表明基于长期稳定性雕刻机制的轨道分布模型能够解释高倾角冷古典TNOs的观测结果,并为太阳系移动历史和TNOs种群演化提供了关键约束。

2026-10-15.title: Emission spectroscopy of KELT-2A b with Gemini-North/IGRINS-2: hints of a stellar C/O ratio and sub-stellar metallicity
2026-10-15.abstract: We present the results of high-resolution emission spectroscopy of the hot Jupiter KELT-2A~b using IGRINS-2 on the Gemini-North telescope, covering the $H$- and $K$-bands at a spectral resolution of $R \sim 45{,}000$. Observations were carried out over five nights, covering both pre- and post-eclipse orbital phases. Stellar and telluric contaminations are removed via singular value decomposition. We detect $\rm H_2O$ at a signal-to-noise ratio of {6.57}, confirming the previous result at a higher significance. While $\rm ^{12}CO$ is identified in the log-likelihood map near the expected planetary velocity, a definitive detection of $\rm ^{12}CO$ remains elusive given the current data quality. We perform atmospheric retrieval both with IGRINS-2 data alone and jointly with archival \textit{Spitzer}/IRAC photometric data points. The retrieved temperature--pressure profile is non-inverted, consistent with prior observations. {From the joint fit we constrain the water abundance to} $\rm log(H_2O) = {-3.78^{+0.27}_{-0.20}}$ {with the free chemistry model}. {The chemical equilibrium model yields} $\rm C/O={ 0.19^{+0.12}_{-0.07}}$, $\rm [C/H]=-0.81^{+0.41}_{-0.34}$, and $\rm [O/H] = -0.37^{+0.27}_{-0.17}${: the C/O ratio agrees with the stellar value, while the carbon and oxygen abundances are moderately depleted relative to the host star, though still consistent at the $\sim2σ$ level.} If confirmed, {this combination of a stellar C/O ratio with a sub-stellar metallicity is difficult to reconcile with gas accretion between the $\rm{H_2O}$ and CO snowlines, which predicts a super-stellar C/O. It instead points to the accretion of metal-depleted gas outside the CO snowline with only limited planetesimal enrichment, and hence to a disk-free, high-eccentricity migration history.}
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究利用Gemini-North/IGRINS-2高分辨率发射光谱观测热木星KELT-2A b，在H和K波段（R~45,000）检测到水汽并约束其丰度，同时联合Spitzer光度数据进行大气反演。检索结果表明该行星具有与宿主星相当的C/O比（~0.19），但碳氧丰度相对贬损，这种组合难以用传统的雪线气体吸积解释，反而指向行星在CO雪线外通过无盘高偏心率迁移形成，仅经历有限的行星体富集过程。

2026-10-15.title: ExoEcho: Exoplanet Ephemerides Change Observations. III. A JWST Survey for Transit Timing Variations of 37 Exoplanets
2026-10-15.abstract: Transit timing variations (TTVs) provide a powerful probe of planetary dynamics and orbital evolution. We extend the ExoEcho project by incorporating James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) transit observations and analyze 84 light curves of 37 exoplanets, including 20 hot Jupiters, 11 Neptune-like planets, and 6 super-Earths. We derive updated transit ephemerides and conduct a systematic search for long-term and periodic TTV signals. We identify two strong TTV candidates, including HATS-6~b and HAT-P-18~b. The hot Jupiter HATS-6~b exhibits a long-term trend with $\dot{P} = 230.5 \pm 46.8\ \mathrm{ms\ yr^{-1}}$, potentially driven by tidal interactions with its host star. In addition, the Neptune-like planet HAT-P-18~b shows periodic TTV signal with amplitude of $92.9 \pm 13.7$~s. We also show that the previously claimed positive period derivative in WASP-121~b is inconsistent with our new transit timing data. Although continued monitoring is required to confirm these findings, our results demonstrate the potential of JWST for high-precision transit timing and extend TTV studies beyond the traditional hot-Jupiter population to lower-mass exoplanets.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究利用JWST观测数据分析了37颗系外行星（包括20颗热木星、11颗海王星型行星和6颗超地球）的84条凌日光变曲线，系统搜索长期和周期性的凌日时间变化(TTV)信号。研究识别了HATS-6~b和HAT-P-18~b两个强TTV候选体，其中HATS-6~b展现出可能由潮汐相互作用驱动的长期周期变化($\dot{P} = 230.5 \pm 46.8\ \mathrm{ms\ yr^{-1}}$)，而HAT-P-18~b呈现周期性TTV信号(振幅92.9 ± 13.7秒)。本研究表明JWST具有进行高精度凌日时间测量的潜力，将TTV研究范围扩展到低质量系外行星。

2026-10-15.title: The Limits of Tidal Circularization and Atmospheric Escape for Mini-Neptunes and Super-Earths: The Case of TOI-2257 b
2026-10-15.abstract: With a 35-day orbital period and $\sim$0.5 eccentricity, TOI-2257 b occupies a sparsely populated corner of transiting mini-Neptune parameter space and may lie near the orbital distance at which tidal and atmospheric escape process become negligible. To test this hypothesis, we performed simulations of the combined stellar, tidal, and atmospheric evolution and confirmed that TOI-2257 b does lie near this boundary, regardless of whether it formed with or without a primordial hydrogen envelope. In the mini-Neptune scenario, we find that all cases retain an envelope of at least 0.02 M$_\oplus$ for 8 Gyr, but that the envelope mass can be halved if it was initially larger than 0.2 M$_\oplus$. We find that tidal evolution only occurs for cases with initial envelope masses larger than 0.02 M$_\oplus$ because their radii are large enough to generate significant torques. In the super-Earth scenario, the planet could lose $\sim$10 Earth ocean masses of surface water during the $\sim$75 Myr pre-main sequence and therefore could be habitable if it formed with $\gtrsim$2x Earth's surface water mass. The predicted tidal heating surface flux tends to be similar to Io, with no cases approaching the flux required to drive a runaway greenhouse. We find that if the planet is rocky, then eccentricities larger than 0.62 today are strongly disfavored, implying that larger eccentricities could confirm the gaseous nature of the planet. These results suggest that TOI-2257 b could provide valuable constraints on mini-Neptune properties and new insight into the radius valley shape as a function of eccentricity.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过结合恒星演化、潮汐演化和大气逃逸的数值模拟，探究了TOI-2257 b（35天轨道周期、离心率~0.5）作为迷你海王星所处的潮汐圆化和大气逃逸的临界轨道位置。研究发现该系统无论初始是否具有原始氢包层，都位于这一边界附近：在迷你海王星情景下至少保留0.02 M⊕的包层，潮汐演化仅在初始包层质量>0.02 M⊕时才显著发生；在超级地球情景下，该星球可能在前主序阶段损失~10个地球洋质量的水，但若初始水质量≥2倍地球海洋质量则可能宜居。结果表明TOI-2257 b的当前离心率若>0.62则强烈排除岩石性质，为确定行星物质组成和理解半径山谷与离心率关系提供了约束。

2026-10-15.title: Chandra-JWST Probing the Effects of Moderate X-Ray Superflares on Protoplanetary Disks
2026-10-15.abstract: Powerful X-ray flares from young stars may rapidly alter the physical and chemical conditions of their planet-forming disks, but direct observational tests remain scarce. We present a Chandra-JWST/NIRSpec study of infrared spectral variability associated with pre-main-sequence (PMS) X-ray flares in the Orion Nebula. Combining six Chandra/ACIS-I observations with three NIRSpec-MOS visits, we analyze two-epoch spectra of 10 X-ray Flare stars and 12 matched non-flaring Controls among 84 observed disk-bearing PMS stars. We investigate three diagnostics: narrow 2.8-4.3 micron features, HI Br-alpha, and the CO fundamental band. Flare stars show tentative evidence for relatively fewer variable narrow features at longer wavelengths than Controls, while feature incidence decreases strongly with projected distance from the dominant ionizing O star Theta1 Ori C. Most classifiable features appear in absorption. These properties suggest that at least some features may arise in externally irradiated disk atmospheres and/or associated photoevaporative flows, with their apparent epoch-to-epoch variability potentially reflecting spatial sampling of such locally structured material rather than intrinsic temporal changes. Br-alpha behaves differently: flare stars show systematically stronger variability and uniquely exhibit absorption-core profiles, suggesting control by magnetospheric accretion and stellar magnetic processes rather than disk irradiation. The CO fundamental band shows no significant flare-associated variability, consistent with thermochemical models predicting weak responses to moderate X-ray superflares. This pilot study demonstrates the potential of coordinated Chandra-JWST observations to probe how young stellar magnetic activity affects planet-forming environments, motivating future monitoring to build larger superflare samples and extend them into the rare X-ray mega-flare regime.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究结合Chandra X射线观测与JWST/NIRSpec近红外分光，调查了猎户星云中中等X射线超耀斑对原行星盘的影响，对10颗耀斑星和12颗对照星进行了双历元光谱分析。研究发现耀斑星的窄的2.8-4.3微米特征变化较少，而Br-alpha线表现出更强的变率并呈吸收芯轮廓，表明其主要受磁圈吸积和恒星磁场控制；CO基频带未显示显著耀斑相关变率，与热化学模型预测一致。该研究表明协调的Chandra-JWST观测可以有效探测年轻恒星磁活动如何影响行星形成环境，并为未来研究更大样本甚至超级耀斑提供了方法论基础。

2026-10-15.title: Science-Driven Performance Requirements for UV Coronagraph Design: Implications for O$_3$ Detection in Earth-like Atmospheres
2026-10-15.abstract: Detecting biosignatures on Earth-like exoplanets from the Proterozoic era requires instrumentation capable of probing near-ultraviolet (NUV) spectral features, particularly ozone (\ce{O3}), which serves as an indirect proxy for molecular oxygen (\ce{O2}) when direct detection is challenging. Using a combination of photochemical-climate modeling and atmospheric retrieval simulations, we quantify fiducial instrument performance requirements for robust \ce{O3} detection and assess the risk of spectral false positives from sulfur dioxide (\ce{SO2}). Our analysis demonstrates the \ce{O3} abundances for Proterozoic Earth-like planets with \ce{O2} as low as 0.1\% the present atmospheric level, can be constrained to within an order of magnitude at 1\,$σ$ confidence using three adjacent photometric bandpasses at a signal-to-noise ratio of 10 at 0.366\,$\upmu$m, each with a 15\% width, and a short wavelength cutoff for those observations near 0.26\,$\upmu$m. The self-consistent steady state atmospheric modeling results show that \ce{SO2} buildup is difficult in a habitable environment with appreciable amounts of water vapor in its atmosphere and would require volcanic outgassing rates at least two orders of magnitude above present-day Earth to reach surface abundance levels comparable to Proterozoic Earth-like abundances of \ce{O3}. Even under these high \ce{SO2} flux scenarios, \ce{SO2} remains largely unconstrained with the recommended observational configuration, reinforcing the need for NUV coverage in coronagraphic instruments. Our findings support the inclusion of UV-optimized optics and detectors on the Habitable Worlds Observatory (HWO) to enable biosignature detection strategies sensitive to atmospheric conditions across key phases of Earth's geological history.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究结合光化学-气候模型和大气反演模拟,量化了紫外日冕仪检测类地行星臭氧(O₃)生物标志所需的仪器性能指标,并评估了二氧化硫(SO₂)产生虚假正信号的风险。研究表明,使用三个相邻的015%宽度光度带通(中心0.366 μm,短波截止0.26 μm)、信噪比为10的观测配置,可将原生代类地行星(O₂含量低至现代大气0.1%)的臭氧丰度约束在一个数量级精度内;同时证明在具有可观测水汽的宜居环境中SO₂难以积累,其表面丰度达到原生代水平需要火山排气速率比现代地球高两个数量级以上。研究结果支持在宜居世界观测台(HWO)上配置紫外优化光学和探测器,以实现对地球地质史关键阶段大气条件的生物标志检测。

2026-10-15.title: Simulations of the Evolving Ozone Layer: Implications for the Early Earth, Exoplanets, and the Search For Life
2026-10-15.abstract: Over 4 billion years, Earth's atmosphere has been transformed from a composition devoid of molecular oxygen (O$_2$) to one where O$_2$ is now 21% of our modern atmosphere by volume. With high quantities of O$_2$, an ozone (O$_3$) layer can form and partially shield the surface from biologically harmful ultraviolet radiation (UV). The evolution of the O$_3$ layer has previously been simulated under the modern Sun by independent groups with separate models. Here, we present simulations of Earth's atmosphere from four open-source one-dimensional (1D) photochemical models and a 3D chemistry-climate model, focussing on O$_3$. We find that the O$_3$ layer thickness exhibits a clear deviation between the 1D models and the 3D model due to several factors, including treatments of O$_2$ photolysis, chemical networks, H$_2$O microphysics and 3D transport. We find that 1D models introduce a bias for unobserved climate states and show how these biases may propagate to calculations of biological UV damage and surface habitability. We show that when applied to specific exoplanet atmospheres, these discrepancies can become more pronounced, propagating through to observational predictions for the next generation of telescopes, such as HWO and LIFE, that will search for habitable and inhabited exoplanets.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究采用五个光化学模型（包括四个一维模型和一个三维气候-化学耦合模型）模拟地球大气中臭氧层的演化，重点关注不同模型在臭氧厚度计算中的差异。研究发现一维模型与三维模型在臭氧厚度预测上存在显著偏差，主要源于O₂光解处理、化学反应网络、水微物理过程和三维输运等因素的差异，这些偏差会影响生物紫外线损伤和宜居性评估。研究进一步表明，这些模型差异在应用于系外行星大气时更加明显，将直接影响HWO和LIFE等下一代望远镜对宜居与生命迹象行星的观测预测精度。

2026-10-15.title: Peering into the Midplane of the DM Tau Disk using N2H+ and DCO+
2026-10-15.abstract: Planets form in the midplanes of protoplanetary disks, thus investigating the properties of the midplane region can shed light on the physical and chemical processes governing the evolution of planetary systems. In this work, we study the conditions near the midplane of the disk around DM Tau using 0."3 (~43 au) ALMA observations of N2H+ (J = 3 - 2) and DCO+ (J = 4 - 3). The radial profiles reveal that DCO+ is centrally peaked, with a depression near 120 au, while N2H+ exhibits a central depression and a peak near 100 au. In addition, both molecules display extended emission out to 400 au. Using parametric models to interpret our observations, we note that a fiducial model based on CO-derived parameters captures the features within 200 au, but fails to reproduce the outer disk emission. We explore various mechanisms that could account for this extended emission and conclude that it is best reproduced by an increased external UV penetration and cosmic ray/X-ray ionization rate, possibly enhanced by radial drift. These processes affect the precursors of N2H+ and DCO+ : increased UV leads to the photodesorption of CO and N2, while ionization enhances H3+ abundance. Besides, the observed N2H+ and DCO+ features are broadly consistent with previous CO snowline constraints, but can also be shaped by processes such as ionization, CO depletion, and multiple chemical pathways. Thus, using these molecular ions as robust CO snowline tracers requires additional constraints from complementary molecular tracers and detailed chemical modeling.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过ALMA高分辨率观测DM Tau原行星盘中的N2H+和DCO+分子离子分布,探究了盘面区域的物理化学条件对行星形成的影响。观测结果显示两种分子在盘内100-120 au处呈现不同的径向分布特征,且在外盘(>200 au)存在延伸发射,表明紫外辐射穿透、宇宙线电离等过程在调控CO雪线附近的化学环境中起重要作用。研究表明仅依赖单一分子示踪CO雪线需谨慎,应结合多种分子示踪和详细化学模型以准确约束原行星盘的雪线位置和行星形成条件。

2026-10-15.title: A Spatial Map of the Atmospheric Limb of a Hot Jupiter
2026-10-15.abstract: Planets are inherently three-dimensional objects shaped by their thermal structure and dynamics. Observations of transiting exoplanets have begun to uncover this three-dimensional nature, with JWST measuring their dayside atmosphere structure with eclipse mapping, and exploring spectroscopic asymmetries in the limbs of planets during transit. We apply the novel mapping method of transmission strings to the hot Jupiter WASP-17b. With this method, we are not only able to extract hemispheric limb asymmetries from east-to-west, but can map equator-to-pole variations around the transmitting atmosphere as a function of angle, spanning 0.6-12$μ$m. We find a clear transition in the thermal scale height around the limb of the atmosphere, with a $\sim$650K temperature difference between the morning (T=858$^{+434}_{-233}$K) and evening (T=1522$^{+116}_{-114}$K). These results are consistent with both nightside emission and dayside eclipse mapping measurements, and represent a fully comprehensive set of observations for a transiting exoplanet. We are also able to constrain the abundances of H$_2$O and CO$_2$ to constant values around the limb, providing observational constraints to results from global circulation models. The transmission string technique combined with the outstanding observability of WASP-17b pushes the study of exoplanet atmospheres further into a three-dimensional understanding of hot Jupiter dynamics and chemistry
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究采用创新的"传输弦"映射方法对热木星WASP-17b的大气凌日轮廓进行三维空间制图，在0.6-12μm波段内获得了从东西半球和赤道到极地的非对称性结构。研究发现大气热标度高度存在明显过渡，晨侧和昏侧温度差异约650K（分别为858K和1522K），并约束了水汽和二氧化碳的丰度分布。这些结果与夜侧辐射和白昼食观测相互印证，为热木星的三维大气动力学和化学性质提供了全面的观测约束。

2026-10-15.title: Star spots mimic the proposed abundance signatures of planet formation
2026-10-15.abstract: Trends with stellar elemental abundances and condensation temperature have been proposed as a possible tracer of rocky planet formation. Here we present an alternative explanation, where we show that stellar activity (star spots) can also cause apparent abundance changes in refractory elements preferentially over volatile elements. This effect arises naturally from atomic physics: refractory (rocky; high-$T_c$) elements preferentially have low first-ionization potentials, with strong transitions that are most sensitive to the cooler, magnetically-perturbed spot conditions, making any spot-induced change in line strength correlated with $T_c$. We re-examine literature on Sun-like stars in the Solar neighborhood and find that the $\log{R'_{HK}}$ stellar activity indicator is correlated with the so-called $T_c$ slope: the gradient of chemical abundances with respect to condensation temperature. Using 1D LTE Korg.jl simulations of the Sun with spots of varying size and contrast, we show that a wide range of spot configurations can manifest as abundance patterns that mimic a signal of abundance trends with condensation temperature. Finally, we conduct a line-by-line differential analysis of an ambient Solar spectrum relative to a Solar sunspot umbra to represent an extreme case, where we find that elements with high condensation temperature can show a factor of three (0.5 dex) increase. We discuss implications that stellar activity poses for precision spectroscopy, and provide some direction on how this effect might be mitigated.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究揭示了恒星活动（星斑）可能是导致恒星丰度与凝聚温度相关趋势的关键因素，而这一趋势此前被视为行星形成的信号。通过原子物理分析和1D LTE光谱模拟，我们证明高凝聚温度元素（岩石成分）由于具有低电离势和对磁扰动敏感的强谱线，在星斑条件下会表现出与凝聚温度相关的丰度变化。这项发现对利用恒星丰度梯度推断行星形成历史的精密光谱学研究具有重要启示，提示需要在行星动力学研究中更谨慎地区分恒星活动效应与真实的行星形成信号。

2026-10-15.title: 3D Global Climate Simulations of Synthetic Mars Warming
2026-10-15.abstract: Artificial warming via engineered aerosols presents a novel pathway to bypass volatile scarcity on modern Mars. Utilizing the Generic Planetary Climate Model, we evaluate the physical feasibility of aerosol-induced terraforming over a full Martian year (669 Sols). Unlike previous approaches that added aerosols to background dust or assumed continuous nanoparticle injection, we simulate the complete substitution of natural dust with a single-injection profile of radiatively active aluminium nanoparticles without continuous dumping. This tests whether initial infrared greenhouse forcing can overcome the severe ice-albedo cooling induced by a massive regional water-ice sheet ($3400 \text{ kg/m}^2$) localized in the Hellas Basin. Comparing this scenario against an unperturbed control run, we analyze surface temperature dynamics, sublimation fluxes, and water vapour concentration. Our 3D global climate simulations quantify the radiative-dynamical feedback thresholds and determine whether engineered aerosol forcing can trigger a self-sustaining water-vapour greenhouse effect or remains fundamentally limited by regional ice-albedo suppression in Hellas.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究采用通用行星气候模型评估了单次注入铝纳米颗粒替代火星天然尘埃作为温室气体的可行性,通过模拟完整火星年的三维全球气候动力学过程,定量分析了工程气溶胶强制辐射与赫拉斯盆地大规模冰雪反照率冷却反馈之间的相互作用。结果表明工程气溶胶诱导的增温能否克服区域冰-反照率抑制,并触发自持水汽温室效应,为火星行星工程的可行性阈值提供了关键约束。

2026-10-15.title: A breath of fresh air: Oxygen enhancement from silicate sublimation during early protostellar evolution
2026-10-15.abstract: Recently, an analog to the t = 0 moment of our Solar System's meteoritic record was identified for the first time around the Class I protostar HOPS-315. Crystalline silicates were found to recondense from SiO gas that cools as it advects upward from a hot thermostat region in the inner midplane. This t=0 moment may be associated with the formation of the first planetesimals in this disk. We explore whether HOPS-68, a Class I protostar with similar properties and system geometries, is engaged in such refractory recondensation as well. A detection of cooler gas-phase SiO in absorption above a hot disk midplane would allow us to achieve this goal, thanks to a previous detection of crystalline silicates. HOPS-68 was observed with the JWST MIRI and NIRSpec, showing multiple bands of molecular absorption. We use local thermal equilibrium slab models to measure the temperature, column density, velocity, and radial location of these bands. The molecular absorption bands of gaseous SiO, H2O, CO2, and 13CO trace a warm molecular inversion layer (300-500 K) at mid-altitudes above the hot disk midplane from 0.3-16 AU, which is consistently blue-shifted with respect to the system velocity by 33-53 km/s. Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) observations of HOPS-68 kinematically resolve an SiO-rich jet and wind. We confirm that HOPS-68, like HOPS-315, is undergoing an epoch analogous to the t=0 moment in the Solar System's planet formation timeline. The detected warm molecular layer traces the base of a disk wind, which carries sublimated material from the thermostat region near 2 AU up into the outer disk. As for HOPS-315, the molecular layer in the inner few AU of HOPS-68 is enhanced in bulk oxygen as a result of this sublimation. Since HOPS-68 is less evolved than HOPS-315, this may indicate a prolonged epoch in protostellar evolution in which such oxygen enhancement occurs.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过JWST和ALMA观测Class I原星HOPS-68，探测其内盘热区升华的SiO气体在外盘冷凝过程中是否发生，以识别与太阳系行星形成初期类似的时刻。研究发现HOPS-68的温分子层（300-500 K）中SiO、H2O、CO2等分子富集，这些物质通过盘风从内盘升华区被输运到外盘，导致内盘几AU范围内氧元素大量富集。结果表明HOPS-68与HOPS-315都处于太阳系行星形成初期的相似演化阶段，且这种氧富集阶段可能在原星演化中持续较长时间，对早期行星体形成的化学成分具有重要影响。

2026-10-15.title: Rattling Resonant Chains with Dynamical Tides and Parametric Resonance Passage
2026-10-15.abstract: Close-in sub-Neptunes are born in mean-motion resonant chains that break apart on a timescale of $\sim$100 Myr. If the chains are first ''rattled'' --- have their free eccentricities excited to a few percent --- then breaking occurs on the required timescale. We propose that chains are rattled by internal oscillations tidally driven by the star in the innermost planet. Unlike other proposals, there is no need to invoke any reservoir of planetesimals or external perturbers --- the chain unravels from within. We develop a Hamiltonian theory (and an accompanying toy model) which predicts a parametric instability whereby chain librations exponentially amplify when the tidal forcing frequency equals the sum of the internal mode frequency and the chain libration frequency. We also introduce a new eigenmode solver for rotating planets, $\texttt{MAQAM}$, that in combination with the evolutionary code $\texttt{ORCHARD}$ enables us to track the frequency evolution of pressure, gravity, and inertial modes in cooling sub-Neptunes. Inertial modes in the gas envelope and fluid mantle can evolve to become momentarily parametrically resonant. Passage through a single parametric resonance can raise the free eccentricities in the chain to a few percent within a few tens of Myrs.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了近距离亚海王星形成的共振链如何通过内部潮汐驱动和参数共振破裂的机制。研究采用哈密顿理论和数值模拟方法，建立了新的行星本征模态求解器MAQAM，发现内行星的潮汐力可激发其内部振荡，当潮汐频率等于内部模频率与链天平动频率之和时，会产生参数不稳定性。研究表明经过单个参数共振通道，可在数十百万年内将共振链的自由离心率提升至几个百分点，从而解释亚海王星共振链的破裂机制，而无需外部扰动源。

2026-10-15.title: Size, atmospheric, and ring constraints on the large Kuiper belt object (55565) Aya from a stellar occultation
2026-10-15.abstract: We aim to constrain the projected size, geometric albedo, possible atmosphere, and possible ring material of the mid-sized trans-Neptunian object (55565) Aya from the stellar occultation of 2024 May 10 (UT). We observed the event from three Japanese sites with high-cadence optical imaging. We combined one positive occultation chord with an informative prior on the shadow centre derived from orbital and astrometric uncertainties, and inferred the body radius with Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo modelling. We constrained a possible atmosphere by fitting refraction models for pure CH$_4$, N$_2$, and CO atmospheres to multi-band light curves, and searched for ring-like extinction signatures in unbinned and binned high-time-resolution photometry. We derive an equivalent radius, i.e., the radius of the circle fitted to the projected shadow, of $r=401^{+28}_{-40}$ km for Aya, corresponding to a geometric albedo of $p_V=0.101^{+0.023}_{-0.013}$. This estimate is insensitive to the adopted ephemeris solution and is consistent with an ephemeris-independent analysis that makes no assumption about the position of the shadow centre. We obtain 3$σ$ upper limits on the atmospheric surface pressure of $p_0=60$, 90, and 80 nbar for pure CH$_4$, N$_2$, and CO compositions, respectively. No significant ring-like extinction is detected over projected distances of about 430-8060 km sampled by the three stations, and our most sensitive data exclude dense narrow features with apparent opacity $p'\gtrsim0.1$ and radial widths of a few kilometres or larger over $\sim3r$-$14r$. This is the first stellar occultation by Aya ever observed. In addition to constraining Aya's size and albedo and finding no ring-like extinction, we place a stringent atmospheric upper limit that supports diversity in atmospheric states among similarly sized trans-Neptunian objects.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过2024年5月10日的恒星掩星观测,利用日本三个地点的高时间分辨率光学成像数据,采用贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法约束了柯伊伯带天体(55565)Aya的投影半径为401+28−40 km、几何反照率为0.101+0.023−0.013。通过拟合多波段光变曲线中的折射模型和高时间分辨率光度数据分析,我们得到了大气表面压力的严格上限(甲烷、氮气和一氧化碳分别为60、90和80 nbar),并排除了在~3r-14r范围内存在明显的环状结构。这项研究首次成功观测了Aya的恒星掩星事件,揭示了类似大小的外太阳系天体在大气状态上的多样性。

2026-10-15.title: Tracing the Influence of Distant companions on Exoplanetary Systems (TIDES) I. Highly Eccentric and Misaligned Binary Companions to Hot Jupiters
2026-10-15.abstract: The origin of hot Jupiters remains an open question. A significant fraction reside in binary or multiple star systems, suggesting that stellar companions may play an important role in shaping their present-day architectures. However, the orbits of the vast majority of these stellar companions remain poorly constrained, leaving their role in hot Jupiter evolution an open question. We present the Tracing the Influence of Distant companions on Exoplanetary Systems (TIDES) survey, a campaign to map the orbits of stellar companions in systems hosting hot Jupiters to assess the extent to which binaries play a role in hot Jupiter formation and migration. Here, we introduce our survey design and new orbital fits for the first six systems in our sample---$τ$ Boo, WASP-2, WASP-11, WASP-76, HAT-P-14, and HAT-P-16---by combining previous observations of the stellar companions together with new Keck/NIRC2 imaging and Keck/KPIC relative radial velocities. Among these six systems, the four with the most precisely constrained orbits exhibit high eccentricities ($e \geq 0.8$), and three of these systems also display significant planet--binary misalignments ($Δi \geq 20^\circ$). This suggests the orbital properties of stellar companions to hot Jupiter host stars are qualitatively different than field binaries and binaries hosting inner transiting small planets. These orbital architectures are consistent with stellar companions shaping the evolution of hot Jupiters, either through high-eccentricity migration or by participating in an earlier episode of dynamical evolution that ultimately led to hot Jupiter formation. Continued orbital monitoring of the full sample will reveal whether outer stellar companions play a causal role in the evolution of hot Jupiters.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究系统测量了热木星宿主星系统中伴星的轨道参数,结合Keck/NIRC2成像和相对径向速度观测,获得了τ Boo等六个系统中伴星的精确轨道拟合。研究发现这些伴星普遍具有高离心率(e≥0.8)和显著的行星-伴星轨道失调特征(Δi≥20°),明显不同于场星二星系统,表明外层伴星可能通过高离心率迁移或早期动力学演化过程对热木星的形成和演化产生重要影响。

2026-10-15.title: Dynamically Coupled Three-dimensional Cloud-Chemistry in Rapidly Rotating Irradiated Atmospheres: an Application to the Compact White Dwarf-Brown Dwarf system ZTFJ0038+2030
2026-10-15.abstract: Clouds and disequilibrium chemistry shape the observable properties of substellar and planetary atmospheres, and JWST time-resolved spectroscopy now enables direct tests of their three-dimensional structures. We present an update to the 3D atmospheric framework ADAM, coupling the dynamical core to a miniature kinetic chemistry scheme (mini-chem) and a saturation-relaxation tracer cloud module. Using this framework, we investigate the atmosphere of the brown dwarf orbiting the white dwarf ZTFJ0038+2030 in a 10-hour orbit. The brown dwarf receives stellar irradiation comparable to its internal heat flux, placing the atmosphere in a regime where the circulation is characterized by a standing Matsuno--Gill wave response and equatorial superrotation. Rapid rotation confines these structures closer to the equator, producing more symmetric broadband light curves with smaller hotspot offsets than canonical hot Jupiters, in agreement with recent JWST observations of this system. Although most species are globally homogenized, rapid rotation limits global-scale horizontal mixing and allows circulation-driven vertical transport to maintain strong CO and CO$_2$ inhomogeneities in the photosphere. These chemical inhomogeneities produce asymmetric phase curves in the CO and CO$_2$ absorption bands, which could qualitatively explain the observed CO$_2$ light-curve asymmetry. When clouds are included, Na$_2$S clouds dominate the photosphere and weaken the large-scale circulation, lowering photospheric CO and CO$_2$ abundances, while MgSiO$_3$ and Fe clouds rain out at deeper levels. Because the dominant Na$_2$S clouds reside mostly above the quench region, cloud-driven convection has limited impact on the quenched abundances, which are instead regulated mainly by large-scale circulation.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过耦合三维动力学、非平衡化学和云模块的ADAM框架，模拟了快速旋转白矮星-褐矮星系统ZTFJ0038+2030中褐矮星大气的结构。研究发现快速旋转通过限制大尺度混合和维持强的CO/CO₂不均一性，产生与JWST观测相符的对称光变曲线和CO₂吸收带的不对称位相曲线；Na₂S云主导光球层并削弱大尺度环流，而淬火丰度主要由环流而非云驱动对流调控。这项工作揭示了快速旋转行星大气中动力学-化学-云的耦合作用如何塑造可观测特性。

2026-10-15.title: Hydrogen and Helium Dissolution, Outgassing, and Loss in Evolving Sub-Neptune Magma Oceans: Examining Demographic Features and Radius Evolution
2026-10-15.abstract: Abstract Sub-Neptunes’ molten interiors are expected to accommodate large quantities of volatiles, potentially altering their radius evolution. Previous studies have examined this effect in isolation with simplified evolution modeling, often assuming idealized interior and atmospheric conditions. To address this limitation, we introduce SEAMIST, a unified evolution model for sub-Neptunes and super-Earths that self-consistently combines, for the first time, interior structure, cooling, rock/iron solidification, boil-off, photoevaporation, H/He dissolution, and atmospheric composition. SEAMIST considers both a partially soluble case, in which hydrogen partitions into the magma ocean with a fraction set by mantle-envelope boundary conditions, and a fully miscible case, in which hydrogen may fully dissolve into the magma ocean at high temperatures. We identify a novel catastrophic boil-off mechanism, triggered by a positive feedback between hydrogen outgassing and mass loss that can operate billions of years after disk dispersal. In partially soluble models, the impact of H/He dissolution on radius evolution is modest. This contrasts with previous expectations, as we find that increasing hydrogen abundance from outgassing enhances mass-loss efficiency, counterbalancing volatile replenishment from the rock/iron interior. Fully miscible hydrogen, in contrast, enhances envelope survival around low-mass stars and produces helium-dominated envelopes. Overall, at intermediate to low masses, mass–radius curves from partially soluble models match observed distributions. The fully miscible case predicts a radius peak and excess planets around low stellar masses that appear inconsistent with current observations, although it reproduces the observed radius “cliff” near 4 R ⊕ at higher masses. Our results suggest that high metallicity may explain the cliff, although alternatives cannot be ruled out.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过开发SEAMIST综合演化模型,首次自洽耦合了亚海王星的内部结构、冷却、固化、沸腾、光蒸发和氢氦溶解过程,系统研究了岩浆海洋中气体溶解对亚海王星半径演化的影响。研究发现,在部分溶解情景下,氢氦溶解对半径演化影响有限,因为溶解引起的气体补充被增强的质量损失所抵消;而完全混溶情景则预测低质量星周围出现过多行星,与观测不符。这些结果表明亚海王星半径"悬崖"现象可能主要由高金属度驱动,对理解亚海王星的形成和演化具有重要意义。

2026-10-15.title: Probing Planet Formation within 10 au: Dust Substructures in Extremely Compact Protoplanetary Disks
2026-10-15.abstract: Abstract Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter (ALMA) high-resolution surveys have so far focused mainly on large, bright protoplanetary disks, where substructures are routinely detected, leaving compact disks poorly characterized. Yet, the survival of millimeter emission in Class II sources implies that radial drift must have been halted by pressure traps, previously undetected due to limited angular resolution. We present ALMA Band 7 (0.9 mm) continuum observations of 11 of the smallest ( R 68 < 10 au) Class II disks in Lupus, reaching 0 . ″ 02 (2 au) resolution, the highest currently available with ALMA at this wavelength. We detect substructures in four disks, including a clear inner cavity of radius 1.6 au, and hints of substructure in three more. Two disks also host faint outer rings beyond their bright inner core. Combining these results with demographic information on Class II disks observed with ALMA, we examine how the substructure detection rate varies with disk size, restricting to disks whose diameter is resolved by at least three resolution elements. We find that nearly all disks (≳95%) larger than 30 au show substructures, compared to a still substantial ∼50% between 3 and 30 au, with the lower rate likely affected by optical depth. The planet masses required to open gaps within 5 au fall in the super-Earth to mini-Neptune regime. These results demonstrate that substructures are ubiquitous across the disk population, and that planet formation conditions can be probed down to a few astronomical units from the host star.
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究使用ALMA在0.9毫米波段对11个极小型(半径<10 au)的原行星盘进行了高分辨率(0.02″)观测,在4个盘中检测到亚结构,包括半径1.6 au的内空洞,并发现亚结构检测率随盘大小而变化:大于30 au的盘几乎全部(≳95%)呈现亚结构,而3-30 au的盘约50%存在亚结构。结果表明亚结构在原行星盘中普遍存在,且开启间隙所需的行星质量落在超地球到迷你海王星范围内,这证明了行星形成条件可以探测到距主星仅几个天文单位的区域。

2026-10-15.title: The physical and chemical structure of Titan’s upper atmosphere: energy balance, photochemistry and Jeans escape
2026-10-15.abstract: Abstract Titan’s upper atmospheric layers provide a unique opportunity to study how photochemistry, photoionisation, haze microphysics and escape processes shape its atmospheric chemical structure, providing a unique benchmark for understanding these processes in exoplanets. Using a 1D first-principles approach, we extend the Kompot model to simulate Titan’s upper atmosphere and investigate its thermal and chemical structure, and Jeans escape. We performed self-consistent simulations of Titan’s upper atmosphere, above the dense haze layer, over a 1D radial grid by solving the coupled hydrodynamics, thermal and photochemical kinetic, and energy balance equations. We considered heating by stellar X-ray and ultraviolet (XUV) and infrared (IR) radiation, and cooling due to radiative emission of methane (CH4) and hydrogen cyanide (HCN). We also included additional nineteen photochemical and 117 thermal reactions to Kompot’s standard chemical network. Our modelled atmospheric temperature structures lie within the observed variability of Titan’s atmospheric temperature profile. Our simulations reproduce observed nitrogen (N2) and CH4 densities in the upper atmosphere, and abundance of minor chemical species also broadly agree with observationally derived abundances. Near the exobase, our CH4 mixing ratio overlap with Cassini-Huygens results, and our model H2 mixing ratios also exhibit broad agreement with observations. Our simulations suggest no significant thermal loss of CH4, even under the conditions of an early Sun’s XUV environment.
2026-10-15.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-10-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过扩展Kompot模型建立了泰坦上层大气的一维自洽流体动力学-热力学-光化学耦合模型,模拟了恒星XUV和红外辐射驱动的大气加热冷却、光化学反应和Jeans逃逸过程。模型成功复现了泰坦上层大气的温度结构、N₂和CH₄等主要物种的密度分布,以及HCN等微量物种的丰度,与卡西尼-惠更斯号观测结果基本一致。研究表明即使在早期太阳XUV辐射环境下,泰坦也不存在显著的CH₄热逃逸,为理解系外行星上层大气的光化学和逃逸过程提供了重要参考。

2026-10-14.title: The Lazuli Space Observatory: Architecture and Capabilities
2026-10-14.abstract: Abstract The Lazuli Space Observatory is a 3 m aperture astronomical facility designed for rapid-response observations and precision astrophysics across visible to near-IR wavelengths (400–1700 nm bandpass). An off-axis, freeform telescope delivers diffraction-limited image quality (Strehl >0.8 at 633 nm) to three instruments across a wide, flat focal plane. The three instruments provide complementary capabilities; the Wide-field Context Camera (WCC) delivers multiband imaging over a 35 ′ × 12 ′ footprint with high-cadence photometry; the Integral-field Spectrograph (IFS) provides continuous 400–1700 nm spectroscopy at R ∼ 100–500 for stable spectrophotometry; and the ExtraSolar Coronagraph (ESC) enables high-contrast imaging expected to reach raw contrasts of 10 −8 and postprocessed contrasts approaching 10 −9 . Operating from a 3:1 lunar-resonant orbit, Lazuli will respond to targets of opportunity in under four hours—a programmatic requirement designed to enable routine temporal responsiveness that is unprecedented for a space telescope of this size. Lazuli’s technical capabilities are shaped around three broad science areas: (1) time-domain and multimessenger astronomy, (2) stars and planets, and (3) cosmology. These capabilities enable a potent mix of science spanning gravitational-wave counterpart characterization, fast-evolving transients, Type Ia supernova cosmology, high-contrast exoplanet imaging, and spectroscopy of exoplanet atmospheres. While these areas guide the observatory design, Lazuli is conceived as a general-purpose facility with open time for the global community. We describe the observatory architecture and capabilities in the preliminary design phase, with science operations anticipated following a rapid development cycle from concept to launch; quoted performance specifications reflect current design requirements and modeling predictions, pending on-orbit verification.
2026-10-14.summary_zh: Lazuli空间天文台是一个3米口径的空间观测设施,搭载宽视场相机、积分视场光谱仪和高对比日冕仪三个互补仪器,从月球3:1共振轨道运行,能在4小时内响应目标观测,在400-1700nm波段实现衍射极限成像和高对比成像能力。该望远镜主要针对时域多信使天文学、恒星与行星系统和宇宙学三大科学目标设计,特别适合系外行星高对比成像、系外行星大气光谱和系外行星快速表征观测。本文介绍了Lazuli望远镜的初步设计阶段的观测架构和性能指标,为后续在轨验证奠定了基础。

2026-10-14.title: Stage-dependent Superhump Waveform Evolution and Nonstationary Positive-superhump Timing in the Near-period-gap Dwarf Nova YZ Cancri
2026-10-14.abstract: Abstract We present a photometric and timing study of the near-period-gap SU UMa-type dwarf nova YZ Cancri, based on nearly continuous Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) photometry and long-baseline ground-based observations. Our main observational result is that the positive-superhump (SH) waveform follows a repeatable, stage-dependent sequence during superoutbursts (SOs). In the two well-covered TESS SOs, and consistently in the long-baseline ground-based SO sample, the plateau waveform evolves from an early sawtooth profile (ST), through a double-humped profile with unequal maxima (DHd), to a more symmetric double-humped profile with nearly similar maxima (DHs). The global and time-resolved Lomb–Scargle periodograms show that power near the positive-SH timescale and its harmonics is concentrated during SOs, whereas quiescent and normal-outburst intervals lack a comparably persistent SH-band signal. The dense TESS maxima–minima timing sequence shows different clock stability in different waveform stages: precursor modulations have slightly longer local periods, the middle-to-late DHs plateau is the most regular timing interval, and the postplateau evolution is affected by phase switching and possible secondary/late-SH contamination. The TESS data also reveal profile-clock coupling, with SH amplitude and rise/decay durations evolving together with the timing residuals. As a secondary timing constraint, we obtain a common TESS-timing-based mean positive-SH period of P sh ′ = 0.09043 ( 27 ) day, corresponding to an SH excess of 4.03(31)% and an approximate mass ratio of q = 0.175(11). The repeatable ST–DHd–DHs sequence makes YZ Cnc a useful system near the lower edge of the period gap and may trace the growth, redistribution, stabilization, and decay of the light source associated with an eccentric, precessing accretion disk during SOs.
2026-10-14.summary_zh: 本研究基于TESS连续测光和地面长期观测数据,系统研究了近周期间隙矮新星YZ Cancri的正超晕现象及其演化规律。通过Lomb-Scargle周期分析和精密时间分析发现,正超晕波形在超爆发过程中遵循可重复的阶段相关演化序列(锯齿形→不对称双峰→对称双峰),不同阶段的时间稳定性和振幅与上升/衰减时间存在耦合关系。研究测得的超晕周期P_sh'=0.09043天对应的质量比q≈0.175,表明该系统偏心前动盘的生长、重新分布、稳定化和衰减过程可能驱动了观测到的波形演化,为理解超爆发机制提供了重要约束。

2026-10-14.title: Quantitative Links between Formation and Atmospheric Composition for Giant Planets
2026-10-14.abstract: Abstract Precise atmospheric abundances of giant exoplanets are becoming increasingly prevalent, and there is a need to systematically convert these measurements into metrics that inform us about the planets’ accretion history. We present a quantitative framework for relating atmospheric composition to the accretion of metals and primordial gas. This includes (i) new relations that simplify and generalize the connection between atmospheric metallicity and metal mass fraction, (ii) methods for inferring the source of the metals and quantifying the quantity of metals accreted via different sources, and (iii) relating the derived quantities to expectations from formation models. We also derive a new estimate of the minimum disk mass needed to form a planetary system based on the amount of excess metals accreted by a planet, assuming that this excess originates from the drift and evaporation of pebbles at condensation fronts. This Letter is accompanied by an open-source code that implements the methods presented herein.
2026-10-14.summary_zh: 本研究建立了一个定量框架,将巨行星大气成分与其吸积历史相关联,通过发展大气金属丰度与金属质量分数的通用关系、推断金属来源并量化不同来源的吸积质量、以及与行星形成模型预期的比较,系统地从精确的大气丰度测量反演行星的吸积过程。基于行星过量金属来自凝聚前沿卵石漂移和蒸发的假设,该研究还导出了形成行星系统所需最小原行星盘质量的新估计。该工作还提供了开源代码以供同行使用。

2026-10-14.title: On the Information Content of Ariel Transmission Spectra: Reassessing the Tier System
2026-10-14.abstract: Abstract The European Space Agency’s Ariel mission will conduct a survey of the atmospheric properties of exoplanets around bright stars. The mission is nominally divided into three tiers. The Tier 1 survey will consist of low-precision observations of ∼1000 planets, with a subset of these included in the higher-precision Tier 2 survey expected to be necessary for atmospheric characterization. Tier 3 will be repeated observations of a small number of benchmark planets. Though previous studies have assessed the ability of Ariel to uncover population-level trends, they have generally presupposed a given tier. Here we interrogate this assumption and assess the information content of Ariel transmission spectra as a function of tier for three benchmark planets: a hot-Saturn, warm-Neptune, and temperate sub-Neptune. We simulate a grid of Ariel transit spectra at different Tiers for each target and use retrievals to assess which chemical species are well constrained. We find that for giant planets like a hot-Saturn or warm-Neptune, Tier 1 quality observations are sufficient for ≲1.5 dex constraints on H 2 O and CO 2 , even in the presence of grey clouds—meaning important chemical insights are already obtainable in the Tier 1 survey. Moving to Tiers 2 and 3 results in an incremental increase in precision as well as other molecules becoming constrainable in certain scenarios (e.g., H 2 S, CO). Tier 1 observations are also sufficient to identify CH 4 in a temperate sub-Neptune, whereas observations with at least Tier 2 precision are necessary for CO 2 . The number of transits necessary to reach this observational S/N, however, may be prohibitive for the inclusion of temperate sub-Neptunes in even the Tier 1 survey.
2026-10-14.summary_zh: 本研究通过模拟和大气反演分析，评估了Ariel任务不同观测精度等级（Tier 1-3）对系外行星大气成分制约能力的信息含量。研究发现，对于热土星和温暖海王星等巨行星，Tier 1级别的低精度观测已足以对H₂O和CO₂获得≲1.5 dex的制约，而更高精度的Tier 2和Tier 3观测可逐步改进精度并约束其他分子；对于温度较低的亚海王星，识别CH₄仅需Tier 1精度，但探测CO₂则需至少Tier 2精度。该研究表明Ariel的Tier分级系统需要重新评估，因为Tier 1调查对巨行星大气特征化已具有显著科学价值，但温度亚海王星的观测需求可能过高。

2026-10-14.title: The occurrence rate of planets around subgiant stars from the TESS photometric survey
2026-10-14.abstract: Subgiant stars represent a critical phase in stellar evolution, offering an opportunity to investigate how planetary systems respond to the early stages of post-main-sequence expansion. Despite their importance, systematic occurrence-rate studies of this population remain sparse compared with those of main-sequence and red-giant hosts. In this paper, we present a uniform analysis of planet occurrence around a sample of 282,904 subgiant stars selected from the Data Release 3 (DR3) catalogue. We performed an independent re-analysis of Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) light curves for transit-signal detection and refinement, followed by multi-stage vetting including a visual inspection and statistical false-positive assessment. We quantified the detection sensitivity of the survey through injection-and-recovery experiments, with 565,808 synthetic transit signals injected across the stellar sample. Over the period range of 1--10 days and the planet-radius range for which the detection completeness is well characterised, we measure a completeness-corrected planet occurrence rate of 0.644^ Gaia +0.048 _ -0.041 %. The occurrence rate is strongly dependent on planet radius, with the highest occurrence contributed by planets in the 1--4,R_⊕ range and a secondary enhancement at 12--15,R_⊕. These results provide a demographic baseline for studying the population of close-in planets around stars undergoing early post-main-sequence evolution.
2026-10-14.summary_zh: 本研究利用TESS光度测量数据系统地分析了282,904颗类巨星周围的行星发生率,通过对TESS光变曲线进行独立重新分析、多阶段排查和注入恢复实验来量化探测灵敏度。研究发现在1-10天周期和经过充分表征的行星半径范围内,类巨星周围的行星发生率为0.644%,且发生率随行星半径强烈依赖,主要集中在1-4地球半径和12-15地球半径两个范围。这些结果为研究早期后主序演化阶段恒星周围近日行星的群体性质提供了重要的人口学基准。

2026-10-14.title: The Fast and Fourier: Using neural operators to speed up radiative modeling of protoplanetary disks
2026-10-14.abstract: Edge-on protoplanetary disks provide a spatially resolved view of the vertical distribution of icy planetary building blocks, but inferring their relative abundances requires radiative-transfer (RT) modeling with multiple anisotropic scattering. Each such model costs 10^1-10^3 CPU hours, which precludes principled Bayesian inference and homogeneous, population-scale analyses. We develop and validate a fast and reusable surrogate for Bayesian inference with ice-bearing edge-on disk models. We trained a Fourier neural operator on a grid of spectra. The network maps disk parameters and analytic physical input fields to the spectrum, using mixed-resolution spectra. We used the surrogate in an explicit-likelihood nested sampler. Then we validated it on held-out simulations and synthetic recovery tests with Test of Accuracy with Random Points (TARP) coverage tests. Finally, we used it to retrieve the disk structure and ice abundances of ESO-Hα 569 from its spectral energy distribution (SED). RADMC-3D The surrogate successfully reproduces the spectra with a median error of fwdPerSpecQFifty%. We recover synthetic parameters without detectable bias and with nominal coverage. For ESO-Hα 569, the posterior favors a massive (M_ RADMC-3D ̊m gas = nearly edge-on (i= . Its ice abundances and cavity size remain weakly constrained by broadband data alone. The marginal spectrum-evaluation speed-up is approximately 10^9--10^10. disk consistent with the image-plus-SED model of wolff2017hubblespacetelescope Neural-operator emulation makes full posterior inference feasible within the adopted model and training prior. Scientifically important posterior points should still be checked with high-fidelity RT models. By dramatically decreasing the evaluation time, for the first time this approach enables homogeneous population studies of ices in disks, which can be capitalized on for new JWST surveys to map the range of compositions within planetary nurseries.
2026-10-14.summary_zh: 本研究通过训练傅里叶神经算子(Fourier neural operator)建立原行星盘辐射转移模型的快速代理,将谱能分布计算速度提升10^9-10^10倍,使得贝叶斯推断和群体规模分析成为可能。该代理在合成测试中表现良好且无偏差,并成功应用于ESO-Hα 569的盘结构和冰丰度反演,揭示其接近边缘的高质量气体盘与较弱约束的冰丰度分布。这一方法首次实现了对行星摇篮中冰成分多样性的均匀群体研究,为JWST巡天数据的系统分析提供了新工具。

2026-10-14.title: TESS flares and chromospheric variability in the Pleiades, the Hyades, and Praesepe
2026-10-14.abstract: Magnetic activity is a result of the interaction between rotation and dynamo processes in cool stars with outer convection zones. Since open cluster members share a common age, distance, and chemical composition, they provide an opportunity for studying the magnetic activity of cool stars in a controlled astrophysical context. We used photometric observations with a cadence of 120 s from the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) to study the flare activity of stars in three open clusters with different ages: the Pleiades (100,Myr), the Hyades (700,Myr), and Praesepe (700,Myr). We used the Ohio State Multi-Object Spectrograph (OSMOS) at MDM Observatory with the goal of identifying coronal mass ejections (CMEs) on stars in the Pleiades and Praesepe. We investigated the flaring characteristics of the cluster members using the TESS light curves: we identified the flares and then divided the dataset into different categories based on the effective temperature of the flaring stars and the amplitude of their light curves after flare removal. We calculated the flare energies and investigated the flare frequency distributions of each previously defined group. We studied the dynamic spectra of the Hα line and its environment for the stars of the Pleiades and Praesepe to search for an indication of CMEs. In order to quantify temporal variations in the line strength, we measured the Hα chromospheric activity indices for each spectrum. The power-law indices of the flare frequency distributions obtained in our analysis span the 1.8-2.8 range. We found the highest flare rates in the Pleiades for all investigated spectral types. Our results show that the flare rate of M dwarfs is similar in the Pleiades and the Hyades, while the flare rate for K-type stars in the Pleiades is higher by an order of magnitude. Our analysis reveals that the flare rate in M stars changes with their effective temperature: the rate is highest for T_ ̊m eff ∼3200-3300,K (which coincides with the transition between partially and fully convective stars), with a smooth decrease in flare rate toward cooler and hotter M dwarfs. We detected no CME signals in the OSMOS spectra, and we used this information to place an upper limit on the CME rate.
2026-10-14.summary_zh: 本研究通过TESS高时间分辨率光度观测和OSMOS光谱观测,系统研究了昴星团、毛群星团和蜂巢星团三个不同年龄开星团中恒星的耀斑活动和色球变异性,揭示了磁活动与恒星自转和年龄的关系。研究发现耀斑频率分布的幂律指数在1.8-2.8范围内,昴星团显示最高的耀斑率,且K型星的耀斑率比毛群星团高一个数量级;M矮星的耀斑率在有效温度3200-3300K处达到最大值(部分对流和完全对流恒星的过渡区),向更冷和更热的恒星平稳递减。虽未在光谱中探测到日冕物质抛射信号,但研究建立了其发生率的上限。

2026-10-14.title: Assessment of the Mass Loss and Radius Change of 3I/ATLAS Based on Observed Production Rates
2026-10-14.abstract: Abstract Formed from the debris of planet formation, interstellar comets provide invaluable insights into the chemical compositions of planetary systems outside of our Solar System. Spectroscopic observations of 3I/ATLAS, the third interstellar object, reveal production of numerous volatiles and refractory species throughout its trajectory. In this paper we present a framework to calculate the change in radius of an object on an arbitrary trajectory at any point in its orbit, applicable to any small body experiencing mass loss. We next provide a comprehensive, machine readable table containing volatile and refractory production rates from all reported observations of 3I/ATLAS pre- and post-perihelion. Applying these equations to 3I/ATLAS, we calculate that it has lost ∼1.71–5.24 meters of its surface during its passage through the Solar System from gas alone, corresponding to ∼1010 kg and ∼0.40–1.25% of its initial mass. Considering dust-to-gas ratios from 1–4, we estimate surface erosion down to depths >10 meters. We present these calculations as approximations and lower limits based on discontinuous observational data with varying methodology and instrumentation. Conservative and optimistic estimates were calculated over a range of heliocentric distances defined by the onset of activity in reported observations and the typical onset of sublimation distance for each species, respectively. The reported production rates combined with the change in radius calculation can be used to estimate subsurface locations of various species within the nucleus of 3I/ATLAS.
2026-10-14.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-10-14.summary_zh: 本研究针对星际彗星3I/ATLAS在太阳系内的质量损失和半径变化，基于多波段分光观测的挥发性和难挥发物质的生产率数据，建立了适用于任意轨道上经历质量损失的小天体的半径变化计算框架。研究结果表明3I/ATLAS在近日点附近损失了约1.71-5.24米的表面层（气体贡献），相当于初始质量的0.40-1.25%，考虑尘气比后表面侵蚀深度可超过10米。该方法和数据可用于推断3I/ATLAS彗核内各物质成分的亚表面位置分布，为理解行星形成残骸的热化学演化提供约束。

2026-10-14.title: Two families of multi-planet systems with distinct architectures and stellar hosts
2026-10-14.abstract: Abstract The rapidly growing census of exoplanets now includes over a thousand multi-planet systems, revealing architectures that span more than four orders of magnitude in mass and five in orbital scale. Explaining the origin of this striking diversity remains a central challenge for planet formation theory, compounded by observational biases that limit access to Solar System-like regimes. Here we introduce architecture-agnostic metrics to uniformly analyse four independently defined samples of multi-planet systems, uncovering unifying patterns across their diversity. We identify a clear bimodality in system masses, dividing known architectures into two distinct families. The lower-mass family, predominantly hosted by subsolar-to-solar stars, exhibits tightly packed configurations with mass distributions consistent with the ‘peas-in-a-pod’ pattern and modal dynamical excitation comparable with that of the Solar System. By contrast, the high-mass family forms in metal-rich environments around solar-to-supersolar stars, displays gravitationally compact architectures and is an order of magnitude dynamically hotter than both the Solar System and the lower-mass counterparts. Their high level of dynamical excitation points to violent evolutionary pathways driven by global instabilities and planet–planet scattering. Together, these results show that the architectures of planetary systems are born from the combined influence of formation processes and host star properties. Signatures of these roots are preserved across the post-formation dynamical evolution that reshaped most known multi-planet systems.
2026-10-14.summary_zh: 本研究通过引入与架构无关的度量方法，对四个独立样本中的多行星系统进行统一分析，揭示了已知行星系统架构的二分法：低质量系族主要围绕亚日-太阳质量恒星，呈紧密堆积构型，动力学激发程度与太阳系相当；高质量系族形成于金属丰富环境中的太阳-超太阳质量恒星周围，具有高度引力紧凑的构型和阶数更高的动力学激发，反映了全球不稳定性和行星散射等剧烈演化过程。研究表明行星系统的架构由形成过程和主星性质共同决定，这些痕迹在后形成的动力学演化中得以保留。

2026-10-13.title: TSD: An Inverse Problem Approach for Recovering the Exoplanetary Atmosphere Transmission Spectrum from High-resolution Spectroscopy
2026-10-13.abstract: Abstract Our ability to observe, detect, and characterize exoplanetary atmospheres has grown by leaps and bounds over the last 20 yr, aided largely by developments in astronomical instrumentation, improvements in data analysis techniques, and an increase in the sophistication and availability of spectroscopic models. Over this time, detections have been made for a number of important molecular species across a range of wavelengths and spectral resolutions. Ground-based observations at high resolution are particularly valuable due to the high contrast achievable between the stellar spectral continuum and the cores of resolved exoplanet absorption features. However, recovering such features without relying on a theoretical or empirical model of the exoplanet atmosphere remains a major hurdle in data analysis, with traditional methods being limited by both the choice of algorithm used to remove the nonexoplanetary components of the signal, as well as the accuracy of model template spectra used for cross-correlation. Here we present a new algorithm Transmission Spectroscopy Decomposition (TSD) formulated as an inverse problem that reconstructs the planetary transmission spectrum without recourse to an exoplanet-atmosphere template, minimizing the number of assumed and theoretically modelled components. Instead of cross-correlation with precomputed template exoplanet spectra, we rely on high spectral resolution and instrument stability to distinguish between the stellar, exoplanetary, and telluric components and velocity frames in the sequence of absorption spectra taken during multiple transits. We demonstrate the performance of our new method using both simulated and real K -band observations from ESO’s VLT/CRIRES+ instrument and present results obtained from two transits of the highly inflated super-Neptune WASP-107 b, which orbits a nearby K7V star.
2026-10-13.summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种名为传输光谱分解(TSD)的反演算法，能够从高分辨率地基光谱中恢复系外行星大气传输光谱，无需依赖预先计算的大气模板光谱，而是利用高光谱分辨率和仪器稳定性来区分恒星、行星和地球大气成分。通过对VLT/CRIRES+多个凌星观测的模拟和实际K波段数据的应用验证，该方法成功重建了超海王星型系外行星WASP-107b的传输光谱特征，为行星大气组成的模型无关检测提供了新途径。

2026-10-13.title: A Semianalytic Model of the Bouncing Barrier for Protoplanetary Dust Aggregates
2026-10-13.abstract: Abstract Collisional bouncing limits the growth of dust aggregates in protoplanetary disks, but its dependence on aggregate size, collision velocity, and filling factor remains poorly understood. Here we develop a semianalytic model for the sticking probability of colliding dust aggregates. We divide each aggregate collision into two phases: a compression phase and a separation phase. The compression phase is described with an elastoplastic contact model, which determines the maximum contact radius and repulsive energy after compression. The separation phase is treated as fracture of a stochastic network of interparticle bonds, whose fracture energy is evaluated using weakest-link statistics. The model naturally predicts that larger aggregates bounce more readily because larger contact regions are more likely to contain weak bonds. Comparison with distinct element method simulations shows that the model reproduces the simulated sticking–bouncing boundary. Furthermore, applying the calibrated model to moderately porous aggregates inferred from Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array observations of protoplanetary disks, we find that the predicted bouncing barrier passes through the observationally inferred size–velocity range. Thus, our semianalytic model provides a useful framework for predicting the collisional evolution of protoplanetary dust aggregates.
2026-10-13.summary_zh: 本研究通过分离碰撞的压缩和分离两个阶段，建立了原行星盘尘埃团块碰撞粘着概率的半解析模型，其中压缩阶段采用弹塑性接触模型，分离阶段采用随机键网络断裂统计描述。模型预测较大的团块更容易反弹，因为其接触区域更可能包含弱键，与数值模拟结果相符。将校准后的模型应用于ALMA观测推断的原行星盘团块，发现预测的反弹势垒与观测的尺度-碰撞速度范围相符，为原行星盘尘埃团块碰撞演化提供了有力的理论框架。

2026-10-11.title: A triple-induced merger in solves the proplyd lifetime problem and the curiously young shell of M42
2026-10-11.abstract: A longstanding tension exists between the stellar ages in the Orion Nebula Cluster (ONC) and the rapid external photoevaporation of its protoplanetary discs. More recently, the shell of the Orion Nebula has also been found to be dynamically younger than its stars. We propose a new scenario aimed at resolving both age issues. In our scenario, the most massive star of the ONC, formed from the merger between two binary stars induced by von Zeipel-Lidov-Kozai oscillations due to the present-day binary companion This merger, taking place between the last episode of star formation and today, resulted in an increased luminosity, leading to stronger external photoevaporation and accelerated expansion of the shell. We used Monte Carlo simulations to explore both whether a sudden brightening of could reconcile the stellar ages and shell expansion. We also considered whether the assumption of triple progenitors for could result in stellar mergers on the relevant timescale. A sudden brightening of a few hundred thousand years ago can be effective in reproducing today's shell, while maintaining a system age close to the stellar age. However, the required increase in the stellar wind luminosity would be greater than a simple merger would be equipped to explain. At a lower luminosity, the mixing of a relatively greater amount of cool photoevaporative wind material into the hot bubble could result in the required increase, and we identified a lower limit on the required strength of this effect. Additionally, we find that progenitor triples merge readily on timescales that are even shorter than the scenario would require. These mergers could be deferred by increased pre-main sequence tidal effects, rotation, and perturbing encounters with other cluster members. Ultimately, our proposed scenario with a merger driven by von Zeipel-Lidov-Kozai evolution successfully resolves two issues: the Orion Nebula's proplyd problem and the shell lifetime problems.
2026-10-11.summary_zh: 本研究针对猎户座星云星团中恒星年龄与原行星盘快速光蒸发之间的矛盾以及星云壳动力学年龄偏年轻的问题,提出了一个基于von Zeipel-Lidov-Kozai振荡诱导的三体星系并合模型。通过蒙特卡洛模拟,我们表明最大质量恒星数十万年前的并合能够增强恒星光度和星风强度,从而加速星云壳膨胀,同时使系统年龄与观测恒星年龄相协调,该机制有效地解决了原行星盘寿命问题和星云壳年龄悖论。

2026-10-11.title: The GAPS programme at TNG LXXXII. The first atmospheric investigation of the gas giant WASP-13 b at high resolution with GIARPS
2026-10-11.abstract: Abstract Low-density transiting gas giant exoplanets are key benchmarks for atmospheric studies. Despite their large-scale heights, many of them remain poorly characterised. We present the first atmospheric investigation at high-resolution of the inflated (Rp~1.4 RJ), hot Jupiter (T~1500 K) WASP-13 b aiming at constraining its atmospheric composition and refine its orbital geometry. We analysed four transits observed with GIARPS at the TNG. Updated stellar and planetary parameters were re-derived from the most precise literature values, and a new Rossiter-McLaughlin analysis was performed to measure the projected spin-orbit angle (λ) and stellar rotational velocity (vsin i⋆). Atmospheric signals were searched using high-resolution spectroscopy, both with cross-correlation and single-line analyses, targeting key atomic and molecular species (e.g. He i, Hα, Na i, H2O, CO). We find a well-aligned orbit (λ = 2.7±1.1○) and vsin i⋆ = 4.5±0.1 km s−1, improving upon previous constraints. No significant atmospheric absorption is detected in either VIS or NIR data. Injection-and-recovery tests exclude an isothermal atmosphere with metallicity [M/H]≲ 10 ×[M/H]⊙ and simultaneously a grey cloud top pressure Pcloud ≳ 10 mbar, under the assumption of chemical equilibrium. WASP-13 b appears to belong to the class of low-density hot Jupiters with weak or featureless transmission spectra, most likely shaped by the presence of high-altitude clouds. Although a highly metal-enriched atmosphere cannot be fully excluded, current evidence disfavours this scenario. Further observations with next-generation facilities will be essential to characterise the atmospheric properties of this challenging target.
2026-10-11.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-10-11.summary_zh: 本研究采用GIARPS高分辨率光谱仪对膨胀型热木星WASP-13 b进行首次大气观测,通过叠加相关和单线分析方法搜索He I、Hα、Na I、H₂O、CO等物种的大气信号。研究改进了该星系的轨道几何参数(自旋-轨道角λ = 2.7±1.1°),但在可见光和近红外数据中均未检测到显著的大气吸收特征,注入-恢复测试排除了金属丰度≲10倍太阳值且云顶压力≳10 mbar的等温大气模型。结果表明WASP-13 b属于低密度热木星中具有微弱光谱特征的一类,其传输谱的形态很可能由高空云层主导,而非金属富集大气。

2026-10-11.title: New determination of Jupiter’s vertical cloud and haze structure using dual viewing angle MUSE/VLT observations
2026-10-11.abstract: Abstract Jupiter is a hugely varying and diverse planet, demonstrated through spectacular changes in the cloud top appearance. However, the cloud structures which contributes to this appearance are hard to determine and are not known with certainty. A lack of in-situ observations and many unknown parameter values and numerous near-degenerate pairings within the parameter space for visible/near infrared observations of the aerosol profiles makes the problem under constrained. This work utilises several methods to alleviate these issues. Fitting simultaneously to dual viewing angle VLT/MUSE observations, using a radiative transfer algorithm, provides greater constraint to the aerosol profile than fitting to a single viewing geometry alone. To reduce the degeneracy between parameter pairings in the model, we utilise an aerosol profile with a minimised number of variable parameters by predetermining these values wherever possible. We find two clouds are needed, with a main cloud and haze layer fixed at 1.4 and 0.2 bars respectively, to successfully reproduce six years of VLT/MUSE observations (2018 - 2023), including dual angle observations of the Great Red Spot. We also retrieve an ammonia gas distribution across the disc similar to previous derived profiles, including the peak in deep volume mixing ratio at 5°N before a rapid depletion at 10°N. This cloud parameterisation successfully reproduces spectra extracted from 40°N to 40°S across the disc of Jupiter. For all locations (including the GRS) we find the material responsible for colouring Jupiter to be located in the main cloud layer (1.4 bar).
2026-10-11.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-10-11.summary_zh: 本研究利用VLT/MUSE双视角观测和辐射传输算法反演木星的气溶胶垂直结构,通过最小化模型自由参数和同时拟合多个视角数据来克服可见/近红外遥感中的参数简并问题。研究表明木星需要两层云结构(主云层1.4 bar和霾层0.2 bar)才能成功再现2018-2023年的六年观测数据,包括大红斑区域的观测。研究还反演了氨气分布,发现木星的着色物质主要位于主云层,这一云参数化方案可成功复现40°N至40°S全圆盘光谱。

2026-10-11.title: Capture of Interstellar Planetesimals in Protoplanetary Discs in Binary Star Systems
2026-10-11.abstract: Abstract Planet formation requires growth over 12 orders of magnitude in size, from micron-sized dust grains to fully formed planets. The formation of $\sim \rm km$ sized planetesimals is the most challenging stage, where radial drift and fragmentation rapidly remove meter-sized solids from the protoplanetary disc. Overcoming this barrier requires favourable conditions for streaming instability to concentrate solids. These problems are exacerbated in binary star systems, where gravitational perturbations and disc truncation reduce the efficiency of planetesimal formation pathways. Planetesimal capture provides an alternative mechanism where unbound planetesimals are captured by the protoplanetary disc through gas-drag, potentially bypassing the most restrictive growth stages. We investigate this process in circumstellar and circumbinary discs using over 3 × 107 numerical experiments across a range of binary separations. For circumstellar discs, capture of large (≳ 50 m) planetesimals is suppressed below ~50 au, with the strongest reduction at ~10 au, broadly consistent with the observed decrease in planet occurrence in binaries. Tight ($\sim 10\ \rm au$) binaries can still capture $\mathcal {O}(1)$ km-sized planetesimals, increasing to $\mathcal {O}(10)$ km-sized in wider systems during the birth cluster’s lifetime. Circumbinary discs are much less efficient, with capture rates dropping to ~1% of the single-star case for binaries above ~1 au and becoming negligible for large planetesimals at wider separations. Overall, planetesimal capture provides a supplementary channel for delivering solids to binary systems and mitigating inefficiencies in in-situ planetesimal formation.
2026-10-11.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-10-11.summary_zh: 本研究通过大规模数值模拟（3×10⁷个实验）系统调查了星际微行星在双星系统原行星盘中的捕获过程，覆盖环星盘和环双星盘两种配置。研究发现大型微行星（≳50 m）捕获效率在双星分离距离~10 au处最低，与观测到的双星系统中行星发生率下降一致，而紧密双星（~10 au）仍可捕获km级微行星。微行星捕获作为一个辅助通道，能够为双星系统提供固体物质，弥补原位微行星形成的不足。

2026-10-10.title: The Sun’s Chemical Peculiarity: Disentangling Galactic Chemical Evolution and Planetary Engulfment in Solar Twins
2026-10-10.abstract: Abstract Recent observational studies have suggested that the Sun may be chemically peculiar relative to the majority of solar twins. Here, we reanalyze high-resolution, high signal-to-noise spectra of 79 nearby solar twins using a differential spectroscopic approach and Bayesian framework to test whether the Sun’s chemical peculiarity arises from Galactic chemical evolution (GCE) or planetary ingestion. Using the spectroscopic tool Korg , we obtain highly precise, validated atmospheric parameters and abundances for 18 elements, with an average abundance precision of 0.015 dex (3.5%). Employing an independent Bayesian indicator, we disentangle GCE and planetary engulfment signatures from other processes influencing stellar composition, including intrinsic abundance scatter. Our results indicate that the chemical peculiarity of the Sun relative to the average solar twin is largely driven by GCE effects, with 62.3% ± 5.8% of our sample exhibiting abundance patterns well-described by GCE trends. We further identify 2–6 solar-twin candidates exhibiting chemical signatures consistent with planetary engulfment that warrant further investigation. These findings reinforce the importance of accounting for GCE effects when interpreting solar-twin abundance patterns, and suggest that the Sun may not be chemically peculiar relative to the majority of solar twins.
2026-10-10.summary_zh: 本研究对79颗太阳孪生星的高分辨光谱进行了差分光谱学分析,利用贝叶斯框架区分了银河化学演化和行星吞噬对太阳化学组成的影响。研究获得了18个元素的高精度丰度(精度~0.015 dex),发现太阳相对于平均太阳孪生星的化学特殊性主要由银河化学演化驱动(样本中62.3%的星体符合GCE趋势),同时识别出2-6颗候选太阳孪生星可能存在行星吞噬信号。这些结果表明在解释太阳孪生星丰度模式时必须考虑银河化学演化效应,且太阳相对于大多数孪生星可能并非化学异常。

2026-10-10.title: The JWST Sub-Jupiters Survey: Direct-imaging Discovery of a Giant Planet and a Debris Disk around the Young M Dwarf RX J0534.0-0221
2026-10-10.abstract: Abstract We present the discovery of RX J0534.0-0221 b, a giant planet orbiting an M dwarf star in the β Pictoris moving group. RX J0534 was originally observed with JWST/NIRCam in the F444W and F200W filters. Observations in F444W reveal a point source at signal-to-noise ratio ∼17.5 at ∼ 0 . ″ 41 (∼14 au) from the host star, with no detection of the source in F200W. A follow-up observation with LBTI/LMIRCam in the L ′ band redetects the source 16 months after the JWST epoch, providing evidence for common proper motion over a chance alignment with a background interloper at the 6 σ –7 σ level. Atmospheric grid model fits to the available photometry yield the bolometric luminosity log 10 ( L / L ⊙ ) = − 5.4 8 − 0.19 + 0.10 dex. At an age of 18–26 Myr, hot-start evolutionary models predict M = 2 . 8 − 0.5 + 0.5 M Jup and T eff = 67 4 − 49 + 57 K. From the L ′ − F 444 W color and magnitudes, we find evidence for disequilibrium chemistry or enhanced metallicity in the planet's atmosphere. Additionally, an extended structure is detected in the JWST F200W observation, consistent with a resolved debris disk with a peak density radius of 7 9 − 3 + 3 au and an inclination of 56 . ° 5 − 1.5 + 1.5 RX J0534 b is one of the lowest-mass planets imaged to date. After TWA 7 b, it is the second imaged planet around an M dwarf orbiting at solar system scales (the first within 40 au) and the first to be confirmed via common proper motion. Future orbital monitoring and atmospheric characterization will shed light on its formation history, a particularly interesting question given the challenging nature of giant planet formation around M dwarfs.
2026-10-10.summary_zh: 本研究利用JWST/NIRCam和LBTI/LMIRCam对年轻M矮星RX J0534.0-0221进行直接成像观测，通过多波段测光和16个月后的跟踪观测确认了一颗质量约2.8 M_Jup、距主星~14 au的巨行星，并检测到了碎片盘结构。大气模型拟合表明该行星大气中可能存在非平衡化学或增强的金属丰度，这为M矮星周围巨行星的形成机制研究提供了关键观测证据。

2026-10-10.title: JWST/MIRI Imaging Search for Kinematically Detected Protoplanetary Candidates
2026-10-10.abstract: Abstract Kinematic perturbations observed with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array in CO line emission provide evidence for a population of embedded giant protoplanets shaping the structure of protoplanetary disks. We present JWST/MIRI F1140C ( λ = 11.3 μ m) coronagraphic observations of five protoplanetary disks—HD 163296, RXJ 1615.3–3255, RXJ 1842.9–3532, SY Cha, and LkCa 15—with the goal of directly detecting candidate protoplanets orbiting at ≳70 au that were previously inferred from gas kinematics. The data were analyzed using a bespoke methodology that combines subtraction of a reference point-spread function with forward modeling of partially resolved inner disk emission, which otherwise dominates the diffraction pattern in the images. This approach improves the sensitivity to young companions at small separations. No point source consistent with an embedded protoplanet is detected in any of the systems. Instead, in three systems we detect extended emission at 11.3 μ m tracing the outer disk out to radii comparable to those probed by CO. Injection tests indicate upper mass limits of roughly 3–20 M J at separations of a few hundred astronomical units, assuming no additional thermal contribution from the circumplanetary environment. Even with space-based observations, these limits remain mostly above the ∼1–5 M J masses inferred from disk kinematics, largely due to the limitations imposed by emission (and/or scattered light) contributions from both the inner disk and outer disk. These observations highlight the challenges of observing protoplanets embedded in their forming environment at large separation with JWST/MIRI. Lessons learned can inform future studies with the Extremely Large Telescope, which will probe separations where the occurrence rate of gas giants is expected to be higher.
2026-10-10.summary_zh: 本研究通过JWST/MIRI冠状光学成像观测五个原行星盘，试图直接探测之前由气体运动学推断存在的嵌入式原行星候选体。采用参考点扩展函数减法结合内部盘发射前向建模的方法改进了小分离度伴星的灵敏度，但在所有系统中都未检测到与原行星一致的点源，而是在三个系统中探测到11.3 μm的延展外盘辐射。观测得到的质量上限（几百AU处为3-20 M_J）仍高于气体运动学推断的质量（~1-5 M_J），主要受到内外盘辐射贡献的限制，凸显了用JWST/MIRI在大分离度观测形成环境中嵌入式原行星的挑战。

2026-10-09.title: Metallicity does not reorder line-to-line sensitivity to granulation in solar-like stars
2026-10-09.abstract: Stellar granulation imprints line-dependent wavelength shifts and profile variations that limit the precision of radial velocity (RV) measurements used for exoplanet detection and characterization. Understanding how the sensitivity of individual spectral lines to granulation depends on stellar parameters is therefore essential for mitigating granulation-induced RV signals. Here, we investigate the effect of metallicity using MURaM 3D magnetohydrodynamic simulations of stellar granulation including a small-scale dynamo for metallicities $\mathrm{M/H}=\{-1.0,-0.5,0.0,0.3,0.5\}$. We synthesize spectra of neutral and ionized lines spanning a broad range of lower excitation potentials and transition probabilities using the MPS-ATLAS code, assuming local thermodynamic equilibrium. We quantify the sensitivity to granulation using the continuum-intensity-weighted standard deviations of the line centre-of-gravity wavelength and equivalent width, denoted by $σ_λ$ and $σ_W$, respectively. Both metrics increase systematically with metallicity at disc centre owing to the combined effects of more vigorous convection and metallicity-dependent changes in the line opacity. We find that the correlation between the solar ($\mathrm{M/H}=0.0$) and non-solar sensitivity metrics remains high from the disk center to the stellar limb. This indicates that the relative ordering of line sensitivities is robust against changes in viewing angle and metallicity. Consequently, line masks calibrated on the solar spectrum can be reliably applied to radial-velocity measurements of stars with non-solar metallicities, provided they have solar effective temperature and surface gravity.
2026-10-09.summary_zh: 本研究通过三维磁流体动力学模拟在不同金属丰度条件下恒星肉粒层的光谱效应，定量分析了中性和电离谱线对肉粒层扰动的敏感性随金属丰度的变化规律。虽然金属丰度增加会增强对流强度并系统性地提高谱线对肉粒层的敏感性，但不同谱线间的相对敏感性排序在不同金属丰度和视角下保持稳定。这一发现表明，为减小肉粒层诱发的径向速度误差，可以直接将太阳光谱下的谱线掩膜应用于非太阳金属丰度但其他参数相同的恒星，从而提高系外行星探测的精度。

2026-10-09.title: Gravitational Microlensing
2026-10-09.abstract: Gravitational microlensing is a unique planet-detection method that does not rely on detecting light from the host star or planet. Instead, planets are discovered when their gravitational field perturbs the light coming from a distant source. The mechanics of this method offer several advantages. It has the ability to detect wide-orbit planets of various masses around host stars of different types, at and beyond the system's snow line. Thus, microlensing complements the other detecting techniques that are more sensitive to close-orbit or high-mass planets. In this Chapter, we review the microlensing method and discuss how the physical properties, such as mass and distance, can be extracted from the microlensing light curve or from additional high-angular resolution observations. Microlensing is essential for the broader context of exoplanet demographics, as it can place constraints on planets, in wide orbits, beyond the {\it snow line}. Studying this parameter space can help us unravel the details of planet formation and how our own Solar System formed. Lastly, we provide an example of how to model a light curve and obtain accurate physical parameters for the host and planet.
2026-10-09.summary_zh: 重力微引力透镜是一种利用行星引力场扰动背景光源来探测系外行星的方法,无需直接探测宿主星或行星的光。该方法相较其他技术具有独特优势,能够探测宽轨道行星、不同质量行星和雪线外的行星,从而补充对近轨或高质量行星更敏感的探测手段。通过从微引力透镜光变曲线和高角分辨率观测中提取物理参数(如质量和距离),该方法对约束宽轨道和雪线外行星至关重要,有助于揭示行星形成机制和太阳系起源。

2026-10-09.title: EK Cha b: multi-tracer detection of a protoplanet candidate in a gas-rich environment
2026-10-09.abstract: Despite sustained community efforts and advances in instrumentation and high-contrast imaging, the search for protoplanets remains difficult, with only two widely accepted systems to date in Class II systems (PDS 70 and WISPIT 2). Here we present the detection of EK Cha b, a new protoplanet candidate, identified through CO emission, millimeter continuum and 0.82 micron broadband photometry, linked to EK Cha, a young late-type M star. The detection of a new protoplanet candidate offers an additional opportunity to advance our understanding of planet formation. By exploiting the wealth of archival data available for nearby star-forming regions, we aim to place EK Cha b in context, characterize its properties, and motivate future campaigns targeting similar systems. We analyzed high-spatial-resolution archival observations of EK Cha from HST, VLT/NACO, VLT/MUSE, and ALMA. We searched for EK Cha b in broadband continuum and gas tracers, reporting the measured flux with uncertainties, and upper limits for non-detections. EK Cha b shows a spectrally-resolved footprint that matches the CO J=2--1 emission, together with 0.82 micron and millimeter continuum emission.
