2026-09-16.summary_zh: 本研究采用因果发现统计框架分析328颗短周期巨行星样本，通过识别行星半径与其他可观测量之间的直接因果关系来探究热木星半径膨胀的物理机制。研究发现热木星半径与公转周期和恒星有效温度存在直接关联而与质量无关，这种配对依赖关系反映了辐照调控的膨胀特征，表明Gold-Soter热潮汐机制起重要作用，而纯引力潮汐机制因缺乏对恒星温度的依赖而被排除。该研究展示了因果发现框架在转化系群级系外行星数据为物理可解释检验的优势，为区分热潮汐、动力学加热和欧姆耗散等膨胀机制指明了观测方向。

2026-09-16.title: Photometric Solutions for 83 Neglected Eclipsing Binaries Using TESS Data
2026-09-16.abstract: Abstract We present a comprehensive photometric analysis of 83 eclipsing binary systems using high-precision space photometry from the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS). The targets were selected from the catalog of Avvakumova et al. to resolve historical classification uncertainties and characterize systems lacking modern data. Using the ELISa modeling code and a Markov Chain Monte Carlo approach, we derived fundamental photometric parameters as: q —photometric mass ratio, i —inclination, T 2 / T 1 —temperature ratio, Ω 1 , Ω 2 —surface potentials, R 1 e q , R 2 e q —equivalent radii in units of semimajor axis. The eight systems exhibit continuous period changes, three show potential light-time effects, and eleven require a third-light contribution. We modeled 26 active systems by incorporating a stellar spot. Using period–color and temperature–color diagrams, we identified several highly anomalous systems that challenge traditional classification schemes. The long-period contact candidate IT Nor ( P ≈ 1.75 days) is reinterpreted as a semidetached Algol-type system. Conversely, GX Nor ( P ≈ 0.27 days) is identified as a rare, short-period detached binary near the contact boundary. The hot, early-type systems V884 Mon and V395 And also occupy atypical parameter space for their short orbital periods, likely representing key transitional evolutionary phases.
2026-09-16.summary_zh: 本研究利用TESS高精度空间测光数据对83个食双星系统进行全面的光度学分析,通过ELISa模型和马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法获得了质量比、倾角、温度比、表面势和等效半径等基本参数。研究发现8个系统存在周期变化,3个系统显示光时效应,11个系统需要考虑第三光源,同时识别出IT Nor和GX Nor等多个异常系统,重新解释了传统分类方案中的误分类,为食双星的演化阶段研究提供了关键约束。

2026-09-16.title: TOI-4616 b: an Earth-sized planet transiting a nearby M4 dwarf
2026-09-16.abstract: Abstract Rocky exoplanets are particularly abundant around M-type stars. These stars’ small radii and low luminosities provide favourable conditions for detecting transiting terrestrial planets and probing their atmospheric properties. We report the discovery and statistical validation of TOI-4616 b, an Earth-sized planet transiting a nearby mid-M dwarf observed by TESS. We confirm the planetary nature of the signal and determine the system parameters by combining TESS photometry with ground-based multi-band transit observations, high-resolution imaging, and optical/near-infrared spectroscopy. The host star lies at a distance of 28.10 ± 0.07 pc and has R⋆ = 0.1889 ± 0.0096 R⊙, M⋆ = 0.1881 ± 0.0094 M⊙, and Teff = 3150 ± 75 K. TOI-4616 b has a radius of 1.22 R⊕ and an orbital period of 1.55 d. The planet receives an incident flux of ~40 S⊕, corresponding to an equilibrium temperature of ~525 K. This places TOI-4616 b in a regime intermediate between Earth-sized planets orbiting early M dwarfs and those around ultra-cool hosts. Statistical validation with TRICERATOPS, supported by high-resolution imaging and chromatic transit constraints, yields a false-positive probability of 0.0135 below the recommended threshold of 0.015, confirming TOI-4616 b as a validated planet. Owing to its proximity to Earth, well-constrained stellar properties, and extensive multi-band follow-up, TOI-4616 b constitutes a valuable benchmark system for comparative studies of terrestrial planets around mid-M dwarfs and for future atmospheric investigations.
2026-09-16.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-09-16.summary_zh: 本研究利用TESS光度测量结合地面多波段凌星观测、高分辨率成像和光学/近红外光谱，发现并统计验证了绕邻近M4矮星运行的类地行星TOI-4616 b，该行星半径为1.22 R⊕，公转周期1.55天，距地球仅28.10 pc。通过TRICERATOPS统计验证方法确定该行星的假阳性概率为0.0135（低于推荐阈值0.015），结合其接近地球、恒星参数约束良好等优势，使其成为研究中M矮星周围类地行星的重要基准系统。

2026-09-16.title: Implantation of icy planetesimals into the main asteroid belt due to the growth and outward migration of giant planets
2026-09-16.summary_zh: 本研究通过N体数值模拟研究了巨行星增长和向外迁移过程中，冰质小行星体如何被植入主小行星带的动力学机制。模拟结果表明，在巨行星迁移阶段，来自更外层区域的冰质小行星体可以通过引力散射被有效地注入主小行星带，其注入效率和分布受巨行星迁移速率的显著影响。这一机制为现有小行星带的组成成分、特别是C型小行星的起源提供了新的解释，对理解行星系统形成演化具有重要意义。

2026-09-15.title: POSTELLAR: Posterior Stellar Spectrum Sampling—An Alternative to Approximate Stellar Spectra for Exoplanetary Analysis
2026-09-15.abstract: Abstract We present a novel approach to perform posterior sampling of the underlying stellar spectrum in high-resolution spectroscopic observations. Our method, postellar , coherently combines information from empirical observations and physics-based models, enabling more accurate spectral recovery while providing uncertainties that can be propagated into downstream analyses. This is accomplished by treating the intrinsic stellar spectrum as a latent variable and performing posterior sampling under a Gaussian likelihood with an informative prior constructed using a score-based diffusion model trained on PHOENIX stellar models. We validate the framework on synthetic SPectropolarimètre InfraRouge (SPIRou) radial velocity (RV) observations generated from the empirical spectra of Barnard’s Star and Proxima Centauri. Spectra inferred with postellar recover the ground truth more accurately than standard empirical templates. For medium signal-to-noise observations, postellar improves RV accuracy by up to a factor of three, while RVs derived from empirical templates tend to be biased. This method performs particularly well in low signal-to-noise and low-cadence regimes. The postellar framework is broadly applicable to other high-resolution spectroscopy science cases, including stellar abundance analyses and exoplanet atmospheric characterization.
2026-09-15.summary_zh: 本研究提出POSTELLAR方法，通过结合实证观测和基于物理模型的先验信息，采用扩散模型进行恒星光谱后验采样，从而更准确地恢复内禀恒星谱。在合成SPIRou径向速度观测上的验证表明，该方法在中等信噪比条件下将径向速度精度提高三倍，相比经验模板避免了系统偏差，在低信噪和稀疏采样情况下性能尤为优异。该框架也适用于恒星丰度分析和系外行星大气表征等高分辨率光谱科学。

2026-09-15.title: Disk Evolution and Planet Formation in the Triple HD 104237 System
2026-09-15.abstract: Abstract Planets are rare in close ( a < 10 au) binaries, consistent with millimeter surveys showing that circumbinary disks in such systems are typically fainter than disks around wide binaries or single stars. However, a few bright circumbinary disks deviate from this trend, suggesting that planet-forming reservoirs can sometimes survive severe dynamical truncation. We present high-angular-resolution (0 . ″ 1; 11 au) Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array Band 6 observations of the triple system HD 104237, a young Herbig Ae spectroscopic binary ( a = 0.22 au) with a tertiary companion at 134 au in the ϵ Cha association. The data reveal a compact circumbinary dust disk with outer radius R dust ≈ 8 au and a characteristic CO gas radius R CO ≈ 18 au, with faint CO emission extending farther outward. Despite its small size, the disk remains relatively massive, consistent with the high stellar accretion rates observed in the system. Modeling the CO kinematics with a Markov Chain Monte Carlo fit to the visibilities yields a dynamical mass for the central binary of M * = 2.42 ± 0.36 M ⊙ , lower than previous estimates. The CO velocity field is well described by Keplerian rotation, with no significant residuals. Hydrodynamic simulations reproduce the observed disk truncation and velocity structure, indicating that the tertiary companion limits the outer disk. Nevertheless, a substantial gaseous reservoir persists within the compact inner disk, compatible with ongoing planet formation. HD 104237 is therefore an outlier to the general trend of disk depletion in close binaries, demonstrating that compact massive circumbinary disks can survive in dynamically complex multiple systems. We also report millimeter continuum and 12 CO(2–1) emission from the disk surrounding HD 104237 E.
2026-09-15.summary_zh: 本研究利用ALMA高分辨率观测研究了近密近双星系统HD 104237的环双星盘结构，发现该系统的尘埃盘半径仅~8 au，但保持相对高质量，气体盘延伸至~18 au，通过CO运动学MCMC拟合得到中心双星动力学质量为2.42±0.36 M☉。流体动力学模拟表明三体伴星限制了外盘的延伸，但紧凑内盘内仍存在可观的气体储备库，与行星形成相容，表明即使在动力学复杂的多星系统中，质量充足的环双星盘也能幸存并维持行星形成活动。

2026-09-15.title: Stability of circumbinary planets: The role of binary properties and migration scenarios
2026-09-15.abstract: Of the thousands of exoplanets detected to date, only a very small fraction are classified as circumbinary planets. When considering only low-mass planets, their number becomes negligible. This rarity may be partly explained by observational biases, but also by the challenging dynamical environment that often prevents the long-term stability of planetary orbits in binary systems. It is therefore essential to investigate the conditions that enable the formation and survival of stable circumbinary planets, with particular attention to the case of low-mass planets. To this end, we performed N-body simulations coupled with a planet migration prescription to study the post-formation dynamics of two circumbinary planets of 10 Earth masses in a protoplanetary disc. This approach allowed us to estimate whether, for a given set of binary and planetary parameters, planets remain bound to their stars or become unstable and ejected. Based on more than 1,000 simulations, our results indicate that two-planet inward migration can, in some cases, be halted through resonance capture with the binary. In contrast to some previous purely N-body studies, such configurations appear to remain stable over long timescales. We further find that the binary parameters q_B and e_B play a key role in shaping the stability landscape of multi-planet systems. Within the explored parameter space, some regions support long-term stability, whereas others appear highly unstable. These stability regions are also highly sensitive to the migration timescales (i.e. to disc properties and planetary masses). Finally, our simulations suggest that systems in which two planets enter resonance while migrating together are more likely to form stable multi-planet configurations, particularly around highly eccentric binaries. This constitutes a first step towards identifying the most promising binary star systems likely to host multiple low-mass circumbinary planets. They may serve as valuable guidelines for future observational campaigns, such as those of PLATO and . Gaia
2026-09-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过耦合N体模拟和行星迁移模型,研究了双星系统中两颗地球质量行星的形成和动力学稳定性,基于超过1000次模拟探索了双星性质(质量比和离心率)与行星迁移时标如何影响多行星系统的稳定性。结果表明,行星在迁移过程中可通过与双星的共振捕获实现稳定配置,且在高离心率双星周围的共振迁移系统更易形成长期稳定的多行星构型。该工作为识别可能容纳低质量环双星行星的最有利双星系统提供了定量指引,对未来PLATO和Gaia等观测任务具有重要参考意义。

2026-09-15.title: The atomic C/O ratio of KELT-9b
2026-09-15.abstract: The carbon-to-oxygen (C/O) ratio of a giant planet's atmosphere has long been theorised to hold compositional information that can be traced back to its formation history. Typically, the C/O ratio of an exoplanetary atmosphere is inferred from abundance measurements of major C- and O-bearing molecules such as CO, CO_2, H_2O, and OH. However, some exoplanets have such elevated temperatures that molecules can be nearly completely thermally dissociated at the pressure levels that observations probe, making it difficult to measure their C/O ratio via these traditional tracers. Here, rather than using molecules, we aim to retrieve the C/O ratio of KELT-9b (T_ = 4000,K) directly from atomic C and O, which are detected in its atmosphere. eq We analysed two transits of KELT-9b observed with the MAROON-X high-resolution spectrograph, finding absorption cross-correlation signals from atomic C and O as well as refractory metals. From this, we inferred the vertical temperature structure, the relative proportions of volatile and refractory species, and the C/O ratio of KELT-9b using a 1D local thermodynamic equilibrium atmospheric retrieval framework applied only to spectral regions mostly unaffected by non-local thermodynamic equilibrium effects. We measure the atomic C/O ratio of the atmosphere of KELT-9b to be 0.20_ -0.07 ^ +0.13 , which is slightly lower than the stellar value of 0.38 times solar ($ and significantly below the solar value of 0.59 ^ We otherwise confirm previous investigations of the terminator region, finding KELT-9b's atmosphere to be thermally inverted and slightly metal-rich. We measure the volatile-to-refractory ratio, a proxy for the ice-to-rock ratio, to be 1.24_ -0.78 +1.93 M_ $/M_ vol ref = 0.09_ -0.20 ^ +0.19 ), which is consistent with both KELT-9 and the Sun. While there are caveats to interpreting observations of such an extreme planet, our results demonstrate that atomic species can be used to measure C/O ratios of exoplanetary atmospheres in high-temperature regimes where molecules are thermally dissociated.
2026-09-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过MAROON-X高分辨率分光观测，直接从超高温系外行星KELT-9b大气中检测的原子碳和氧推导其C/O比，采用局部热力学平衡大气反演框架获得大气垂直温度结构和金属丰度。测得KELT-9b的原子C/O比为0.20（略低于其主星值0.38倍太阳值），证实了该行星大气存在热反演和轻微超金属特征。该研究表明原子物种可用于测量分子完全热离解的高温系外行星大气的C/O比，为极端条件下行星成因信息的追踪提供了新途径。

2026-09-15.title: Self-gravity in thin protoplanetary discs. II. Numerical convergence solved and revealing the overestimation in mass of formed planets with softening
2026-09-15.abstract: Gravitational instability (GI) is a leading theory proposed to explain both angular momentum transport and early planet formation in young, massive discs. In the early 2010s, 3D smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) simulations investigating GI failed to achieve convergence. Although this issue was initially addressed and attributed to resolution-dependent viscosity, it subsequently emerged in 2D SPH and 2D grid-based simulations -- suggesting a numerical artefact inherent to the 2D approximation of gravity. Recently, we derived from first principles a much improved prescription for gravity in 2D discs (via a Bessel kernel). This prescription introduces a characteristic length, H_ rms, below which gravity smoothly transitions from a 3D to a 2D scaling. This cannot be captured by standard smoothing length approaches, widely used in 2D simulations. My objective is to employ this new prescription to resolve the convergence issue of GI in 2D and compare the outcomes of the instability in runs using the Bessel kernel with those obtained using softening prescriptions at high resolution. I conducted numerical simulations with the code, where the Bessel prescription was implemented. The 2D Bessel formalism of gravity effectively resolves the convergence issues encountered in 2D simulations. When compared to simulations employing softened or unsoftened potentials, I observe that a softening parameter ε/Hłeq 0.3 overestimates gravitational effects. This may result in an artificially high number of fragments, potentially leading to final fragment masses that are overestimated by a factor of 2–3. Conversely, employing a softening parameter exceeding the scale height inhibits gravitational effects. Although my analysis initially suggests that a softening parameter of 0.6 H might offer the best compromise, in reality, the resulting fragments fail to remain gravitationally bound—a limitation not observed when using the Bessel kernel. My findings on the Bessel kernel, coupled with its high numerical efficiency, strongly suggest its adoption in future studies to ensure a consistent and accurate treatment of gravity in thin discs.
2026-09-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过首次从第一原理推导的Bessel核方法解决了二维光滑粒子流体动力学(SPH)模拟中引力不稳定性(GI)的长期收敛性问题,该方法通过引入特征长度H_rms准确捕捉重力从三维到二维的过渡。与传统softening方法的对比模拟表明,softening参数ε/H≤0.3会高估引力效应,导致碎片数量和质量被高估2-3倍,而过大的softening参数则会抑制引力效应导致碎片难以维持引力束缚。研究结果强烈推荐在薄盘行星形成研究中采用Bessel核方法,以确保引力处理的一致性和准确性。

2026-09-15.title: Oxidation constraints on terrestrial planet formation from a ring
2026-09-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过分析原行星盘中固体物质的氧化状态约束，揭示了陆地行星形成过程中物质的化学演化规律。我们建立了考虑盘内温度梯度和氧逸逸的热力学模型，以解释行星物质的氧化还原状态如何影响其聚集和分化行为。研究表明，原始盘中的氧化条件不仅决定了行星物质的初始成分，还通过改变物质的密度和碰撞性质，对行星的最终质量分布和内部结构产生重要制约。

2026-09-15.title: Orbit determination of the Emirates Mission to the Asteroid Belt flyby target asteroids using Minor Planet Center (MPC) and Gaia focused product release astrometry
2026-09-15.summary_zh: 本研究利用小行星中心(MPC)和盖亚天文测量数据,对阿联酋小行星带探测任务的掠过目标小行星进行轨道确定。通过比较两个独立的天文测量数据源,评估了轨道确定精度,并分析了不同数据质量对小行星轨道参数的影响。研究结果为该探测任务的导航规划和小行星物理特性推导提供了关键的动力学基础。

2026-09-13.title: Sorting a mess. I. Addressing the velocity-axis correlation of cross-correlation functions: A census of atomic and ionised species in KELT-9b's atmosphere
2026-09-13.abstract: Ultra-hot Jupiters (UHJs) represent the most extreme class of close-in gas giants, with KELT-9b being the most extreme example known. For this study, we combined 13 transit observations of KELT-9b from six high-resolution spectrographs spanning 316--960,nm to conduct a census of atomic and ionised species in the planet’s atmosphere using the cross-correlation technique. The primary objective is to introduce an agnostic strategy to mitigate velocity-axis correlation bias in parameter uncertainties during cross-correlation analysis. By employing a forward model of the cross-correlation function (CCF) alongside a Monte Carlo bootstrap of flux uncertainties, the individual CCF-derived velocity profiles of each species in the planet’s atmosphere were measured, and potential time dependence in these velocity profiles was assessed. The stellar reference frame was determined, yielding a systemic velocity of sys = -17.99 ± 0.04,km,s-1 and a projected rotational velocity of v = -8.02 ± 0.17,km,s$^ i = 110.54 ± 0.05$,km,s^-1, which is consistent across all instruments and observing nights. The combined planetary absorption profiles provide insight into the collective motion of all detectable gas species in the atmosphere. All previously reported species were recovered except for Tb,II, and the combined analysis detects 29 species, including additional absorbers C,I, Si,I, K,I, V,II, Co,I, Zr,II, La,II, Pr,II, and Nd,II. All 29 recovered species exceed the conventional 5σ threshold in the bootstrap Mahalanobis significance test. The collective Doppler shifts display a blueshift of Δ V_ offset -1 relative to the stellar rest frame, indicating a net day-to-night wind, with no explicit time dependence observed when all species are homogenised. These results constitute a catalogue of detections and retrieved Doppler parameters, forming a foundation for a companion study of KELT-9b that would allow for the most significant detections to be analysed and the differences across individual species to be compared.
2026-09-13.summary_zh: 本研究使用六台高分辨率分光仪的13次凌星观测数据,结合交叉相关技术对超热木星KELT-9b大气中的原子和离子物种进行了普查。通过引入前向建模和蒙特卡洛自助法,研究开发了一种消除速度轴相关偏差的无偏策略,测量了29个气体物种的视向速度轮廓。结果表明所有物种整体呈现蓝移(-1.74 km/s),反映了行星大气中日夜风的净效应,且未观测到随时间的显著变化。

2026-09-12.title: The Mysterious Inspiral of WASP-12b: Why Obliquity Tides Cannot Drive Orbital Decay
2026-09-12.abstract: WASP-12b's orbit is decaying, for unknown reasons. The planet's period is shrinking more rapidly than can be attributed to equilibrium tides or dynamical tides in a main-sequence star. Planetary obliquity tides could be sufficiently dissipative to drive WASP-12b's inspiral, but would also damp the planet's obliquity, halting the decay. Millholland & Laughlin proposed that a nearby, low-mass planet ($\sim 10$ M$_\oplus$) is maintaining a large obliquity for WASP-12b, sustaining the dissipation. We re-evaluated this hypothesis, finding that the companion must be more massive than originally proposed ($\gtrsim 65$ M$_\oplus$) to absorb WASP-12b's orbital angular momentum. Radial velocity data allowed us to rule out a companion of this type. Any companions within $3$ AU have $K \lesssim 14$ m/s at $95$% confidence.
2026-09-12.summary_zh: 本研究通过数值模拟和径向速度数据分析,检验了低质量伴星通过维持热木星WASP-12b的大倾角来驱动其黄道倾角潮汐耗散并导致轨道衰减的假说。研究发现,该假说要求伴星质量至少为65 M⊕以吸收WASP-12b的轨道角动量,但径向速度观测以95%置信度排除了这样的伴星存在。因此,黄道倾角潮汐无法解释WASP-12b异常快速的轨道衰减,其真实物理机制仍需进一步探索。

2026-09-12.title: Planetary Accretion Is Less Frequent in Wide Binaries: Evidence from Metal-Enriched White Dwarfs in DESI DR1
2026-09-12.abstract: Binary stars are common in the Galaxy, and understanding how stellar binarity influences the formation and evolution of planetary systems is an active area of research. In this study, we use metal-enriched white dwarfs in wide binaries as tracers of long-lived planetary systems. With Data Release 1 from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI), we find that the fraction of cool metal-enriched white dwarfs in wide binaries is 9.8\,$\pm$\,2.1\%, significantly lower (4.7\,$σ$) than the 20.5\,$\pm$\,0.9\% in a control sample of single systems. Furthermore, we identify a tentative dependence of metal enrichment on projected separation and white dwarf effective temperature, where enrichment fraction decreases at smaller separations and lower temperatures. These findings indicate that, compared to single stars, binary systems either start with smaller initial planetary reservoirs due to suppressed planetesimal formation or undergo more rapid depletion of planetary material during the initial part of the white dwarf stage.
2026-09-12.summary_zh: 本研究利用DESI DR1数据中宽食双星系统内的金属污染白矮星作为长期存在行星系统的示踪体，发现宽食双星中金属污染白矮星的比例（9.8%）显著低于单星系统（20.5%），表明双星环境抑制了行星吸积。分析表明金属污染程度与投影分离度和白矮星有效温度存在关联，这提示双星系统可能因行星体形成抑制导致初始行星物质储量较少，或在白矮星早期阶段经历更快速的行星物质耗散。

2026-09-12.title: Properties of Linear Magnetic Holes at Jupiter Based on Juno Observations
2026-09-12.abstract: Abstract Magnetic holes (MHs) are localized magnetic depressions widely observed in space plasmas and are important for understanding plasma instability, particle dynamics, and energy conversion. Among them, linear magnetic holes (LMHs), defined by strong magnetic depressions with little field rotation, have been reported at several terrestrial planets, but their global properties at Jupiter remain poorly understood. Here, by using 10 yr. of Juno observations, we present the first comprehensive study of LMHs in Jupiter’s space environment. We investigate their spatial distribution, occurrence rate, timescales, and associated electron dynamics and show that LMHs are widespread in both the magnetosheath and magnetosphere and can persist for much longer timescales than those observed at terrestrial planets. Electron measurements reveal diverse pitch-angle distributions dominated by isotropic and field-aligned populations, as well as frequent energetic-electron flux enhancements. These results suggest that Jovian LMHs represent a large-scale extension of MH structures and that their properties depend on plasma environment and system size, providing new constraints on the universality of LMHs across the heliosphere.
2026-09-12.summary_zh: 本研究利用10年的Juno卫星观测数据，首次系统研究了木星磁层和磁鞘中线性磁孔的空间分布、发生率、时间尺度及相关电子动力学特性。研究发现木星的线性磁孔广泛分布且持续时间远长于地球行星观测结果，电子测量显示各向同性和沿磁场方向的复杂分布，以及频繁的高能电子通量增强。这些结果表明木星线性磁孔代表了更大尺度的磁孔结构，其性质与等离子体环境和系统尺度相关，为理解整个日球层中磁孔的普遍性提供了新的约束。

2026-09-12.title: Spin–Orbit Alignment of Two Neptune-size Planets Younger Than 500 Myr: TOI-560 b and TOI-5082 b
2026-09-12.abstract: Abstract Stellar obliquity measurements provide a direct probe of planetary system dynamics, but remain sparse for Neptune-size planets, particularly at young ages. We present Rossiter–McLaughlin measurements for two young Neptune-size planets, TOI-560 b and TOI-5082 b, using time-resolved Keck Planet Finder (KPF) spectroscopy and joint modeling with TESS transit photometry. We measure sky-projected obliquities of λ b = −25° ± 16° for TOI-560 b and λ b = 1 9 ° − 13 ° + 17 ° for TOI-5082 b. Combining these constraints with stellar rotation periods and spectroscopic estimates of v sin i ⋆ , we obtain 95% upper limits of ψ < 69 . ° 7 and ψ < 50 . ° 5, respectively. Both systems are therefore consistent with low to moderate true obliquities and show no evidence of strong spin-orbit misalignment. With ages of 480 ± 190 Myr for TOI-560 b and 180 ± 9 Myr for TOI-5082 b (a likely member of the CRIUS197 stellar association), the systems are in a key evolutionary phase when postdisk dynamical processes such as secular interactions may begin to manifest. Nevertheless, both systems remain consistent with low obliquity. In the broader context of young systems with existing measurements, these results support an emerging picture in which Neptune-size planets at ≲1 Gyr are commonly found in low-obliquity configurations.
2026-09-12.summary_zh: 本研究通过Keck Planet Finder的罗西特-麦克劳林效应测量，获得了两颗年龄均小于500 Myr的海王星级行星TOI-560 b和TOI-5082 b的自转-轨道倾角，结合TESS凌星光度测光和恒星参数约束，测得它们的真实倾角均处于低至中等水平。这两个系统虽处于后吸积盘动力学过程（如世俗相互作用）可能开始显现的关键演化阶段，但均未显示出强烈的自转-轨道失准现象，与年轻系统中海王星级行星普遍保持低倾角的新兴图景相符。
